jobs.name: Internship in Controlling (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF At Corporate Finance@BASF, we do not just focus on figures, but solutions. Our approach is strategic and innovative, we get things done. Doing so, the needs of our business partners are priority and we have the finger on the pulse when it comes to sustainability and digitalization. Topics such as evaluation of mergers & acquisitions and major investments, financing, the preparation of published statements, the management of financial risks and advising the board of directors on economic decisions are all part of our daily job. In collaboration with our globally networked communities, we continuously develop and enhance our processes. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Exciting controlling tasks await you in the Group Reporting & Performance Management department from december 2026 for a period of 3 to 6 months. You’ll have the opportunity to apply your academic knowledge and gain valuable insights into BASF’s finance and controlling processes. You will support budget planning, forecasting and risk management activities. Moreover,  you will assist in the systematic analysis of financial and operational data and preparation of both regular and ad hoc reports. You will contribute your knowledge to the identification of business developments as well as trends and thus contribute to economic decision-making. Furthermore, you will work with various IT tools and systems relevant to controlling and reporting. Varied project assignments and international teamwork complement the diversity of responsibilities. WHAT YOU OFFER currently pursuing a degree in business administration or economics with a focus on controlling or finance ideally first work experience during internships or study-related activities or experience abroad above-average performance strong affinity for numbers and IT systems, especially SAP, Microsoft Excel and Power Point independent work approach, and commitment proficiency in English is required; knowledge of German is an Advantage WHAT WE OFFER Practical phase - actively apply theory in challenging and varied tasks/projects Teambuddy - contact person for all questions and regular feedback Networks - get to know different perspectives, ways of thinking and fields of work Internship compensation - a recognition of the commitment, more information here: on.basf.com/compensationBASFSE Flexible working hours - depending on the location and area of work HOW TO REACH US Laura Deland (Talent Acquisition), laura.deland@basf.com , Tel.:+49 30 2005-58168 will be happy to answer your questions for this position. You're also welcome to book an online appointment . You can also reach our recruiting team here First information about our application process can be found here ABOUT US First information about our application process can be found here: http://on.basf.com/applicationprocess . BASF SE, located in Ludwigshafen am Rhein, is the corporate headquarters of the BASF Group and part of the Rhine-Neckar Metropolitan Region. BASF stands for competence in chemistry since 1865 and is represented today in the world's major consumer markets, with a wide range of products. As the largest employer in the region, BASF SE offers multiple career opportunities for students, university graduates and professionals providing also training in over 30 professions. Leisure, sports, culture and a good infrastructure characterize the Rhine-Neckar Metropolitan Region, in which BASF is also involved with numerous activities. Learn more about BASF SE at on.basf.com/BASFSE_LU Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.name: Traineeprogram START IN Finance & Controlling with focus Controlling (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF We are BASF in agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. We do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture by connecting innovation, customers and society. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth Take a look at our Agricultural Solutions vision & mission! WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT With our 18-month trainee program, you will gain a comprehensive insight into the various fields of activity in the areas of finance and controlling. From the very beginning, you will work on your own projects in which you can advance topics in the field of finance or controlling. Your three assignment stations of six months each as well as your later target function will be individually coordinated with you. In doing so, we consider your wishes and strengths. In each assignment station, you will familiarize yourself with the corresponding topic area, such as operational and strategic controlling, innovation controlling, business evaluations, or digitalization projects. After a short time, you will take responsibility for exciting projects or initiate them yourself. You will always have a professional contact person at your side. During the entire time of the trainee program, you will receive mentoring that will strengthen you in your professional and personal development. An assignment abroad allows you to get to know a new culture and gain insights into other ways of working. In this way, you will further develop your intercultural competence and expand your global network at the same time. Here, too, we will coordinate the location individually with you. The trainee program prepares you optimally for a career in the field of finance and controlling. After completing the program, you will have a wide range of career opportunities within the company. By working closely with various stakeholders, taking on responsible projects and being in contact with senior management, trainees and alumni, you will build a strong network. In doing so, you will lay the foundation for a successful professional future at BASF. WHAT YOU OFFER We are looking for committed university graduates who set themselves goals and want to leave their comfort zone. We require the following minimum requirements: • Degree in the field of business/economics (Master, PhD, MBA) • At least 3-month internship in Finance and/or Controlling • At least 3 months abroad (in the form of study semesters or internships abroad) A maximum of three years’ work experience. • Fluency in English is a must, German language skills are a plus Additional requirements: • Ability to work in a team: You enjoy working in a team and can quickly integrate into new groups. • Strong communication skills: You can convey complex issues in an understandable and precise way. • Analytical thinking: You have the ability to systematically analyze problems and develop solutions. • Initiative: You proactively show commitment and contribute your own ideas. WHAT WE OFFER Mentoring that supports your personal and professional development A wide range of seminars tailored to your needs Networking events where you can expand your career network Permanent employment contract from day 1 and best career opportunities HOW TO REACH US Laura Deland (Talent Acquisition), laura.deland@basf.com , Tel.:+49 30 2005-58168 will be happy to answer your questions for this position You can also reach our recruiting team here First information about our application process can be found here: on.basf.com/applicationprocess . ABOUT US As a reliable partner of the rural economy, Agricultural Solutions offers innovative, sustainable solutions for plant protection and health. With the agricultural center in Limburgerhof, close to the BASF Group headquarters in Ludwigshafen, you can expect an attractive place for both work and play in the Rhine-Neckar region. Learn more about BASF SE at on.basf.com/Headquarters Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.name: Banco de Talentos - PCD - Pessoas com Deficiência - Brasil
jobs.description: Criamos química para um futuro sustentável Cerca de 111.000 funcionários do Grupo BASF contribuem para o sucesso de nossos clientes em quase todos os setores e em quase todos os países do mundo. Nossa carteira compreende seis segmentos: Químicos, Materiais, Soluções Industriais, Tecnologias de Superfície, Nutrição e Cuidados e Soluções Agrícolas. A BASF gerou vendas de cerca de 78.6 bilhões de euros em 2021. A BASF, em contínua busca pela equidade e pluralidade de seus colaboradores, representatividade na sociedade e em linha com sua estratégia global de Diversidade & Inclusão, lança seu Banco de Talentos – PCD - Pessoas com deficiência, com o objetivo de buscar profissionais para atuar em seus negócios. Acreditamos que a diversidade de nossos colaboradores e colaboradoras com sua pluralidade de ideias e experiências, traz novas perspectivas e resultados, permitindo que alcancemos nosso objetivo de ser uma organização de alta performance, gerando interações criativas, inovação e valor para nossa gente, nossos clientes e para a sociedade. Quer se juntar ao time BASF? Se inscreva em nosso Banco de Talentos e, caso surja uma oportunidade para o seu perfil, vamos entrar em contato com você. Este Banco de Talentos é direcionado para profissionais PCD - Pessoa Com Deficiência , que tenham interesse em oportunidades de trabalho em todo o Brasil. O que queremos? Queremos que nossos(as) colaboradores(as) se sintam valorizados(as) por serem quem são, do jeito que são e, assim, possam desempenhar 100% das suas potencialidades. Como atuamos? Atuamos sempre para alcançar três grandes objetivos: Promover equidade ao longo de toda jornada dos(as) colaboradores(as) e nos processos de gestão de pessoas. Desde a seleção, passando pela integração e todos os processos internos. Desenvolver ações afirmativas que garantam a representatividade das sociedades em que operamos negócios e que gerem oportunidades para grupos historicamente discriminados. Contribuir para gerar diferenciais competitivos ao influenciar a cadeia de valor. Nossa estratégia está ancorada em quatro pilares: Demografia: Queremos que o conjunto de características das pessoas que compõe nossa empresa reflita o conjunto de características que está presente na comunidade ou na sociedade onde atuamos. Comunicação e cultura: Queremos reforçar nosso cuidado na relação com todas as pessoas. jobs.name: Officer/ Specialist Payroll and HR administration Specialist with French (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF In Global Business Services, we support BASF's divisions with a cross-functional network and offer modern solutions tailored to the needs of the business. As a specialized service unit we ensure a high level of customer orientation, and we design our services to be cooperative, efficient and future-oriented. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Within the HR Services Team France, we are a diverse and inclusive team of experts and young professionals. Together, we are committed to deliver the highest quality of service to our BASF partners in France. To complete our Administration& Payroll team, we are looking for an HR Specialist/ Officer (m/f/d) with a strong enthusiasm for Payroll, HR processes and customer relations. Your responsibilities will include: You process variable elements for the preparation of monthly payroll, improve and maintain HR administrative processes in our HR systems. You prepare monthly and yearly reporting on HR data. You ensure that all legal and regulatory requirements concerning our HR services are met. You advise and inform the employees based in France regarding HR topics. You work closely with our local HR partners in France as well as with our internal departments in Berlin and our technical service providers. You are innovative and participate in internal projects, identify opportunities for improvement and encourage the sharing of best practices between our European HR teams. You take part in the digitalization of our HR services; by identifying opportunities for improvement and sharing best practices with your international colleagues. WHAT YOU OFFER You have successfully completed vocational training or hold a degree in Human Resources, Payroll, or a related field, and you bring initial professional experience in HR, including a first exposure to payroll processes. Building on this initial experience, you are motivated to further develop your knowledge of payroll processes and deepen your understanding of legal regulations related to social security, taxation, time management, and compensation & benefits. You feel comfortable working with HR systems (ideally SAP HR) and have a good level of confidence using Excel in your daily work. You are fluent in French and have a good command of English. Knowledge of German would be a plus. You enjoy working with people and interacting with stakeholders in a friendly, helpful, and service-oriented way. You have strong analytical and organizational skills and are able to structure your work well, even when working towards deadlines. WHAT WE OFFER Gross annual salary (full-time): 40.000 - 46.000 €, depending on qualifications and professional experience - In addition, you can expect a bonus dependent on the company's success 30 days of paid vacation, special leave and sabbatical options Flexible working hours so that you can organize your working and private life according to your needs Modern sustainable office building in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg with flexible working options, rooftop terrace and cafeteria for innovative and team-focused collaboration - get to know our location Team and company events in which we celebrate our achievements and live up our team spirit Location-independent work models with defined days of presence in Berlin and place of residence in Germany - Here a first impression Subsidy for public transport, personal employee benefit card and other discounts Work mobile from other EU countries for up to six weeks HOW TO REACH US ? You can also reach our recruiting team here . First information about our application process can be found here . ABOUT US As an international service hub, the BASF Services Europe GmbH bundles a wide range of services for the BASF Group throughout Europe. In the heart of Berlin, we combine expertise in the areas of finance, HR, supply chain, procurement, product safety and IT. jobs.name: Internship Predictive Maintenance (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF The Global Engineering Services service unit contributes to shaping a sustainable future with outstanding technical expertise. With our dedicated, interdisciplinary teams, we support BASF's divisions in growing together with our customers and markets. We implement investments competitively. Around the globe, we provide safe and reliable solutions to ensure that production plants deliver excellent performance. We are continuously improving and driving digital transformation. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Our Asset Monitoring Solutions & Services unit develops innovative and sustainable solutions to increase plant availability. Unplanned downtimes are specifically reduced by combining process engineering/mechanical engineering knowledge with methods from applied mathematics, data science and IT. The overarching goal is the holistic and sustainable optimization of the maintenance process over the entire life cycle of a plant. As part of a mandatory internship of three to six months, with the option of supplementing this with a voluntary placement, you will have the opportunity to integrate different types of machines into the monitoring process from January 2027 and get to know different IT systems in the process: You will put innovative technologies & methods for model- and data-based condition monitoring of process engineering machines as well as apparatus into practice. You will quickly familiarize yourself with the system architecture and contribute your ideas to the further development of system tools. At the Ludwigshafen site, you will work in an interdisciplinary and cross-departmental team in which you will present and discuss your results. The focus of your work will depend on your interests and skills. WHAT YOU OFFER enrolled student in a bachelor's or master's program in a technical field, e.g. engineering or physics interest in linking plant engineering with digital technologies excellent knowledge of English and good knowledge of German ideally good knowledge of drive and driven machines, process engineering or chemistry motivation and perseverance to implement innovative and practical solutions based on scientific findings independent and autonomous work and ability to actively contribute ideas to the team WHAT WE OFFER Practical phase - actively apply theory in challenging and varied tasks/projects Team buddy - contact person for all questions and regular feedback Networks - get to know different perspectives, ways of thinking and areas of work Internship remuneration - recognition of your work, more information here: http://on.basf.com/VerguetungBASFSE Flexible working hours - depending on the location and area of work HOW TO REACH US Tina Le (Talent Acquisition), tina.le@basf.com, Tel.: +49 30 2005-56367 will be happy to answer your questions about this position. You can also book an online appointment . You can also reach our recruiting team here . You can find initial information on our application process here . The selection process includes a background check of the last diploma obtained and a criminal record certificate. Please submit the required documents only after our request. ABOUT US BASF SE, based in Ludwigshafen am Rhein, is the corporate headquarters of the BASF Group and part of the Rhine-Neckar metropolitan economic area. BASF has stood for competence in chemistry since 1865 and today is represented in the world's major consumer markets with a wide range of products. jobs.description: Job Description: In the Philippines, BASF has been supporting manufacturers from various industries since 1963. jobs.name: Account Manager Glysantin DACH (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF As a European distribution organization of the BASF Group, BTC Europe sells highly-refined specialty and fine chemicals to international customers in numerous industries. We capitalize on our proximity to our customers, agility, many years of expertise and the accumulated know-how of the BASF Verbund. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT We are looking for a field account manager for the DACH sales region to start as soon as possible, with a 100% remote work arrangement. A company car will be provided. In your new position, you manage and grow customer relationships in the Automotive Fluids Independent Aftermarket, focusing on coolant/antifreeze and brake fluid products. Your expertise is asked for when negotiating contracts and steering technical and commercial projects with customers and internal teams. Together with your colleagues, you actively acquire new customers and business opportunities, driving cross-selling and price management initiatives. Not least, you represent BTC at industry events and fairs, ensuring visibility and collaboration with BASF counterparts. Furthermore, you contribute to digitalization initiatives and support the development of industry-specific strategies within local and European teams. WHAT YOU OFFER technical professional training in a relevant area or completed master’s degree in business or STEM fields several years of professional experience in automotive fluids technologies and aftermarket sales strong knowledge in contract negotiations, account planning, and customer relationship management, ideally with Salesforce experience fluent German and advanced English skills, plus confident use of IT tools and MS Office applications proactive team player with excellent communication skills, intercultural competence, and a growth-driven mindset willingness to travel WHAT WE OFFER 100% home office company car inspiring networks for developing and implementing your own ideas (e.g., Women in Business) mentoring programs and learning opportunities for your professional and personal development career paths for professional growth, including opportunities to move into other roles within the company 30 vacation days, plus options for special leave and sabbatical models flexible working time arrangements (e.g., part-time employment) an attractive salary, based on business success and your individual performance bicycle leasing options HOW TO REACH US Svenja Sollmann (Talent Acquisition), svenja.sollmann@basf.com, Tel.:+49 30 2005-59355 will be happy to answer your questions for this position. jobs.name: EHS Specialist III
jobs.description: Now hiring! EHS Specialist III Malcom, IA (On Site) We are looking for an EHS Specialist III to join our Performance Materials team in Malcom. Come create chemistry with us! The Performance Materials division is at the forefront of the much-needed sustainability transformation in plastics. Our experts co-create products with customers to bring innovations to major industry sectors such as transportation, consumer goods, industrial applications, and construction.These solutions contribute to a sustainable future by pushing the boundaries in thermal resistance, robustness and lightweight applications. Your primary responsibilities will include ensuring compliance with all federal, state, and local regulations related to environmental protection, hazardous waste management, and spill prevention, as well as adhering to BASF's internal standards, such as Responsible Care®. You will play a crucial role in enhancing our site programs to maintain our license to operate while fostering a culture of safety and compliance among all personnel.  In addition, you will lead our site security initiatives, identifying and mitigating security risks to uphold and optimize our security standards. As a key member of the site leadership team, you will collaborate closely with the site manager and contribute to the overall success of the Malcom site.  You will also be an integral part of the BASF EHS community, working alongside EHS experts across the organization and reporting directly to the EHS Director for Performance Materials North America. As an EHS Specialist III, you create chemistry by... Leveraging your effective communication skills to develop strong working relationships with employees, the EHS community, and regulatory agencies/third parties, serving as a positive change agent within the organization. Utilizing your knowledge of Occupational Safety, Industrial Hygiene, and Environmental disciplines to develop and maintain EHS programs, policies, and procedures for the site. Drawing upon your experience in Occupational Safety, Industrial Hygiene, Environmental management, and Emergency Response program management in a manufacturing environment to lead and participate in risk assessments, accurately addressing identified deficiencies. Providing guidance - both tactically and strategically- to site leadership on critical EHS issues, ensuring adherence to corporate EHS policies and procedures, including the Responsible Care® Management Systems. Creating training content and, where appropriate, delivering training or coaching, facilitating the sharing of programs, procedures, tools, and best practices across the BASF EHS organization. Prioritizing opportunities and issues to drive the continuous improvement of EHS processes and systems. Utilizing your strong organizational skills to identify and monitor key performance indicators within your area of responsibility, making necessary adjustments to improve EHS performance. Leading and participating in project reviews, process hazard analyses, and change management processes, ensuring all internal and external reporting requirements are met through your solid analytical and computer skills. Being a role model and collaborating with hourly employees to reinforce a culture of behavior-based safety and support emergency response activities. Working with and traveling to other sites to evaluate audit readiness and share best practices Leading and/or participating in EHS work teams and/or task forces If you have... A Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Science, or a related field. Two (2) years of experience in an industrial/manufacturing environment Ability to work independently under broad goals and objectives with minimal guidance. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Experience with Environmental Reporting and Safety Management Systems strongly preferred Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF . We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us As one of the largest chemical companies in North America we have been finding solutions for your everyday needs and addressing the most complex economic, environmental, and sustainability challenges for more than 150 years! At BASF we empower our employees with the tools, guidance and opportunities they need to advance and succeed in work and life. Giving you the support you need to be your best and fulfill your personal ambitions is what helps us create chemistry. After all, our success is linked to yours. Whatever path you envision, BASF is a great place to build a rewarding, successful career. Belong to Something Bigger. #belongatBASF Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. If you have experienced any of the above, please contact Careers.NorthAmerica@basf.com to report fraud. Equal employment opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

jobs.description:
Ubicación Madrid WELCOME TO THE TEAM If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. Please do not be confused by this: All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application will be submitted to us. At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships. We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable backend services that support and enhance our internal and external applications. Work in an agile, self‑organized team and collaborate effectively with colleagues. Develop new backend functionality using Java and Spring Boot, following modern backend engineering principles and best practices. Maintain and improve existing backend services, ensuring performance, reliability, and long‑term maintainability. Design, implement, and evolve RESTful APIs and service interfaces to enable seamless integration with frontend applications and other systems. Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code in line with team coding standards and industry best practices. Contribute actively to planning, refinement, reviews, operations, and continuous improvement activities within the team. Collaborate closely with frontend developers to ensure smooth data flows, clear API contracts, and consistent end‑to‑end behavior. Implement and maintain unit, integration, and component tests to ensure high quality, stability, and regression prevention. Share responsibility for operations and maintenance as part of the team’s DevOps mindset, including monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous optimization. (Nice to have) Show interest in frontend technologies such as Angular and full‑stack development, with opportunities to collaborate across the stack if desired. WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or comparable practical experience. Around 3-5 years of professional experience with Java (≥ 21) and building backend applications in production environments Strong hands‑on experience with Spring Boot (3.x) and core Spring modules such as Spring Data, Spring Integration, Spring Batch, and Spring Security Solid understanding of persistence technologies, including JPA 2 / Hibernate, and designing robust data access layers. Experience designing, implementing, and maintaining RESTful APIs for microservice‑based systems. Good knowledge of SQL databases, ideally PostgreSQL, including data modeling and query optimization. Experience writing unit and integration tests (e.g., JUnit or similar frameworks) to ensure code quality and stability. Familiarity with microservice and cloud architectures, including service communication and API‑based integration. Experience working with containerization technologies such as Docker; exposure to Kubernetes is a plus. Proficiency with JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA or comparable Java IDEs. Familiarity with agile methodologies (Scrum or Kanban) and working in agile development teams. Strong communication skills in Spanish and English, both verbal and written. WHAT WE OFFER Continuous training and professional development with our internal vacancies. Safe environment where we promote your health. Restaurant ticket. Competitive economic offer with a base salary plus a variable for good performance. Hybrid model of work and adapt your schedule according to your circumstances. Connect outside the office and practice sports with colleagues through company groups. Flexible remuneration that you can voluntarily allocate to transportation services, training, childcare, etc. Pension plans, life and accident insurance, personal loans and participation in company stock programs. Financial aid for schooling and other measures for families. HOW TO PARTICIPATE IN THE PROCESS Send your CV in English through the job offer so we can get to know each other. If your profile matches, we will call you from the Spanish Talent Acquisition team in Germany (prefix +49) and support you throughout the process. With each step, you will be closer to meeting your future team! Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief. Hasta el 1 de julio, nuestra empresa formaba parte de BASF. Como parte de la transición actual, todas las ofertas de empleo y el proceso de solicitud siguen alojados en la plataforma de BASF y, por tanto, se presentan íntegramente bajo la imagen corporativa de BASF. Por favor, no te confundas por ello: todas las vacantes corresponden a puestos en Surventis y tu candidatura será enviada directamente a nosotros. En Surventis, vamos más allá de la superficie en todo lo que hacemos. Ponemos a los clientes en el centro, nos anticipamos a las necesidades y desarrollamos soluciones que generan valor real y relaciones duraderas. Nos inspiramos mutuamente para ir más allá, asumir la responsabilidad de nuestro trabajo y nos esforzarnos continuamente por ampliar los límites de lo posible. Si aportas tu mejor versión, cuestionas las respuestas evidentes y quieres crecer junto a un equipo que realmente cree en ello, este es tu lugar. LO QUE PUEDES ESPERAR En nuestra unidad Digital Solutions & IT Architecture, EC/XD, desarrollamos conceptos y soluciones de TI para nuestro negocio global de recubrimientos y superficies. Impulsamos soluciones innovadoras, garantizamos procesos integrales sin interrupciones e identificamos las mejores prácticas globales para nuestras ubicaciones. Tu rol consistirá en: Definir o seleccionar la implementación técnicamente óptima de los procesos de FI y AP, con un enfoque inicial en un proyecto global de procesamiento de facturas. Asumir la responsabilidad técnica de las interfaces con sistemas satélite. Colaborar estrechamente con los Global y Regional Process Owners de EC/XD y con los equipos de digitalización de Controlling y Finanzas. Contribuir al diseño del futuro modelo de arquitectura independiente de FI y AP e implementar estándares de calidad. Diseño e implementación de soluciones SAP, abarcando customizing , desarrollo y integración en paisajes de sistemas existentes, en estrecha colaboración con socios técnicos de implementación. En las operaciones diarias, brindar soporte de segundo nivel a los Application Managed Services, analizando incidentes críticos en el sistema productivo. LO QUE NECESITAMOS DE TI Título Universitario en Informática Empresarial, Ciencias de la Computación o Administración de Empresas con enfoque en TI. Conocimientos profundos de paisajes de TI, especialmente personalización y programación en los módulos SAP (S/4HANA) FI & CO. Al menos 2 años de experiencia en un rol similar, usando métodos y herramientas para la descripción de interfaces y arquitectura de datos. Se valorará experiencia de varios años en proyectos globales de TI. Habilidades sólidas de comunicación y presentación en inglés y español. Capacidad analítica y gusto por el trabajo en equipo para lograr resultados óptimos con socios internos y externos. LO QUE OFRECEMOS Formación continua y desarrollo profesional con nuestras vacantes internas. Entorno seguro y donde promovemos tu salud. Ticket restaurante. Oferta económica competitiva con un salario base más un variable por buen desempeño. Trabajar en remoto y adaptar tus horarios, según tus circunstancias. Conectar fuera de la oficina y practicar deportes con compañeros/as mediante Grupos de empresa. Retribución flexible que puedes destinar voluntariamente a servicios de transporte, formación, guardería, etc. Planes de pensiones, seguro de vida y accidentes, préstamos personales y participar en programa de acciones de la compañía. Ayudas económicas para la escolarización y otras medidas para las familias. CÓMO PARTICIPAR EN EL PROCESO Envía tu CV en inglés a través de la oferta para poder conocernos. Si tu perfil encaja, te llamaremos desde el equipo español de Talent Acquisition en Alemania (prefijo +49) y te acompañaremos en el proceso. ¡Con cada paso estarás más cerca de conocer a tu futuro equipo! jobs.name: Senior PKI Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description: ABOUT US At BASF Digital Hub Madrid we develop innovative digital solutions for BASF, create new exciting customer experiences and business growth, and drive efficiencies in processes, helping to strengthen BASF´s position as the digital leader in the chemical industry. We believe the right path is through creativity, trial and error and great people working and learning together. Become part of our team and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities. Digitalization will be a true part of BASF’s DNA that creates new exciting customer experiences and business growth as well as drives efficiencies in processes. This is our digital VISION for BASF. Global Digital Services (GDS) is supporting BASF business in Digitalization transformation. Our MISSION is to drive forward the digital transformation of BASF, providing innovative, global and high-quality digital products and services through a strong agile culture. The product family Cyber Engineering & IAM Solutions enables the business to operate securely by ensuring consistent security measures and maintaining a unified defense through reliable, standardized engineering practices. As a product team of this family, the Certificate Management team is a key enabler for Information Security by managing cryptographic keys and digital certificates. It operates and continuously enhances the trust anchor systems Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), Hardware Security Module (HSM) and Key Management System (KMS) incl. provisioning of TLS certificates by a Cloud service. RESPONSIBILITIES As a team member of the Certificate Management team, you will be part of a team delivering global IT services in an agile set-up with the following main tasks: Configuration and operation of Windows- and Linux-based certificate lifecycle solutions (PKI). Creation and customization of processes for certificate lifecycle management. Configuration and operation of key management systems and hardware security modules. Focus on automation and standardization of the respective use cases, you are responsible for. Troubleshooting, ticket handling & Change Management QUALIFICATIONS Completed Master’s degree or comparable in the field of IT, e.g. Cyber Security, Informatics/ Computer Science, Mathematics Minimum of 5 years of relevant work experience in the environment of PKI/CA and/or cryptography Powershell-Scripting, Repository Management over Github, General-Scripting (Azure DevOps) Strong commitment, fast comprehension & Innovative thinking skills Agile Development & Growth Mindset Problem Solving & Analytical Thinking English proficiency required Nice to have: Knowledge in working with Thales Safenet HSMs and/or Nexus PKI BENEFITS A secure work environment because your health, safety and wellbeing is always our top priority. Flexible work schedule and Home-office options, so that you can balance your working life and private life. Learning and development opportunities 25 holiday days per year 5 additional days (readjustment) A collaborative, trustful and innovative work environment Being part of an international team and work in global projects Relocation assistance to Madrid provided At BASF, the chemistry is right. Because we are counting on innovative solutions, sustainable actions, connected thinking and on you, become a part of our formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief. At BASF, we are committed to upholding and ensuring compliance with company standards related to quality, environment, health, safety, and energy, in line with our global guidelines. We actively promote a culture of prevention and continuous improvement, encouraging collaboration in initiatives related to quality, environmental protection, health, safety, and energy performance. We foster responsible energy use, promoting efficiency in daily operations and supporting the identification of improvement projects and energy-saving opportunities. Contact Do you have any questions about the application process or the position? Please reach out to Felipe Bianco ( felipe.bianco@partners.basf.com )

jobs.name: Manufacturing Operator
jobs.description: Now hiring! Manufacturing Operator Sparks, Georgia Starting pay at $18. You will work 14 out of 28 days in 12-hour rotating shifts. You will get shift differential (increase in pay) when rotating to night shift. $500.00 Signing bonus : $250 after 30 days, $250 after 60 days from hire date. Full benefits package available including 401K. We are looking for a Manufacturing Operator to join our Agricultural Solutions team in Sparks, GA. Come create chemistry with us! BASF's Agricultural Solutions division connects innovation, customers, partners and agricultural experts and integrates sustainability criteria into all business decisions. We help farmers deliver the best possible outcomes, working to achieve the balance between economic, environmental and social value creation for sustainable and efficient agriculture. As a Manufacturing Operator, you will measure and batch raw materials to ensure product quality, safely operate batching equipment, and comply with all regulations. You will maintain batch records, complete daily checklists, and update shift activity boards while adhering to safety policies and participating in safety meetings. During your 12-hour rotating shifts as a Manufacturing Operator, you will Measure and batch raw materials in accordance with precise Manufacturing guidelines and procedures so the product meets customer specifications. Safely operate equipment associated with batching operations including pumps, motors, mills, tanks, ventilation systems, control panels. Operate processing equipment in compliance with company training and all federal, state, and local regulations. Maintain batch records, complete daily checklists, update shift activity boards. Always adhere to established safety, health and environmental policies and procedures, including participating in Safety meetings. If you... Earned a HS Diploma or GED . Have at least 2 years of experience in a Manufacturing facility or have work skills that may transfer to a Manufacturing environment. Are open to a 12-hour rotating day/night shifts. Can perform physical activities such as bending and climbing stairs. Are willing to wear the necessary Personal Protection Equipment, such as, hard hats, gloves, goggles, masks & sometimes respirators to ensure safety precautions are met. Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF . We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us As one of the largest chemical companies in North America we have been finding solutions for your everyday needs and addressing the most complex economic, environmental, and sustainability challenges for more than 150 years! At BASF we empower our employees with the tools, guidance and opportunities they need to advance and succeed in work and life. Giving you the support you need to be your best and fulfill your personal ambitions is what helps us create chemistry. After all, our success is linked to yours. Whatever path you envision, BASF is a great place to build a rewarding, successful career. Belong to Something Bigger. #belongatBASF Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. If you have experienced any of the above, please contact myhr@basf.com to report fraud. Equal employment opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

jobs.description: About The Role: Process Invoice to Cash (ITC) daily task and support prepare necessary ITC KPIs reporting Support in generate relevant audit documents or reports for Year-End and perform customer reconciliation per request from Auditor or customers and engagement with various business units Delivering high levels of customer service to both internal and external stakeholders Performing other relevant support activities as and when require. About You: Currently pursuing Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance & Business Able to commit 6 months internship. Proficient in oral and written English Proficient in Microsoft Excel and Power Point A good team player with high level of maturity and independence Willing to work at Mercu Aspire, Bangsar (next to Abdullah Hukum LRT station) BASF has been present in Malaysia since 1989, and operates a manufacturing plant in Pasir Gudang, Johor. BASF’s Regional Service Hub in Kuala Lumpur provides functional support services to BASF companies in 20 markets across Asia Pacific. BASF also provides infrastructure and utilities support services to its joint ventures BASF PETRONAS Chemicals and Toray BASF Resins at an integrated Verbund site situated in the Gebeng Industrial Zone, Pahang. BASF posted sales to customers in Malaysia of approximately €340 million in 2024 and had 2,579 employees as of the end of the year. Further information is available on www.basf.com/my

jobs.name: Project Lead Strategy Consulting (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF Welcome to the global management consultancy of BASF! We focus on strategic projects that drive the effective transformation of our businesses. Our teams work on a broad range of topics such as sustainability, organizational development, efficiency projects, M&A, and profitable growth through all types of innovation. We put people first: We are proud of our strong team spirit, and we cherish diversity. Become part of a great international team where your hands-on approach and desire to leave an impact are truly valued. Together, let’s create new ideas and offer the best solutions to our customers. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT As Project Lead (m/f/d) you collaborate with colleagues on complex strategy consulting projects and provide impactful solutions for businesses and functions across BASF. You identify potential improvements in each project and advise the management team competently and empathetically. From Day 1, you apply your skills and contribute your ideas to ongoing projects. You communicate clearly and openly with all parties involved throughout all project phases. Our end-to-end consulting services allow you to accompany a project from start to finish. You enjoy top management visibility by working with BASF Executives globally on a wide range of strategic high-priority projects with sustainable impact. Our projects cover the fields of Innovation & Growth, Marketing & Sales, Organizational Excellence, and Post-Merger Integration/Carve Out. For an overview about our practice groups see here . WHAT YOU OFFER professional experience in strategic consulting and project work in a (global) strategy consulting firm depending on your qualifications and professional experience, you start as Project Leader (3-5 years) or Senior Project Leader (5-7 years) proven expertise in project management methods as well as consulting methodologies and approaches excellent communication skills in English; German is a plus convincing and competent behavior in client interactions open-minded and inclusive attitude, reliable team player international work experience is a plus WHAT WE OFFER Attractive location: Your work location is in Monheim (near Düsseldorf), the administrative headquarters of BASF Personal Care & Nutrition GmbH. The Monheim office has a canteen and modern, flexible workspaces designed to accommodate various teams and functions. Hybrid Work: You can combine remote work with up to 3 office days. Regular visits of our headquarters in Ludwigshafen are required, e.g. for monthly team days or unit events. Depending on the project/client, journeys to other BASF sites may be necessary as well. Work-Life-Balance: We offer access to childcare providers, flexible working time models, and cooperations with fitness and health studios, along with numerous other (preventive) offers for your mental and physical health. Personal Growth: We provide a comprehensive training program tailored to your needs. Our unit has a successful track record in employee career development: former team members can be found at all hierarchy levels at BASF globally. Individual support for your professional development is part of our mission. Perks: An attractive salary and a variable bonus, employee stock options, the possibility of special leave, 30 days of paid vacation, canteens with freshly cooked food, job bike, social counselling, and many others. HOW TO REACH US Jennifer Weiz (Talent Acquisition), jennifer.weiz@basf.com, Tel.: +49 30 2005-56454 will be happy to answer your questions for this position You can also reach our recruiting team here First information about our application process can be found here ABOUT US Moisturizing creams, mild shampoos, strong styling gels, glossy lipsticks and protective sunscreens – all of these products contain ingredients made by BASF Personal Care and Nutrition GmbH, a BASF subsidiary. Using natural, renewable raw materials, we develop and produce a large range of ingredients for the personal care sector. Learn more about BASF Personal Care and Nutrition GmbH at on.basf.com/ECareandNutrition Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

Wir konzentrieren uns auf strategische Projekte, die die effektive Transformation unserer Geschäfte vorantreiben. Unsere Teams arbeiten an einem breiten Spektrum von Themen wie Nachhaltigkeit, Organisationsentwicklung, Effizienzprojekte, M&A und profitables Wachstum durch alle Arten von Innovation. Wir stellen die Menschen in den Mittelpunkt: Wir sind stolz auf unseren starken Teamgeist und schätzen Vielfalt. Werden Sie Teil eines großartigen internationalen Teams, in dem Ihr praxisorientierter Ansatz und der Wunsch, einen Einfluss zu hinterlassen, wirklich geschätzt werden. Lassen Sie uns gemeinsam neue Ideen entwickeln und die besten Lösungen für unsere Kunden anbieten. WAS SIE ERWARTET Bei uns können Sie als Project Lead (m/w/d) die Zukunft der BASF beeinflussen, indem Sie effektive Empfehlungen und nachhaltige Lösungen für unsere Führungskräfte bereitstellen. Hands-On-Mentalität: Vom ersten Tag an setzen Sie Ihr Fachwissen in der System- und Managementberatung ein, um Change-Prozesse erfolgreich zu gestalten. Klarheit und Orientierung: Sie spezifizieren die Auswirkungen von Veränderungen und leiten Strategien für organisatorische und kulturelle Projekte ab. Einfluss: Sie unterstützen die Führungskräfte und die Organisation bei der Umsetzung wirksamer Veränderungsmaßnahmen. Auf der Grundlage unseres umfassenden End-to-End-Serviceangebots begleiten Sie ein Projekt von Anfang bis Ende. Sichtbarkeit: Sie konzipieren Change-Management-Maßnahmen und führen Interventionen durch, z. B. große Gruppenveranstaltungen und Workshops mit Managementteams. jobs.name: (Senior) Specialist External Reporting (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture. #ForTheLoveOfFarming#TheBiggestJobOnEarth#AgEmployerOfChoice Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions! WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT We in Agricultural Solutions are preparing to be an independent, pure-play agricultural company within BASF group. To be ready for independence, we are looking for you to join us in our new Corporate roles (see here: build your career on our Standalone Transformation ). In this role you take ownership of the preparation and publication of the Group’s external financial reports, including annual and interim financial statements, the management report (“Lagebericht”) and regulatory filings, ensuring full compliance with IFRS and internal reporting standards. Your expertise is in demand as you manage and further develop the disclosure tool, prepare and review notes and disclosures, and ensure full alignment with consolidated figures, accounting policies and applicable reporting requirements. You ensure that group accounting policies and IFRS interpretations defined by Accounting Governance / IFRS are consistently applied and accurately reflected throughout all external reporting outputs. You translate complex accounting topics into clear, compliant and decision‑useful disclosures, particularly in areas requiring significant judgment such as business combinations, impairments, provisions and equity‑related matters. You act as the primary point of contact for external auditors on reporting‑related matters, coordinating audit requests, discussions and deliverables while explaining reporting judgments and presentation decisions. You also participate in cross‑functional projects (e.g., reorganizations, carve‑outs, acquisitions) with a focus on accounting, external reporting and governance implications. Last but not least, you collaborate closely with colleagues from Consolidation, Accounting, Legal, Tax, Treasury, ESG and Investor Relations to orchestrate inputs, ensure consistent messaging and deliver high‑quality, complete and transparent external reporting results. WHAT YOU OFFER Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting or a related field at least 5 years of experience in external reporting, audit or related areas, ideally within an IFRS environment dealing with complex accounting topics; leadership experience is an advantage strong knowledge of IFRS‑based external financial reporting and a solid understanding of end‑to‑end reporting processes including closings, disclosure preparation and publication cycles in a group environment strong analytical and drafting skills to translate complex technical accounting matters into clear, accurate and audit‑ready disclosures, with the ability to appropriately address judgment‑heavy topics in the financial statements proven digital and AI focus with the ability to leverage modern technologies and data-driven approaches to enhance efficiency and quality excellent English skills as well as solid familiarity with SAP ERP, disclosure tools and common MS Office applications clear communication and effective stakeholder management skills, acting with confidence when interacting with auditors and cross‑functional finance teams WHAT WE OFFER A dynamic work environment that empowers you to contribute your ideas, take ownership, and assume responsibility. A strong focus on continuous learning, modern technologies, and the responsible use of artificial intelligence, enabling us to work in a future‑oriented, efficient, and sustainable way while actively driving innovation. Inspiring networks for the development and implementation of your ideas (e.g. Women in Business). Learning opportunities for your professional and personal development. Career paths as professional development into other roles within the company. We actively support with childcare (e.g. company daycare, holiday programmes) and provide a f itness and health studio as well as a medical center with numerous offers for your health. We offer sustainable mobility benefits — a discounted Deutschlandticket for regional public transport, a job‑bike leasing program, and on‑site e‑charging stations for private electric vehicles to make your commute affordable, healthy, and climate‑friendly. HOW TO REACH US Isabel Maisack (Talent Acquisition), isabel.maisack@basf.com, Tel.:+49 30 2005-56683 will be happy to answer your questions for this position. You are also welcome to book an appointment online. Technical questions cannot be answered at this meeting. You can also reach our recruiting team here First information about our application process can be found here ABOUT US BASF Agricultural Solutions Deutschland GmbH is a reliable partner to the agricultural sector, offering innovative and sustainable solutions tailored to a wide range of crop systems. With the Agricultural Center in Limburgerhof, near the BASF Group headquarters in Ludwigshafen, you’ll find an attractive environment for both your professional life and your leisure time in the Rhine‑Neckar metropolitan region. You can learn more about the Agricultural Center in Limburgerhof here . Find out more about our Agricultural Solutions team here Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

Wenn du in der Schule Spaß an Mathematik, Englisch und wirtschaftlichen Zusammenhängen hast und du dich zudem für fremde Kulturen interessierst, dann bist du in der internationalen Wirtschaftsinformatik richtig! Denn so vielfältig und anspruchsvoll wie deine Interessen sind, so ist auch dein Studium. Du erlernst die wichtigsten Grundlagen in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Softwareentwicklung oder aktuellen Themen der IT, genauso wie in BWL, VWL, Mathe und Statistik. Außerdem absolvierst du verschiedene Praxiseinsätze, z. B. in den Bereichen Projekt- und Informationsmanagement sowie Controlling, Einkauf, Marketing oder Vertrieb. Dabei lernst du, Antworten auf betriebswirtschaftliche Fragestellungen mit den passenden IT-Systemen zu finden. Viele spannende Erfahrungen in einer der Zukunftsbranchen warten auf dich! DAS LERNST DU WÄHREND DEINES DUALEN STUDIUMS du erlernst die wichtigsten Grundlagen in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Softwareentwicklung oder aktuellen Themen der IT, genauso wie in BWL, VWL, Mathe und Statistik in den vorlesungsfreien Phasen absolvierst du verschiedene Praxiseinsätze, z. B. in den Bereichen Projekt- und Informationsmanagement sowie Controlling, Einkauf, Marketing oder Vertrieb. Dabei arbeitest du an spannenden Themen oder in zukunftsorientierten Projekten mit deine internationalen Kompetenzen erweiterst du durch Fremdsprachenunterricht in Englisch und profitierst von einem hohen Anteil an englischsprachigen Vorlesungen internationaler Gastdozenten du sammelst wertvolle Auslandserfahrung durch einen Studienaufenthalt an einer renommierten Partneruniversität im Ausland (Organisation und Kosten werden von BASF übernommen) auf dich warten maßgeschneiderte Schulungsangebote in Form von Seminaren, Workshops und Veranstaltungen zum Weiterentwickeln deiner persönlichen Fähigkeiten und Fremdsprachenkompetenz du lernst und studierst in kleinen Gruppen und genießt individuelle Betreuung durch eine:n feste:n Ansprechpartner:in über die komplette Studienzeit DAS BRINGST DU MIT mindestens eine gute, vollständige Fachhochschulreife sehr gute bis gute Mathe- und Englischkenntnisse Begeisterung für Informatik und aktuelle IT-Themen sowie für internationale wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge hohe Zuverlässigkeit, Verantwortungsbewusstsein, sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit und Eigeninitiative analytisches Denken und Interesse an Daten und Zahlen Spaß am Arbeiten in internationalen Projektteams und bei der Beratung in- und externer Kunden und Geschäftspartner DAS BIETEN WIR IN DEINEM DUALEN STUDIUM ein spannendes duales Studium in einem der weltweit führenden Chemieunternehmen in Kooperation mit der Hochschule für Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft Ludwigshafen du erwirbst 210 Credits im Intensivstudiengang sowie zusätzliche Master-Credits, die du dir ggf. auf einen Anschlussmaster anrechnen lassen kannst gute Übernahmechancen bei entsprechenden Leistungen attraktive Vergütung - du startest mit 1247 Euro pro Monat im 1. Als Expert:in für die Schnittstelle zwischen Unternehmen, Anwendern und IT pushst du deine Karriere als Ideenentwickler:in. Arbeite mit unseren Forschern an der Gewinnung neuer Erkenntnisse und führe Versuche in den Bereichen der Grundlagenforschung, des Pflanzenschutzes und der Diagnostik durch. Hier zeigen wir dir auch, wie du toxikologische Untersuchungen an Tieren planst und den Vorgaben des Tierschutzgesetzes entsprechend durchführst. Dabei suchen wir stets nach Alternativmethoden, um die gesetzlich geforderten Versuche zu verbessern oder zu ersetzen. DAS LERNST DU WÄHREND DEINER AUSBILDUNG • Planen und Durchführen von Versuchen in den Bereichen der Molekularbiologie, Mikrobiologie, Biochemie, Biotechnologie, des Pflanzenschutzes und in vielen anderen wissenschaftlichen Arbeitsgebieten • Planen und Durchführen von toxikologischen Untersuchungen an Tieren unter Berücksichtigung der jeweiligen Gesetzgebung • Untersuchen von biologischen Materialien mit modernen Analysegeräten • Dokumentieren und statistisches Auswerten von Versuchsergebnissen • Anwenden von deutsch- und englischsprachigen Vorschriften DAS BRINGST DU MIT • mindestens eine gute Mittlere Reife • Interesse an Biologie, Chemie und Mathematik sowie Spaß am Untersuchen, Beobachten, Messen und Dokumentieren • sicheres Farbsehvermögen und keine Allergien gegenüber tierischen und pflanzlichen Bestandteilen oder Staub • Bereitschaft zur Durchführung von Tierversuchen unter Einhaltung des Tierschutzgesetzes • Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Genauigkeit und Sorgfalt beim Arbeiten • gute Englischkenntnisse DAS BIETEN WIR IN DEINER AUSBILDUNG • eine spannende Ausbildung im weltweit führenden Chemieunternehmen in Kooperation mit der BBS Naturwissenschaft in Ludwigshafen • maßgeschneiderte Schulungsangebote sowie die Möglichkeit zur Teilnahme an EU-Austauschprojekten • attraktive Vergütung – du startest mit 1147 Euro pro Monat im 1. Ausbildungsjahr • zahlreiche Zusatzleistungen: Jahresprämie, Erfolgsbeteiligung, 700 Euro Urlaubsgeld, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Teilnahme am BASF Aktienprogramm, Tablet, Essensgeldzuschuss, Zuschuss Jobticket • 30 Tage Urlaub und 37,5 Stunden-Woche • Freizeit- und Fitnessangebote sowie Mitarbeiterevents • Wohnmöglichkeiten für Azubis von weiter weg • Verkürzung der Ausbildung um ein halbes Jahr bei besonders guten Leistungen möglich • gute Übernahmechancen bei entsprechenden Leistungen AUSBILDUNG GESCHAFFT - WAS DANN ? jobs.name: (Senior) Project Manager Supply Chain Consulting (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF Welcome to the global management consultancy of BASF! We focus on strategic projects that drive the effective transformation of our businesses. Our teams work on a broad range of topics such as sustainability, organizational development, efficiency projects, M&A, and profitable growth through all types of innovation. We put people first: We are proud of our strong team spirit, and we cherish diversity. Become part of a great international team where your hands-on approach and desire to leave an impact are truly valued. Together, let’s create new ideas and offer the best solutions to our customers. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT As a Project Managing Consultant, you make a real difference for the future of BASF by providing innovative solutions and effective recommendations to BASF's leaders. Our internal customers include the entire value chain of BASF from base chemicals to specialties, each with their unique requirements. You will be focusing on the topics of sustainability, end-to-end supply chain processes, automation & digitalization initiatives and complexity management. End to end project leadership: You lead high impact supply chain consulting engagements from initial problem structuring and value case design through solution development and implementation planning. CORE value chain focus: You drive transformations in large scale, cost critical chemical and consumer care–relevant value chains, with emphasis on planning, S&OP, logistics, inventory, and network optimization. Senior stakeholder engagement: You act as a trusted sparring partner for senior leaders and project sponsors, communicating clearly, fact based, and with a strong value orientation. AI enabled consulting: You leverage advanced analytics and AI supported tools (e.g. scenario modeling, planning analytics, process mining, decision support solutions) to accelerate insights, improve decision quality, and increase consulting impact. Capability building: You coach and develop consultants in modern consulting methods, digital and AI capabilities, and BASF Winning Ways behaviors, ensuring sustainable adoption in the organization. Thought leadership: You continuously monitor external trends and internal priorities to develop new methodologies and scalable solutions for BASF’s future supply chain challenges. WHAT YOU OFFER several years of professional experience in supply chain consulting or transformation roles, ideally in CORE chemical, consumer care, or asset intensive industries proven expertise in areas such as supply chain strategy, planning, S&OP, cost optimization, inventory management, or logistics strong strategic thinker with a hands on, data driven mindset and experience leading teams and complex stakeholder environments exposure to advanced analytics, AI supported planning, or digital supply chain solutions is a strong advantage excellent proficiency in English, good German skills and international work experience are a plus high level of ownership, curiosity, and entrepreneurial drive, aligned with BASF Winning Ways WHAT WE OFFER Attractive location: Your work location is in Monheim (near Düsseldorf), the administrative headquarters of BASF Personal Care & Nutrition GmbH. The Monheim office has a canteen and modern, flexible workspaces designed to accommodate various teams and functions. Hybrid Work: You can combine remote work with up to 3 office days. Regular visits of our headquarters in Ludwigshafen are required, e.g. for monthly team days or unit events. Depending on the project/client, journeys to other BASF sites may be necessary as well. Work-Life-Balance: We offer access to childcare providers, flexible working time models, and cooperations with fitness and health studios, along with numerous other (preventive) offers for your mental and physical health. Personal Growth: We provide a comprehensive training program tailored to your needs. Our unit has a successful track record in employee career development: former team members can be found at all hierarchy levels at BASF globally. Individual support for your professional development is part of our mission. Perks : An attractive salary and a variable bonus, employee stock options, the possibility of special leave, 30 days of paid vacation, canteens with freshly cooked food, job bike, social counselling, and many others. HOW TO REACH US Jennifer Weiz (Talent Acquisition), jennifer.weiz@basf.com, Tel.: +49 30 2005-56454 will be happy to answer your questions for this position You can also reach our recruiting team here First information about our application process can be found here ABOUT US Moisturizing creams, mild shampoos, strong styling gels, glossy lipsticks and protective sunscreens – all of these products contain ingredients made by BASF Personal Care and Nutrition GmbH, a BASF subsidiary. Using natural, renewable raw materials, we develop and produce a large range of ingredients for the personal care sector. Learn more about BASF Personal Care and Nutrition GmbH at on.basf.com/ECareandNutrition Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.name: Production Manager
jobs.description: O bjectives of the Position Responsible in managing daily production operations to ensure timely, safe, and high-quality production of products, while also focusing on training production personnel, optimizing procedures, and ensuring compliance. Main Responsibilities Ensure all environmental, health and safety rules and guidelines are fully adhered and maintaining high safety standards for a safe working environment. Plan, organize, and manage daily production activities to ensure that production schedules and target quantities are met. Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Production Superintendent, Production Supervisors, Boardmen and technicians fostering a culture of teamwork and accountability. Conduct periodic training, performance evaluations, provide feedback, and identify training needs for team members (including succession planning for roles Boardman and above). Facilitate effective communication within the production team and across departments. Perform internal audits to support ISO9001, ISO14001 and ISO 50001 standards. Implement and uphold quality control measures to maintain product quality requirements and consistency within production team. Coordinate production trials, test and implement recommendations from Toray to improve plant operation and product quality as and when required (via MOC process). Job Requirements Bachelor’s degree in chemical engineering, Polymer Engineering, Materials Science, or a related field At least 7 years of experience in production management within a manufacturing environment, preferably in polymerization and distillation processes. Technical & Professional Knowledge Proven experience leading teams and managing production operations. Strong communication skills, both verbal and written (English & Bahasa Malaysia) Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities. A proactive and results-oriented mindset with a focus on continuous improvement. Commitment to fostering a positive and inclusive workplace culture. About BASF in Malaysia BASF has been present in Malaysia since 1989, and operates a manufacturing plant in Pasir Gudang, Johor. BASF’s Regional Service Hub in Kuala Lumpur provides functional support services to BASF companies in 20 markets across Asia Pacific. BASF also provides infrastructure and utilities support services to its joint ventures BASF PETRONAS Chemicals and Toray BASF Resins at an integrated Verbund site situated in the Gebeng Industrial Zone, Pahang. BASF posted sales to customers in Malaysia of approximately €340 million in 2024 and had 2,579 employees as of the end of the year. Further information is available on www.basf.com/my

Tot 1 juli maakte onze organisatie deel uit van BASF. In het kader van de huidige overgang worden alle vacatures en het sollicitatieproces nog steeds gehost op het BASF‑platform en daarom volledig in BASF‑huisstijl weergegeven. Laat je hier niet door verwarren: alle functies zijn posities bij Surventis en jouw sollicitatie wordt bij ons ingediend. Bij Surventis kijken we een stukje verder — in alles wat we doen. We zetten de klant centraal, denken een stap vooruit en ontwikkelen oplossingen die echte waarde en langdurige samenwerkingen creëren. We inspireren elkaar om dieper te denken, verantwoordelijkheid over ons werk en streven er voortdurend naar om het mogelijke te vergroten. Als je jezelf volledig meebrengt, de voor de hand liggende antwoorden uitdaagt en wil groeien met een team dat het meent — dan is dit jouw plek. Als Technisch Specialist Autolakken ben jij de technische sparringpartner voor onze klanten. Je combineert diepgaande kennis van autolakken en spuittechnieken met het vermogen om die kennis helder over te brengen. Je ondersteunt klanten bij technische vraagstukken, verzorgt trainingen en begeleidt hen in het optimale gebruik van onze producten én softwareoplossingen. WAT JE KUNT VERWACHTEN Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het oplossen van technische vraagstukken bij klanten, op locatie. Je geeft productdemonstraties en technische trainingen bij klanten en in ons eigen training center. Het analyseren en optimaliseren van werkprocessen en applicatietechnieken behoort tot je belangrijkste taken. Je ondersteunt en traint klanten in het gebruik van onze eigen software. Je draagt bij  aan kennisdeling en best practices binnen het team. Daarnaast werk je Intensief samen met collega’s van andere afdelingen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor rapportage en documentatie. Je legt bevindingen en adviezen vast en geeft feedback aan de interne afdelingen. WAT JE AANBIEDT Je hebt een technische achtergrond of aantoonbare ervaring in autolakken en spuittechnieken. Praktische ervaring binnen een autoschadeherstelbedrijf is een vereiste. Je hebt een sterk probleemoplossend en analytisch denkvermogen. Je hebt interesse in software (training & support) en bent digitaal vaardig. Bovendien ben je zelfstandig, gestructureerd en sterk klantgericht. Je bent bereid om klanten door heel Nederland te bezoeken. Een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal en het Engels is een plus. WAT WIJ BIEDEN Een afwisselende technische functie met veel zelfstandigheid Werken met hoogwaardige producten en innovatieve systemen Uitgebreide opleidingsmogelijkheden en voortdurende bijscholing Een aantrekkelijk salaris met aanvullende arbeidsvoorwaarden Auto van de zaak Moderne werkomgeving met een eigen training center Werken voor een sterk en internationaal merk Diversiteit is onze grootste kracht! Maak deel uit van onze succesformule en ontwikkel samen met ons de toekomst -- in een wereldwijd team dat inclusiviteit en gelijke kansen omarmt, ongeacht geslacht, leeftijd, afkomst, seksuele geaardheid, handicap of geloof.
