jobs.name: Control Systems Project Engineer
jobs.description: Now hiring! Control Systems Project Engineer Freeport, TX (Onsite) Includes relocation assistance We are looking for a Control Systems Project Engineer to join our Petrochemicals team in Freeport, TX. Where the chemistry happens… BASF’s Petrochemical division is the starting point of BASF's petrochemical value creation worldwide, also known as “the heart of the Verbund,” representing the world's largest chemical markets. Together, let us keep the heart beating one creative solution at a time! As a Control Systems Project Engineer, you will serve as a senior technical contributor and focal point for delivering safe, reliable, and optimized control systems capital projects at BASF’s Freeport, Texas site. In this role, you will work closely with Operations, Engineering, Maintenance, and Project Management teams to lead control systems investments that support operational excellence, lifecycle sustainability, and long term business success. Come create chemistry with us! As a Control Systems Project Engineer, you create chemistry by... Leading the design, execution, and commissioning of control system capital projects, with emphasis on programmable logic controller modernization, replacement, and lifecycle management initiatives, as well as safety instrumented and distributed control systems. Serving as the technical authority and single point of accountability for control systems project scope, cost, schedule, and performance, in close partnership with Project Managers. Developing and executing lifecycle management strategies for replacement and modernization of aging automation systems, including legacy programmable logic controller platforms, while maintaining safe and reliable plant operations. Applying continuous improvement and value improving practices to optimize project scope, cost, reliability, and long term operability. Ensuring all projects are executed in full compliance with environmental, health, and safety requirements while actively promoting a strong safety culture. Collaborating across engineering, operations, maintenance, and peer groups to share best practices and deliver consistent, high quality technical solutions. If you... Have a bachelor’s degree in an engineering discipline such as electrical, chemical, automation, or a related field. Bring significant experience executing and leading industrial automation capital projects, including control system replacement, modernization, and lifecycle management initiatives involving programmable logic controller and distributed control system technologies. Possess hands-on experience designing, implementing, and commissioning industrial control system modernization projects in a manufacturing environment, including programmable logic controller replacements, distributed control system migrations, or other legacy automation system upgrades. Demonstrate strong technical leadership and sound engineering judgment when resolving complex or high risk control system challenges. Have solid knowledge of project execution processes, including scope development, cost estimating, risk management, and funding approvals. Exhibit a demonstrated commitment to environmental, health, and safety compliance and to promoting a strong safety culture during project execution. Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF . We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us As one of the largest chemical companies in North America we have been finding solutions for your everyday needs and addressing the most complex economic, environmental, and sustainability challenges for more than 150 years! At BASF we empower our employees with the tools, guidance and opportunities they need to advance and succeed in work and life. Giving you the support you need to be your best and fulfill your personal ambitions is what helps us create chemistry. After all, our success is linked to yours. Whatever path you envision, BASF is a great place to build a rewarding, successful career. Belong to Something Bigger. #belongatBASF Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. If you have experienced any of the above, please contact Careers.NorthAmerica@basf.com to report fraud. Equal employment opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

jobs.description:
Now Hiring! Technical Sales Representative If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. Please do not be confused by this: All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application will be submitted to us. At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships. We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place. Company Description Surventis , is a global expert in the development, production and marketing of innovative and sustainable mobility and refinish coatings, as well as surface treatments for metal, plastic and glass across many industries. We share the skills, knowledge and resources of interdisciplinary global teams through a collaborative network of sites in Europe, North America, South America and Asia Pacific. Roles and Responsibilities Understands the business activities of accounts in the territory and applies knowledge of the customer’s internal operation to tailor sales presentations and sales proposals to the account’s specific needs. Manages territory profitability by reviewing territory compensation margins, providing margin improvement by product selection and optimum pricing.  Assures that technology provided within the territory strengthens the company’s competitive position within the accounts. Calls on established and prospective customers, determines their needs, and sells appropriate products to markets, targeted by the business units of the company. Selects the process and the right material to solve customer cleaning, sanitation or surface treatment problems. Price negotiation: Provide pricing quotes, price and delivery policy within established limits, subject to approval. Attain sales plan by securing new customers, increasing sales to current customers and maintaining up to date opportunity pipeline in CRM (Salesforces). Works closely with customers focusing on building strong business relationships. Maintains contacts with customers in relation to their service requirements. Provides information on new products, methods, techniques and other general information such as safety and disposal. Trains customers and insures proper and safe use of Chemetall materials. Reports competitive activities, that impact sales in the territory, to the supervisor (District Manager). Prepares and submits call reports, exception reports, and in-plant service reports via CRM (Salesforce). Share reports with appropriate colleagues to ensure collaboration with different functions to keep all necessary information on all accounts. Requirements BS Degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Engineering, or Business is required. Minimum of 2 years of relatable experience is required. B2B/outside industrial sales experience, in specialty chemical sales (surface treatment-paint pretreatments, wastewater treatments, metalworking fluids, etc.) preferred. Ability to make sales presentations and follow up with written proposals and manage customer contracts. Well organized with sales planning. Managing customer accounts within the assigned territory. Strong selling skills for customer acquisition and continuous up-/cross-selling opportunities (customer support/account management) Build and strengthen customer relationships. Technical consulting capabilities regarding products and processes; will learn and understand Chemetall product portfolio. Strong business acumen. Strong Negotiation skills Problem solving skills Time management Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. Travel up to 50-60%, with occasional overnight travel. Valid driver's license in good standing. [[LEGAL_ENTITY_OBJ]] Notice regarding responsibility and data processing The job offers published on this platform relate exclusively to positions at . jobs.name: 1st Class Mechanic
jobs.description: Now hiring! 1st Class Mechanic McIntyre GA (Onsite) We are looking for a 1st Class Mechanic to join our Catalyst team in McIntyre GA. Come create chemistry with us! BASF’s Catalysts division is the global market leader in catalyst technologies. The division develops and produces mobile emissions catalysts as well as process catalysts and offers precious metals trading, recycling and related products and services. During your shift as a 1st Class Mechanic, you will Recognize and practice safe work habits in all daily duties. Install, rearrange, align, dismantle, repair, and reassemble complex equipment; diagnose complex equipment failures. Perform mechanic‑skill work including fabrication, assembly, welding, burning, cutting, and pipefitting using oxyacetylene, plasma arc, shielded arc, tungsten arc, flux‑cored, carbon arc cutting and gouging, and submerged arc methods. Occasionally perform work in other trades (pipefitter, rigger, rough carpentry, machinist, etc.). Use typical mechanic’s tools, tool‑room inspection equipment, inspection gages, and involved shop math; operate production equipment to check work. Work from drawings, sketches, or verbal instructions and read, comprehend, and execute tasks from technical operating and maintenance manuals. Inspect own and others’ work for quality and dimensional requirements. Clean debris and lubricant from parts, equipment, and the work area. Repair piping and valves; install new pipe, valves, and control devices for equipment modifications. Rig equipment for lifting with hoists or cranes, routinely handling loads of several thousand pounds. Complete routine paperwork and use basic computer skills to access CMMS information. If you... Hold a High School diploma or equivalent. Have prior experience working with rotating equipment or equivalent in a manufacturing environment. Are able to start, stop and operate all shop equipment. Can work with water soluble and oil-based lubricants. Are able to work on ladders, scaffolds and in pits and manually lift 50# intermittently (Heavier parts are lifted using other methods). Create your own chemistry with you@BASF This is an Union position under United Steel Workers (USW) and is covered under the collective bargaining agreement.  All benefits are outlined in this agreement. About us As one of the largest chemical companies in North America we have been finding solutions for your everyday needs and addressing the most complex economic, environmental, and sustainability challenges for more than 150 years! At BASF we empower our employees with the tools, guidance and opportunities they need to advance and succeed in work and life. Giving you the support you need to be your best and fulfill your personal ambitions is what helps us create chemistry. After all, our success is linked to yours. Whatever path you envision, BASF is a great place to build a rewarding, successful career. Belong to Something Bigger. #belongatBASF Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. If you have experienced any of the above, please contact myhr@basf.com to report fraud. Pay transparency The pay rate for this role is $35.34 per the Union's collective bargaining agreement. Equal employment opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

jobs.name: Millwright
jobs.description: Now hiring! Millwright Regina, SK (On-site) Annual bonus / Overtime pay eligible We are looking for a Millwright to join our Agricultural Solutions team in Regina, SK. Come create chemistry with us! BASF’s Agricultural Solutions division connects innovation, customers, partners and agricultural experts and integrates sustainability criteria into all business decisions. We help farmers deliver the best possible outcomes, working to achieve the balance between economic, environmental and social value creation for sustainable and efficient agriculture. As a Millwright, you will perform safe, reliable, and efficient mechanical maintenance activities to support continuous operation of the Regina chemical manufacturing facility. The Maintenance Millwright Technician is responsible for executing planned and corrective maintenance work, troubleshooting mechanical equipment failures, and supporting asset reliability and mechanical integrity. This role contributes directly to safe plant operation, equipment uptime, and effective execution of the site’s maintenance strategy. As a Millwright, you create chemistry by... Executing planned preventive and corrective maintenance work in accordance with SAP work orders, job plans, procedures, and safety requirements. You will also maintain accurate documentation by completing SAP work orders, inspections, and maintenance records. Troubleshooting mechanical equipment failures and supporting timely restoration of production during unplanned breakdown events, including participation in a rotating on call schedule with availability for evening, weekend, and emergency response as required by site operations. Installing, repairing, and replacing mechanical components including pumps, bearings, seals, gearboxes, conveyors, and associated equipment. Participating in equipment inspections, condition monitoring activities, and continuous improvement of maintenance tasks and job plans. Supporting shutdown, turnaround, and outage activities, including equipment preparation and commissioning. Participating in project design reviews, Management of Change (MOC) reviews, and other cross functional forums to provide maintenance expertise and feedback on equipment maintainability, serviceability, and reliability. Participating in safety meetings, job hazard analyses, and EHS initiatives. If you have... Interprovincial Red Seal Journeyperson Millwright (Industrial Mechanic) Certificate recognized under current Saskatchewan Apprenticeship and Trade Certification Commission (SATCC) requirements, and possess a valid Saskatchewan driver’s license or ability to obtain. Experience troubleshooting and maintaining mechanical equipment in a manufacturing or industrial environment and supporting equipment breakdowns in a 24/7 or continuous production setting, with working knowledge of industrial EHS requirements and safe work practices. Experience working within a planned maintenance and reliability‑based maintenance programs, and executing preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance work orders. Strong mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting skills, with working knowledge of pumps, gearboxes, bearings, couplings, conveyors, rotating equipment and mechanical drives, with the ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings, technical manuals, and P&IDs. Experience with alignment, rigging, precision measurements, and mechanical installation practices. Experience working with Enterprise Asset Management systems, preferably SAP PM, and demonstrate proficiency in basic computer use, electronic work order systems, and maintenance documentation. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Représentant de Service Technique 1 1 Nous sommes à la recherche d'un représentant de service technique pour rejoindre notre division Agricultural Solutions à l’est de l’Ontario ou au Québec. Venez créer de la chimie avec nous! La division Agricultural Solutions de BASF met en relation l’innovation, les clients, les partenaires et les experts agricoles et intègre des critères de durabilité dans toutes les décisions commerciales. Nous aidons les agriculteurs à obtenir les meilleurs résultats possibles, en s’efforçant d’atteindre l’équilibre entre la création de valeur économique, environnementale et sociale pour une agriculture durable et efficace. Le représentant de service technique (contrat de 14 mois) est chargé de s’assurer que le positionnement des produits marketing, commerciaux et techniques est conforme à la région et à l’équipe de spécialistes des cultures qu’il soutient. Comme Représentant de Service Technique 1 1, vous créez de la chimie en... Dispensant une formation technique à la force de vente et aux principaux influenceurs de la région. Cela comprend la formation des représentants commerciaux sur les techniques d’enquête sur le terrain et, le cas échéant, une assistance technique pour les demandes de renseignements sur les produits. Soutenant également les objectifs de vente par une interaction directe avec les ventes et indirecte en influençant les principaux clients externes de la région. Exécutant des activités estivales de création de demandes, y compris des essais chez les producteurs à grande échelle et des sites de démonstration dans la région. Il est chargé de fournir des données utiles pour atteindre les objectifs de vente et répondre aux questions sur l’utilisation des produits. Surveillant et en influençant positivement les principaux centres d’influence tels que les universités, les consultants, le personnel chargé de la vulgarisation provinciale et le commerce de détail agricole en établissant des relations et des contacts réguliers. Il fournit à ces centres d’influence des renseignements sur les produits, des mises à jour de la marque et des résultats techniques. Jouant un rôle clé dans le transfert des connaissances sur les nouveaux produits et les cultures vers d’autres régions de vente, en interagissant régulièrement avec les chefs de marque, les représentants des ventes au détail et des producteurs, les responsables de comptes stratégiques, les responsables du marketing technique, de la réglementation et de la biologie. Si vous avez... Un baccalauréat ou une maîtrise en agriculture ou en biologie avec un accent sur la science des cultures, la malherbologie, l’agronomie, l’entomologie, la phytopathologie ou une discipline connexe est recommandé. Les candidats titulaires d’un baccalauréat en sciences et ayant un minimum de 5 ans d’expérience seront également pris en considération. Un professional agrologist, CCA ou CCSC (Certified Crop Adviser ou Certified Crop Science Consultant) avec au moins 2 ans d’expérience relative sur le terrain. Des compétences en développement et enlivraison de présentations aux clients externes et internes. Vous devez avoir d’excellentes compétences informatiques et maîtriser divers logiciels, notamment PowerPoint, Excel et Word. Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et orale est essentiel. Être efficace pour communiquer avec une grande variété de publics. Être capable d’établir des relations avec les principaux contacts influents sur les attributs techniques des produits et les problèmes agronomiques relatifs aux principales cultures de la région. Capacité à recommander le positionnement d’un produit en fonction de l’évaluation des données et des besoins des clients. Expérience de travail avec des représentants des ventes au détail et des producteurs, des universités ou des consultants serait un atout. Une capacité à fournir un leadership technique au sein de l’équipe de vente est un avantage. Posséder de solides compétences en organisation et en gestion du temps est essentiel. Le bilinguisme est considéré comme un atout. Wenn Sie Ihre ganze Persönlichkeit einbringen, das Offensichtliche hinterfragen und mit einem Team wachsen möchten, das es ernst meint – dann sind Sie hier richtig. WAS SIE ERWARTET Für unsere interne Revisionseinheit suchen wir eine engagierte und analytisch denkende Person als Senior Auditor (m/w/d). In dieser Rolle unterstützen Sie die Einheit dabei, den Wert der Organisation zu steigern und zu schützen, indem sie unabhängige, objektive Prüfungsleistungen erbringen, die darauf abzielen, Mehrwert zu schaffen und die Abläufe der Organisation zu verbessern. In Ihrer Rolle als Senior Auditor führen Sie eigenständig risikoorientierte Prüfungen bei in- und ausländischen Einheiten und Gesellschaften der Unternehmensgruppe durch. Sie analysieren und bewerten Geschäftsprozesse im Hinblick auf Ordnungsmäßigkeit, Wirtschaftlichkeit und Wirksamkeit. Des Weiteren identifizieren Sie wesentliche Risiken und entwickeln darauf aufbauend geeignete Prüfprogramme. Sie dokumentieren Ihre Arbeitsschritte sowie Prüfungsergebnisse strukturiert und nachvollziehbar. Zudem bereiten Sie Ihre Prüfungsergebnisse prägnant auf und kommunizieren diese adressatengerecht an das Senior Management. Letzlich verfolgen Sie die Umsetzung vereinbarter Maßnahmen nach und wirken an der Weiterentwicklung von Prüfungsansätzen und -methoden mit. WAS SIE MITBRINGEN erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Betriebswirtschaftslehre Finanzen, Rechnungswesen oder eines vergleichbaren Fachgebiets mehrjährige relevante Berufserfahrung, z. B. in der Internen Revision, Wirtschaftsprüfung, im Accounting, Controlling oder Risikomanagement ausgeprägtes analytisches Denkvermögen sowie eine strukturierte und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Professionalität kommunikationsstarke und souveräne Gesprächsführung auf unterschiedlichen Managementebenen sehr gute Deutsch‑ und Englischkenntnisse; sicherer Umgang mit MS Office, SAP‑Kenntnisse von Vorteil WAS WIR BIETEN Die Attraktivität unserer außertariflichen Gehälter stellen wir durch regelmäßige Benchmarks sicher. Über den Bonus können die Benefits individuell gestaltet werden. Eine firmenfinanzierte Unfall- und Pflegezusatzversicherung sowie eine attraktive Altersvorsorge bieten eine umfassende Absicherung. An unserem Standort in Münster gibt es ein betriebseigenes Fitness-Studio „Freizeit“ mit angeschlossener Physiotherapie-Praxis, festangestellte Werkärzte, ein Betriebsrestaurant „Auszeit“ inklusive einer Café-Bar, eine bilinguale Betriebs-KiTa „LackiKids‟ sowie ein Ferienprogramm „LackiKids on Tour“. Wir haben 30 Urlaubstage/Jahr (Vollzeit), zusätzliche Freizeitoptionen und eine 37,5 -Stunden-Woche. Für die fachliche sowie persönliche Weiterentwicklung bieten wir vielfältige lokale und globale Entwicklungs- und Karrieremöglichkeiten. BASF als Gründungsmitglied der Charta der Vielfalt steht für Diversität – wir sind stolz auf unsere Coatings Mitarbeitendennetzwerke WomenInCoatings, ColorPride@EC und CultiConnect. Unsere Sozial- und Lebensberatung der BASF Stiftung ist zentrale Anlaufstelle zu sozialen Fragen sowie bei besonderen beruflichen und privaten Herausforderungen und bietet vielfältige Aktionen sowie Veranstaltungen für Mitarbeitende. SO ERREICHEN SIE UNS Melissa Amina Rahmani (Talent Acquisition), melissa.rahmani@basf.com, Tel.:+4930200558073 beantwortet gerne Ihre Fragen zu dieser Position. Gerne können Sie auch einen Online-Termin buchen. ÜBER UNS Mehr über unser Unternehmen erfahren Sie hier . Vielfalt ist unsere größte Stärke! Gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft – in einem globalen Team, das Inklusion und Chancengleichheit unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, sexueller Orientierung, Behinderung oder Weltanschauung lebt. jobs.name: Senior Auditor (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
WELCOME In the Coatings division, we offer far more than just paints and coatings. Our approach is to put the needs of our customers at the centre and always think one step ahead. Our motto ‘We always go beyond the surface’ makes it clear that we are not only focussed on the products themselves, but also on the reasons why we develop them. We are interested in creating innovative solutions that promote future growth and fulfil the requirements of the market. With our extensive knowledge and experience, we work to provide tailored coatings solutions that create real value and build strong partnerships. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT For our Internal Audit unit, we are looking for a committed and analytically minded Senior Auditor (m/f/d). In this role, you support the unit in enhancing and protecting the organization’s value by providing independent and objective audit services aimed at creating added value and improving organizational processes. In your role as Senior Auditor, you independently conduct risk-based audits at group companies globally. You analyze and assess business processes with regard to compliance, efficiency, and effectiveness. Moreover, you identify key risks and develop appropriate audit programs based on those risks. Furthermore, you document your work steps and audit results in a structured and transparent manner. You prepare audit results concisely and communicate them in a target-group-oriented way to senior management. Finally, you follow up on the implementation of agreed measures and contribute to the further development of internal audit methods and tools. WHAT YOU OFFER successfully completed university degree in business administration, economics, finance, accounting, or a comparable field several years of relevant professional experience, e.g., in internal audit, external audit, accounting, controlling, or risk management strong analytical skills as well as a structured and thorough working style high level of initiative, sense of responsibility, and professionalism strong communication skills and confident interaction across different management levels very good German and English skills; confident use of MS Office, SAP knowledge is an advantage WHAT WE OFFER We offer an attractive salary with individual benefits such as performance-related bonuses. Company-funded supplementary health insurance, accident insurance and an attractive pension plan offer comprehensive coverage. We offer a wide range of local and global development and career opportunities for professional and personal development. As a founding member of the Diversity Charter, BASF stands for diversity – we are proud of our Coatings employee networks WomenInCoatings, ColorPride@EC and CultiConnect. The feedback culture is firmly integrated into our corporate culture, e.g., through regular employee surveys and management feedback. At our location in Münster, we have our own fitness studio “Freizeit” with a physiotherapy practice, permanently employed company doctors, a company restaurant “Auszeit” including a café bar, a bilingual company daycare center “LackiKids” and a vacation program “LackiKids on Tour”. We have 30 vacation days/year (full-time), additional time off options and a 37.5-hour week. HOW TO REACH US Melissa Amina Rahmani (Talent Acquisition), melissa.rahmani@basf.com, Tel.: +49 30 2005 58073, will be happy to answer any questions you may have about this position. You are also welcome to book an online meeting . You can also reach our recruiting team here . You can find initial information about our application process here . ABOUT US Learn more about our company here. Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief. jobs.name: Junior Controller (m/f/d) - Hybrid Option GER
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF In Global Business Services, we support BASF's divisions with a cross-functional network and offer modern solutions tailored to the needs of the business. As a specialized service unit we ensure a high level of customer orientation and we design our services to be cooperative, efficient and future-oriented. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Are you a passionate and motivated person? Then join our Business Reporting team as a Junior Controller. This position offers you the opportunity to develop your skills in the areas of Cost Center Accounting, Cost Charging, Product Costing or Project Accounting. Embark on Financial Analysis: Engage in management accounting activities to provide strategic financial insights and support informed decision-making. We like it well-founded: Collaborate with controlling units to find effective solutions for strategic decision-making. You help to get things moving: work with SAP data, ensure accuracy and handle month-end-closings successfully. Achieve more together: Bring expertise to defined areas of competence, supporting internal and global projects. We love new things: Identify process, report, and system enhancement opportunities; drive harmonization and automation. WHAT YOU OFFER successfully completed studies in the field of business & economics or able to think outside the box with high willingness to learn first professional experience in accounting or controlling, e.g. in the context of internships strong IT affinity and interest in digitalization; ideally initial experience with  SAP R/3, FI and CO or SAP S/4HANA fluent communication skills in English, other European languages are an advantage WHAT WE OFFER Gross annual salary (full-time): 40.000 - 46.000 €, depending on qualifications and professional experience - In addition, you can expect a bonus dependent on the company's success 30 days of paid vacation, special leave and sabbatical options Flexible working hours so that you can organize your working and private life according to your needs Location-independent working models with defined days of presence in Berlin and residence in Germany – here a first impression Work mobile from other EU countries for up to six weeks HOW TO REACH US Katarina Borisov (Talent Acquisition), Tel: +49 30 2005-59269 will be happy to answer your questions for this position. You are welcome to book an online appointment. You can also reach our recruiting team here. First information about our application process can be found here and in our Q&A video. ABOUT US As an international service hub, the BASF Services Europe GmbH bundles a wide range of services for the BASF Group throughout Europe. In the heart of Berlin, we combine expertise in the areas of finance, HR, supply chain, procurement, product safety and IT. We focus on digital and customer-focused solutions, to create services for future. Learn more about us and our career opportunities here . Diversity is our greatest strength! jobs.description:
WELCOME If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships. We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place. M ain Areas of Responsibilities and Key Activities Product Portfolio Management : Develop and implement technology toolbox to optimize products, drive consolidation, and facilitate knowledge sharing among countries. Steward project proposals and manage PhaseGate projects. Strategic Marketing Projects : Lead marketing initiative for the Indian automotive market focused on profitable and sustainable growth. Conduct market analysis, optimize technology portfolios, and develop tailored product offerings. Pricing Management : Define and implement regional pricing policies, propose pricing actions, and ensure adherence to KAM Business Rules for margin management. Strategy Development : Build regional strategies for different coatings layers, define milestones, and promote collaboration across countries. Business Development : Act as the key contact for 2W accounts, identify opportunities, and support business restructuring efforts. Sales and Key Account Management : Drive growth and optimize sales turnover in the 2W segment, identifying areas for improvement and monitoring product performance. Recommend enhancements to sales and distribution efficiency in line with regional strategies. Cross functional Collaboration with Customization Lab, global /regional Product Management, Technical Project management, Supply Chain, and Key Account Managers to ensure short- and long-term growth and profitability improvements across all coatings layers Localization - Evaluate & implement localization of critical raw materials Define organic measures for complexity reduction and profitability improvement, e.g. introduction of local sourcing, toll manufacturing of finished goods, raw materials and intermediates, consolidation of RMs/intermediates/Finished goods technologies etc. Collaborate with Labs & Key Accounts Management for Introduction and Implementation of new products and technology like High Solids, low-cost mono coats Job Skills: 1. Should be able to collaborate with region and global teams based on project needs 2. Should be able to think strategically for the division to lay out plans for future growth and profitability, and execute them 3. Product knowledge; Knowledge of application technique, commercial acumen 4. Communication & Collaboration skills 5. Investment and R&D project business case preparation Job Requirements (m inimum requirement to carry out the work) Edu c a t i o n Incumbent should be preferably a postgraduate (Chemicals or related field) A degree in Business Management will be an added advantage W o r k in g Experience The incumbent should have more than 15 years’ experience in Automotive or Chemicals sector. Join our diverse and inclusive team in India, where we value different perspectives and provide equal opportunities to all employees, irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or belief. We believe that diversity, equity and inclusion make us stronger and drive innovation, collaboration and sustainable success. Tot 1 juli maakte onze organisatie deel uit van BASF. In het kader van de huidige overgang worden alle vacatures en het sollicitatieproces nog steeds gehost op het BASF‑platform en daarom volledig in BASF‑huisstijl weergegeven. Laat je hier niet door verwarren: alle functies zijn posities bij Surventis en jouw sollicitatie wordt bij ons ingediend. Bij Surventis kijken we een stukje verder — in alles wat we doen. We zetten de klant centraal, denken een stap vooruit en ontwikkelen oplossingen die echte waarde en langdurige samenwerkingen creëren. We inspireren elkaar om dieper te denken, verantwoordelijkheid over ons werk en streven er voortdurend naar om het mogelijke te vergroten. Als je jezelf volledig meebrengt, de voor de hand liggende antwoorden uitdaagt en wil groeien met een team dat het meent — dan is dit jouw plek. Als Accountmanager ben jij het vaste gezicht voor klanten in regio Zuid. Je bouwt aan relaties die blijven plakken, spot groeikansen en zet die om in duidelijke afspraken en slimme voorstellen. Jij houdt overzicht in je pipeline, legt alles netjes vast in Salesforce en schakelt met collega’s en interne teams om klanten elke dag vooruit te helpen. WAT JE KUNT VERWACHTEN Je stapt ’s ochtends de auto in, rijdt naar klanten in Zuid-Nederland en bent de sparringpartner die kansen ziet voordat ze op de radar staan. In deze rol combineer je relatiebeheer met new business en bouw je jouw regio stap voor stap uit, met Salesforce als jouw cockpit. Jouw speelveld: Zuid-Nederland Mix van relatiebeheer én nieuwe klanten binnenhalen Je werkt data gedreven met Salesforce en MS Office Korte lijnen: je schakelt direct met de Sales Manager en interne specialisten WAT JE AANBIEDT Met behulp van een scherpe en analytische blik weet je jezelf te onderscheiden en nieuwe kansen in de markt te signaleren, deze verder te ontwikkelen en om te zetten in new business met ondersteuning van het Salesteam. Je hebt minimaal een mbo-diploma en HBO werk- en denkniveau, aangevuld met commerciële trainingen. Je hebt commerciële skills en je weet hoe je deals opbouwt (en afrondt). Je hebt feeling met sales en marketing en vindt het leuk om met digitale tools te werken. Je woont in Zuid-Nederland (of super dichtbij) en kent de regio. Je bent bekend met CRM-Systemen zoals Salesforce MS Office. Bovendien heb je sterke communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel Nederlands als Engels. Je bent vaardig met Microsoft Office, waaronder Power BI en Excel. Ervaring in B2B sales is een plus. Je staat bekend om je hands-on mentaliteit, enthousiasme, en vooral veel gedrevenheid! WAT WIJ BIEDEN Veel vrijheid en vertrouwen: jij runt je regio en maakt het waar. Een vliegende start met onboarding, producttraining en coaching-on-the-job. Een team waar je op kunt bouwen: support van collega’s en interne experts. Marktconforme arbeidsvoorwaarden, met ruimte voor resultaat (bonus/variabel). De tools om te knallen: alles wat je nodig hebt om onderweg goed te werken. 8,33% vakantietoeslag + eindejaarsuitkering + uitgebreide bonusregeling. 25 vakantiedagen, aangevuld met 6 ADV-dagen op basis van een 40-urige werkweek. Een auto van de zaak. Diversiteit is onze grootste kracht! Maak deel uit van onze succesformule en ontwikkel samen met ons de toekomst -- in een wereldwijd team dat inclusiviteit en gelijke kansen omarmt, ongeacht geslacht, leeftijd, afkomst, seksuele geaardheid, handicap of geloof. jobs.name: Postdoc, Solid Process
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities. About The Role You will work as an expert in process research and development, focusing on solid process and engineering . How You Will Do It Be responsible for compliance to EHS rules in your area of activity. Initiates safety review for experiments and ensures compliance to measures. Initiate, manage, constantly discuss, and align research projects with other project partners including product development, technical groups, production, universities, etc. to develop solid handling, drying, mixing, extrusion and other relevant processes. Your expertise and results will be applied to both research and operation. Provide technical support for business units in Asian Pacific region on related process development and optimization, troubleshooting, debottlenecking on field of solid characterization, conveying, drying, mixing, extrusion, etc. Design, instruct, and coach lab members for project experiments, closely watching and achieving project milestones, timeline and budget, present and document results, file patents. Join the expert network within the BASF global R&D community, operational units, technologies, and scientific partners to maintain state of the art expertise as well as monitor new practices and market trends What We Look For Education: Ph.D. in chemical engineering, process engineering, mechanical engineering, material science and engineering, physical chemistry or related. Working Experience: at least 1 year relevant work experience. Hands-on experimental skills and in-depth knowledge on solid mechanics, powder technology, conveying, drying, mixing, extrusion, etc. Demonstrated ability to define research problems, design experimental plans, and independently drive a project forward. Excellent data analysis and technical writing skills. Prior industrial experience is a strong plus. Modeling and simulation experience on solid related processes is highly valued English and Chinese: Fluent. El éxito de nuestro equipo se basa en soluciones innovadoras y una estrecha colaboración con nuestros clientes. LO QUE PUEDES ESPERAR Ayudas a ofrecer aplicaciones web de alta calidad que mejoran los servicios de BASF Coatings para usuarios internos y externos. Trabajas en un equipo DevOps ágil y multifuncional y apoyas el ciclo de vida del producto desde el concepto hasta la puesta en marcha, con un fuerte enfoque en el aseguramiento de la calidad y la automatización de pruebas. Ayudas a definir enfoques de prueba basados en riesgos y a diseñar soluciones de pruebas automatizadas para garantizar que las aplicaciones cumplan sus objetivos de calidad funcional y no funcional. Desarrollas una sólida comprensión de los procesos de negocio, los recorridos de usuario y los flujos de trabajo de las aplicaciones para crear una cobertura de pruebas significativa y basada en riesgos. Colaboras estrechamente con desarrolladores de software para validar nuevas funcionalidades, identificar defectos de forma temprana y mejorar la capacidad de prueba general. Diseñas, desarrollas y mantienes pruebas automatizadas para escenarios funcionales, de regresión e integración, y las integras en pipelines de CI/CD para respaldar controles de calidad fiables en múltiples aplicaciones. Utilizas herramientas y frameworks modernos de QA, como Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, Postman o SOAP UI, para probar aplicaciones web y APIs. Te alineas estrechamente con product owners, diseñadores y desarrolladores en cuanto a criterios de aceptación, cobertura de pruebas y expectativas compartidas de calidad. Contribuyes a un proceso fiable de QA automatizado revisando resultados de pruebas, apoyando puertas de calidad y ayudando a los equipos de desarrollo a identificar y resolver incidencias de forma temprana en estrecha colaboración con un equipo internacional de QA. Documentas enfoques de prueba, casos de prueba y resultados de calidad de forma estructurada para apoyar la transparencia, la mantenibilidad y la mejora continua. LO QUE NECESITAMOS DE TI Más de 3 años de experiencia profesional en aseguramiento de la calidad del software, testing de software o ingeniería de calidad en un entorno IT. Grado universitario en Informática, Ingeniería de Software o una cualificación comparable adquirida mediante experiencia práctica. Experiencia en la creación y mantenimiento de planes de prueba, casos de prueba, informes de prueba y documentación estructurada de testing. Experiencia en la identificación, documentación y validación de defectos, así como en pruebas de aplicaciones web y APIs; la experiencia en entornos cloud se valorará positivamente. Experiencia práctica con al menos un framework de automatización de pruebas como Playwright, Cypress, Selenium o Cucumber/Gherkin. Experiencia práctica con herramientas comunes de QA para pruebas de APIs y pruebas funcionales, como Postman o SOAP UI. Experiencia práctica con al menos un lenguaje de programación utilizado para la automatización de pruebas, como JavaScript, TypeScript o Python. Familiaridad con arquitecturas orientadas a servicios o basadas en microservicios. Familiaridad con pipelines de CI/CD o interés en trabajar con controles de calidad automatizados en pipelines de entrega. Experiencia trabajando en múltiples aplicaciones o proyectos y capacidad para equilibrar prioridades de testing en un entorno dinámico. Una forma de trabajar estructurada, analítica y colaborativa, con sólidas habilidades de resolución de problemas y autoorganización. Sólidas habilidades de comunicación en español e inglés, tanto escritas como orales, para colaborar eficazmente entre distintas ubicaciones y zonas horarias. Familiaridad con metodologías ágiles como Scrum o Kanban y experiencia trabajando en equipos de desarrollo ágiles. LO QUE OFRECEMOS Formación continua y desarrollo profesional con nuestras vacantes internas. Entorno seguro y donde promovemos tu salud. Ticket restaurante. Oferta económica competitiva con un salario base más un variable por buen desempeño. Modelo híbrido de trabajo y adaptar tus horarios, según tus circunstancias. Conectar fuera de la oficina y practicar deportes con compañeros/as mediante Grupos de empresa. Retribución flexible que puedes destinar voluntariamente a servicios de transporte, formación, guardería, etc. Planes de pensiones, seguro de vida y accidentes, préstamos personales y participar en programa de acciones de la compañía. Ayudas económicas para la escolarización y otras medidas para las familias. CÓMO PARTICIPAR EN EL PROCESO Envía tu CV en inglés a través de la oferta para poder conocernos. Si tu perfil encaja, te llamaremos desde el equipo español de Talent Acquisition en Alemania (prefijo +49) y te acompañaremos en el proceso. ¡Con cada paso estarás más cerca de conocer a tu futuro equipo! jobs.name: Supplier Quality Engineer
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities. About The Role Ensure all QM rules in accordance with ISO9001 / IATF16949 / ISO14001 / ISO 45001 / VDA / AIAG procedures Address and resolve quality issues, providing technical input and guidance on process enhancements and improvements at suppliers Drive pro-active QM mindset in BU How You Will Do It Cooperate with Sales and Engineer team on product development and jointly define process parameters and criteria to ensure supplier process capability is effective to meet product and process requirements (Focus on critical products, critical processes or critical suppliers) Work with global team to improve Supplier Quality Management system Drive “Quality Assurance Agreements” (QSV) with Suppliers and execute accordingly Supplier evaluation is based on historical performance together with purchasing and release score to supplier regularly. Supplier audit, including potential supplier audit, annual audit, product and process audit and assess their practices and procedures and identify areas for improvement Take responsibility for the overall quality activities concerning quality assurance of purchased parts, monitor supplier performance, validate supplier 8D report and collect failure cost to support procurement for compensation Project supplier nomination procedure engagement based on supplier quality and capacity assessment. Check and approve product drawing and release to supplier Project APQP support for supplier part, regarding OTS and PPAP work, project audit for supplier. Support on supplier development based on customer and business requirements. Apply quality tools e.g. Cp/Cpk, SPC, R&R, 8D to analyze and improve supplier quality performance Supplier changes are managed and approved based on quality, cost savings, and customer requirements. Cooperate with the other QM functions to improve customer satisfaction Work together with delegated procurement to transfer customer CSR to supplier. Assist in maintaining Quality Management (QM) documents in accordance with ISO 9001-2015 and IATF 16949-2016 standards. This involves ensuring compliance with the quality management system by keeping all necessary documentation and records up to date and accurate. QMS Audit Records: Maintain comprehensive records of both external and internal quality management system audits to demonstrate compliance and facilitate continuous improvement. Assist in compiling customer-specific QMS requirements, including supporting the implementation and maintenance of customer special Quality status related requirements. Participate in Manufacturing Site Assessment audits, monitor and maintain periodic customer audit scores, and fulfill other customer-specific quality requirements. Oversee compliance with the Supplier Quality Assurance Manual. What We Look For Bachelor or above on Mechanical or Production Engineering. At least 6 years of experience in quality functions, including supplier quality and project quality with automotive sector. Certificated auditor for IATF16949, VDA 6.3, VDA6.5 or equivalent knowledge. Familiar with quality tools such as APQP, PPAP, 8D, 5why, SPC, FMEAs, etc. Knowledge of injection molding processes, Casting, Machining, and GD&T is preferred. Ability to work under pressure. Good skills in communication and negotiation. Flexible on business trip Work Location Godrej One - Mumbai

In deiner Rolle unterstützt du die Erstellung der externen Konzernfinanzberichterstattung, insbesondere des Konzernjahresabschlusses und der Konzernzwischenabschlüsse nach IFRS, des Konzernlageberichts sowie regulatorischer Veröffentlichungen. Deine Expertise bringst du bei der Erstellung von Notes und Disclosures sowie weiteren Offenlegungspflichten ein. Außerdem unterstützt du bei der Überführung komplexer Bilanzierungs- und Rechnungslegungssachverhalte in transparente, adressatengerechte und regelkonforme Berichte. Hierzu gehört insbesondere die Aufbereitung prüfungssicherer Dokumentationen und Unterlagen für Themen wie Business Combinations, Impairment Tests, Rückstellungen sowie Eigenkapitaltransaktionen. Nicht zuletzt arbeitest du eng mit den externen Wirtschaftsprüfer:innen sowie Kolleg:innen aus den Bereichen Konzernkonsolidierung, Accounting, Legal, Tax, Treasury, ESG und Investor Relations zusammen, um eine konsistente Kapitalmarktkommunikation, die Vollständigkeit aller Berichterstattungsanforderungen sowie eine qualitativ hochwertige externe Finanzberichterstattung sicherzustellen. jobs.description:
Now hiring! Business Development Manager -  Atlantic Canada New Brunswick, NewFoundland, Nova Scotia, and Prince Edward Island ** Field Role/ Atlantic Canada / Company Car provided If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. Please do not be confused by this: All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application will be submitted to us. At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships.  We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place. We are looking for a Business Development Manager to join our Refinish team in Atlantic Canada. Come create chemistry with us! Surventis Automotive Refinish Coatings offers high-quality refinish paint brands and paint-related products to body shops from around the world. Our solutions are approved by the world’s leading automotive manufacturers for the repair of their vehicles. We provide collision centers with a vast array of solutions that help drive their business performance and efficiency. At the heart of our business are our people and our trainers who take care of our customers’ needs, including car painting skills, advanced body shop management solutions, and sophisticated management solutions. As a Business Development Manager based in Atlantic Canada with the ability to travel 50% of the time, you will work with automotive collision repair shops and distribution partners to grow our market share. As a Business Development Manager you create chemistry by... Executing the business strategy and driving sales growth in the local markets through identifying customers and market needs within your assigned market responsibility. Increasing sales growth by developing market potential through forecasting, lead generation, qualification, closing sales and recommending new products and services (70% of the role will be focused on adding new business). Managing existing relationships and developing new ones. Establishing trust and value in our ever-changing industry. Retaining business and driving sales growth. If you... Have a Bachelor’s Degree (preferred).  HS Diploma is acceptable with relevant work experience. Are team-focused and experienced in field sales, territory management, customer relations Have experience in industrial sales (beneficial), the collision industry (a plus), strong interpersonal skills, robust relationship-building and value-based selling skills Are a solid professional who will value our current customer base while also being aggressive to win new business Privacy Statement Surventis takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request personal or financial information of any kind via either text message or direct message on any social media platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never offer a candidate a position and request a cheque for equipment or any other type of payment during the job application process. Pay Transparency Surventis is committed to pay transparency practices. The competitive Pay Range for this role is $83,000 - $90,000. Actual pay will be determined based on education, certifications, experience, and other job-related factors permitted by law. Inclusion and Equal Opportunity Employment Surventis is dedicated to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where our employees can be their authentic selves. We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, place of origin, ethnic origin, colour, religion/creed, sex/pregnancy, marital status, family status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by law. jobs.name: Nematologist Scientist (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF We are BASF in agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. We do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture by connecting innovation, customers and society. Come join us on our journey to create solutions for sustainable agriculture at the Innovation Center of BASF Belgium Coordination Center CommV in Ghent, Belgium. We are seeking people who thrive in a culture of creativity, openness, responsibility, and entrepreneurial spirit. In our organization, we encourage and celebrate innovative thinking, where ideas flow freely and are nurtured. We value individuals who take ownership of their work and are accountable for their actions. We foster an entrepreneurial mindset, where taking calculated risks and seizing opportunities are encouraged to drive growth and success. Join our team and be part of an environment that values and rewards creative thinking, collaboration, and a can-do attitude. Within BASF Seed and Traits R&D, Trait Research we focus on the design, creation and testing of candidate leads as gene-based solutions for herbicide tolerance, pest and disease control in key crops including soybean, oilseed rape, wheat and cotton. We are currently seeking a talented, motivated, and inspiring Nematologist to join our Trait Research team at the R&D Innovation Center in Ghent, Belgium. In this role, you will develop and execute research strategies aligned with business goals to successfully commercialize innovative nematode resistant traits and germplasm. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth Take a look at our Agricultural Solutions: Vision & Mission WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT You propose innovative nematode trait concepts and develop and implement nematode control research strategies using state-of-the-art know-how and technologies including suitable third-party collaborations to ascertain scientific competitiveness of the nematode program. You evaluate scientific progress of nematode control programs with the project leader and with support of team members (technicians and scientists in the lab and GH) and take decisions to ensure the achievement of scientific objectives and critical milestones with optimal use of available resources. You design and oversee the execution of nematode control assays to support program goals. You articulate a clear, innovative and competitive testing scheme to meet these goals and to ensure the efficient delivery of high-quality nematode traits. You proactively report on your scientific progress and new opportunities to all relevant stakeholders as requested. You develop the innovative ability and competence of research teams, and you act as a mentor and give scientific guidance across the organization. You support the program leader to ensure strategy competitiveness by working closely with Intellectual Property colleagues to build a proactive patenting (and, if needed, licensing-) strategy and ensure a competitor IP analysis in the program field. WHAT YOU OFFER You hold a PhD in Nematology with 12-15 years of relevant experience or equivalent. You are internationally acknowledged as a consistent innovator and leading authority in the field of Plant Nematology and have a profound knowledge of GM trait development. You provide innovative solutions for plant parasitic nematode issues and demonstrate knowledge and expertise from working directly with plant parasitic nematodes. You are familiar with crop business strategies and the principles of value creation for growers. You understand the connection between the lab and the field. You have a track record of providing scientific leadership for internal and external program work packages, effectively managing collaborations with partners, and excel in developing innovative research proposals that incorporate novel technology platforms to advance plant parasitic nematode control project objectives. You possess leadership and team coaching skills, motivating and inspiring others, while fostering collaboration in diverse environments through a multi-cultural mindset. You demonstrate proactivity, with well-developed communication skills that enable effective interactions with stakeholders. You build a culture of innovation by creating an environment that supports creativity and by coaching and developing people. You are fluent in English. WHAT WE OFFER A permanent contract within an attractive working environment in a professional and motivated team. Interesting and challenging learning and development opportunities to help you make the most of your talents and your job. An attractive base salary in relation to your diploma and competencies, an annual bonus and extra-legal benefits. HOW TO REACH US If you need more information about the process or the vacancy, you can reach our recruiting team here . Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

The BASF Service Hub Kuala Lumpur (BASF Asia-Pacific Service Centre Sdn Bhd) is strategically located in the capital city of Malaysia. Since its inception in 2005, the hub has expanded from 130 employees to over 1,300 employees currently and is expected to keep growing. As an ISO 9001:2005 certified organization, the Service Hub Kuala Lumpur is committed to delivering high quality expertise and services in finance, people, supply chain, EHSQ (environment, health, safety, quality), product safety and digital. We take pride in providing our business services to BASF companies and affiliates across 20 markets in the Asia Pacific region and beyond. Moreover, we offer our services in 8 different languages to cater to the diverse needs of our stakeholders. Our focus on competency and technology-driven solutions allows us to consistently deliver exceptional services, thereby contributing to the success of our businesses. BASF also has two other regional hubs located in Berlin, Germany, and Montevideo, Uruguay, which cover the European and American regions. Furthermore, the hub secured a Bronze Award for Excellence in Digital Transformation at the HR Excellence Awards 2024 and received a Bronze Award for Human Resources Impact and an Honorary Award for Creative Talent Management Impact at the SSON Impact Awards Asia 2024. At BASF, we create chemistry for a sustainable future. Our ambition: We want to be the preferred chemical company to enable our customers’ green transformation. We combine economic success with environmental protection and social responsibility. Around 112,000 employees in the BASF Group contribute to the success of our customers in nearly all sectors and almost every country in the world. Our portfolio comprises, as core businesses, the segments Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, and Nutrition & Care; our standalone businesses are bundled in the segments Surface Technologies and Agricultural Solutions. jobs.name: Regional Data & AI Engineer, Operations, Asia Pacific
jobs.description:
About the Role Regional Data & AI Engineer builds and advances a scalable data and AI backbone for smart manufacturing across Asia sites within Coatings business unit. It combines the development of a standardized production data architecture across sites with the ability to translate data into business value through advanced analytics, AI-ML, and agentic AI solutions. The role ensures that production data is consistently leveraged to improve performance, enable better decisions, and drive continuous optimization across the regional manufacturing network. How You Will Do It Production Data Architecture Define and implement the target architecture for the capture, integration, and provision of production and process data across multiple sites, ensuring scalability and alignment with global standards. IT/OT Integration Develop and implement standards and concepts for the integration of production-relevant data sources, including sensors, PLC, SCADA, historian, MES, LIMS, quality, and ERP systems, with a focus on data quality, availability, and cybersecurity. Data Modeling, Analytics and AI Enablement Design and structure production data models to support reporting, root cause analysis, process optimization, as well as advanced analytics and AI applications, establishing the foundation for scalable data products. Technical Leadership and Consulting Provide technical guidance and advisory support to business functions, production sites, and project teams; translate business requirements into robust architectural solutions and support the implementation of data-driven and AI-enabled initiatives. Standards and Governance Establish and maintain regional standards for data models, interfaces, documentation, and governance to ensure consistency, traceability, compliance, and reusability across the organization. Global Collaboration and Continuous Development Collaborate within an international network of sites, experts, and stakeholders; contribute to and drive global roadmaps; continuously advance the production data architecture in line with business and technology developments. AI and Agentic AI Solution Development Drive the design, development, and industrialization of AI-ML based and agentic AI-based solutions tailored to manufacturing operations, including predictive analytics, intelligent process control, and decision-support systems. External Innovation and Partnerships Identify, evaluate, and manage partnerships with external vendors, startups, and technology providers to incorporate advanced, manufacturing-specific AI and digital solutions into the operational ecosystem. What We Look For Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data engineering, Data Science / Artificial Intelligence or a comparable scientific or technical field. Working Experience: Min. 5 years of professional experience in data architecture, data integration, industrial data platforms or advanced analytics, ideally in a global production-related environment. Experience in designing scalable data architectures and a good understanding of data quality, governance, information security and standardization. Technical & Professional Knowledge / Others: Strong understanding of production processes and industrial system landscapes as well as solid knowledge of integrating IT and OT systems and relevant standards such as ISA-95, OPC or MQTT. Strong knowledge of data processing, data modeling and data analysis as well as technologies such as Python, SQL, ETL/ELT concepts and modern data platforms. Knowledge of Databricks platform, Agentic AI, Machine Learning techniques, including decision tree learning, clustering, artificial neural networks, etc., and their pros and cons. Strong communication and facilitation skills, confidence in working with global stakeholders, a strong team orientation, as well as a high degree of initiative and structuring capability. Very good written and spoken Chinese and English skills. jobs.name: Auditor, Corporate Audit
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities. About The Role Why does this position exist?  With what permanent objectives? Corporate Audit supports the BASF Board of Executive Directors in its responsibility to perform supervisory, steering and control activities. It is an integral part of BASF’s internal control and risk management system. It has teams spread over 3 continents of the globe. This position will be a part of the Asia-Pacific hub of the global Corporate Audit function. How Will You Do It We are seeking for an experienced Internal Auditor who possesses strong set of internal audit skills including resilience and agility, business acumen, and critical thinking to join our team. Your role will involve conducting audits with a resilient and agile approach to assess the effectiveness of our organization's risk management, control, and governance processes and recommend improvements. You will also be responsible for conducting audits of our organization's financial and operational processes to identify areas for improvement and provide recommendations to enhance efficiency and effectiveness of the process. It is also expected that you actively collaborate with Global experts (Domain Owners/ SPOCs) as regional subject matter expert for specific audit topic/ risk aspect. Main Task : Execute the internal audit plan in accordance with established audit standards and procedures. Evaluate the effectiveness of the organization's risk management, control, and governance processes. Conduct audits of the organization's financial and operational processes to identify areas for improvement. Provide value adding recommendations to enhance efficiency, effectiveness, and compliance with policies and procedures. Communicate audit observation and recommendations to management and other stakeholders. Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate and engage with stakeholders at all levels. Monitor the implementation of audit recommendations and provide guidance as needed. Stay up to date with changes in laws, regulations, and industry best practices. Maintain integrity and ethical behaviour, conduct unbiased audits, ensuring transparency, compliance, confidentiality, professionalism, and teamwork mindset in the role. What We Look For Education: Chartered Accountant, Chemical Engineer, or Data Scientist. Preferable Candidate should have Professional Certifications such as: required CIA (Certified Internal Audit) – or work in progress, optional CFE (Certified Fraud Examiner), CISA (Certified Information System Audit) Working Experience 4 – 7 Years experience. Preferably worked on international assignments and working in diverse cultures of team members. Exposure to industries that are manufacturing based preferably chemical companies. Travel Requirement Travel requirement would be ~30%. Approx. 6 to 7 audits per annum with fieldwork for each audit ~3 to 4 weeks. Depending on the audit scope, a site fieldwork, may require travel between 1 - 3 weeks. Orther Proven experience in internal auditing, demonstrating resilience, agility, and critical thinking. Strong understanding of business dynamics that comes with complex organization, financial principles, and internal control frameworks. You will need to possess the aptitude to understand the intricacies of business dynamics, enabling you to provide valuable insights that strengthen the organization's management processes. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify risks and propose effective solutions. Ability to embracing technology and data analytics. With the increasing volume of data and the complexity of business operations, you will leverage data analytics tools to enhance audit efficiency and effectiveness. Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks simultaneously. Work Location Godrej One - Vikroli (Mumbai)

Our culture is built on trust, collaboration, and a shared commitment to continuous growth - both for the business and for the individuals within it.At BASF, your development never stands still.
