jobs.name: Category Buyer ( Site and Business services )
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities. About The Role Support procurement activities for BASF Global Digital (GD) and Global Business (GB) Service Centres being established in Hyderabad. Manage procurement for large and complex offices and sites with multiple production units, businesses, and functions, including Site and Business Services across BASF locations beyond Hyderabad. Contribute to the development, implementation, and monitoring of regional category strategies covering Site and Business Services (e.g., Facility Management, Fleet, HR Services, Marketing & Communications, and Legal). Oversee contract implementation and performance monitoring. Drive category management initiatives to achieve cost efficiencies and value creation. Execute supplier management, including performance evaluation and relationship management. Ensure vendor compliance with human rights practices in line with applicable country laws and regulations. Manage Procure-to-Pay (P2P) processes effectively. How Will You Do It Supplier Management: Monitor supplier performance to ensure alignment with BASF standards on quality, quantity, and service responsiveness. Maintain strong supplier relationships through regular communication and drive corrective actions using established performance management tools when required. Provide regular updates to internal stakeholders on market dynamics, including pricing trends, supply risks, supplier performance, and insights. Identify and develop new suppliers through market research and analysis to support business growth, including supplier evaluation, commercial negotiations, contracting, and onboarding. Supplier Qualification: Identify and develop new supplier sources, with a strong focus on local vendors in Hyderabad. Lead supplier audits and qualification processes in collaboration with technical teams. Source-to-Contract (S2C) Management: Manage the end-to-end S2C process using BASF procurement tools (e.g., SAP Ariba, Mercanis). Take full ownership of bidding processes for medium- to high-value purchases, including documentation, evaluation, and award. Procure-to-Pay (P2P) Management: Oversee the complete P2P cycle, including purchase orders (via SAP), contract execution (including paper-based agreements where applicable), and vendor payments. Negotiation & Cost Management: Develop and execute negotiation strategies for high-value contracts, with a strong focus on achieving EBIT savings in line with BASF policies. Category Management – Business & Site Services: Lead S2C activities for Business Services categories, including: HR services (manpower outsourcing, recruitment) Marketing services (events, promotions, corporate communications) Legal and professional consulting services Maintain deep category knowledge across site services (facility management, leasing, fleet management) and business support functions. Compliance & Governance: Ensure adherence to human rights, governance, and regulatory requirements, particularly in manpower outsourcing for manufacturing and business operations. Manage internal and external audits and ensure compliance across all assigned procurement activities. Market Intelligence & Strategy: Continuously monitor market trends, cost developments, and supplier landscapes through data analysis and external engagement. Translate insights into procurement strategies and provide forecasts on cost and supply impacts to relevant stakeholders. Stakeholder & Supplier Communication: Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external suppliers to ensure effective implementation of BASF procurement policies and procedures. Additional Responsibilities & Requirements Operate under the functional guidance of the Regional Category Manager. Execute supplier and risk management strategies as defined, including performance evaluation, innovation initiatives, and mitigation plans. Report negotiation outcomes and procurement performance metrics. Collaborate closely with headquarters in Mumbai and regional teams in Shanghai. Preferred Experience Strong knowledge of the Hyderabad market is an advantage. Experience managing procurement for large multinational corporate offices (GCCs, GSCs, shared services centers). Exposure to large-scale office environments (approx. 100,000 sq. ft., 2,000–3,000 headcount). Experience in office interiors procurement is an added advantage. What We Look For Education: Master’s degree with a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience, or Bachelor’s degree with at least 10 years of experience across two relevant roles. An MBA / CPSM/CIPS is an added advantage. Professional Experience: Proven experience in Procurement, preferably within a corporate or multinational environment. Core Competencies: Strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills In-depth knowledge of suppliers, market dynamics, products, and technologies within relevant categories Good understanding of Business Services, including HR, Marketing, Corporate Communications, Legal, and engagement of professional consultants Language Proficiency: Fluency in English and Hindi Knowledge of regional language (Telugu) is an added advantage Technical Skills: Proficiency in SAP systems (e.g., SAP R/3, Cobalt, SAP Business Warehouse, Strategic Procurement Suite) Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint Familiarity with digital tools such as Copilot and Power BI

jobs.name: Product Safety (Senior Specialist I)
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities. Do you want to work with passionate teams, providing excellent business and digital services to the Asia Pacific region? Do you want an open, supportive, and caring working environment? Do you view your development needs seriously as we do? If YES, then take your career to the #NextLevel with BASF ! O bjectives of the Position Deliver Product Safety services, demonstrating intermediate to advance competencies in the specific Chemical Regulations, and/or Product Stewardship skillset Lead discussion for the designated services with various stakeholders such as supply chain, customer services and technical experts for execution and/or improvement actions of related compliance measures Continuous improvement for designated work processes and communication processes, including change management Guide related member(s) in performing routine tasks for designated services Main Areas of Responsibilities Product Safety Asia Pacific is an integrated expertise platform for steering compliant and safe product across the entire product value chain for BASF. We provide effective & efficient standard services and customized professional expertise services for various business and cross regions. As Senior Specialist with designated expertise on BASF Product Safety compliance framework, to execute chemical regulation and product safety related compliance measures for BASF companies. Collaborate closely with team for excellence services and active participation in operation excellence activities and initiatives. Execute related Product Safety services deliverables, including chemical regulation operational compliance measures through close collaboration among team and cross sub-team, including timely addressing non-conformance management. Monitor related regulatory reporting and review compliance relevant areas against business processes predefined criteria Evaluate, analyze and verify product regulatory data and compliance documentation for system and database compliance monitoring and maintenance Assist team members in learning and issues troubleshooting related to the service delivery including communication with internal stakeholder and other business partners As part of region specialist on BASF Product Safety Compliance framework, to assess risk and ensure related regulatory activities are executed timely and in accordance to the requirements. Active execution of knowledge exchange on best practices and training within sub-team and cross team. Lead quality checks, including non-conformance monitoring and active participation in improvement initiatives. Take part as key focal to support internal and external audit, including execution of improvement measures. Ensure timely review, update and improvement related work documentation by team, such as work guide, process description, etc. Job Requirements University degree, Master’s degree in scientific area, preferably in Chemistry, or related Science discipline At least 3-4 years of relevant experience in Chemical Regulation, Product Regulatory Affairs, or related fields focused on Product Safety and Stewardship activities. Technical & Professional Knowledge Excellent analytical abilities with a keen attention to detail. Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with a result-oriented mindset. Sound knowledge in Chemistry and regulations Good understanding on global and local chemical legislation system, master data system, supply chain processes and business processes of BASF Fluent in written and spoken English Proactive and be able to work under pressure and independently The BASF Service Hub Kuala Lumpur (BASF Asia-Pacific Service Centre Sdn Bhd) is strategically located in the capital city of Malaysia. Since its inception in 2005, the hub has expanded from 130 employees to over 1,300 employees currently and is expected to keep growing. As an ISO 9001:2005 certified organization, the Service Hub Kuala Lumpur is committed to delivering high quality expertise and services in finance, people, supply chain, EHSQ (environment, health, safety, quality), product safety and digital. We take pride in providing our business services to BASF companies and affiliates across 20 markets in the Asia Pacific region and beyond. Moreover, we offer our services in 8 different languages to cater to the diverse needs of our stakeholders. Our focus on competency and technology-driven solutions allows us to consistently deliver exceptional services, thereby contributing to the success of our businesses. BASF also has two other regional hubs located in Berlin, Germany, and Montevideo, Uruguay, which cover the European and American regions. BASF Service Hub Kuala Lumpur was recognized with nine prestigious awards in 2024, reflecting its commitment to creating a vibrant, inclusive, and empowering workplace. These awards include winning the title of Operational Excellence in HR at the GBS Asia Awards 2024, multiple accolades at the Life at Work Awards 2024, where the hub was recognized as First Runner-up for Workplace Excellence (International Organization) and CEO Champion (International Organization), as well as Second Runner-up for Best International Organization. The hub also won the title for Excellence in Learning Tech Advancement System and a Certificate of Excellence in Talent Management and Leadership at the HRD Awards 2024. Furthermore, the hub secured a Bronze Award for Excellence in Digital Transformation at the HR Excellence Awards 2024 and received a Bronze Award for Human Resources Impact and an Honorary Award for Creative Talent Management Impact at the SSON Impact Awards Asia 2024. At BASF, we create chemistry for a sustainable future. Our ambition: We want to be the preferred chemical company to enable our customers’ green transformation. We combine economic success with environmental protection and social responsibility. Around 112,000 employees in the BASF Group contribute to the success of our customers in nearly all sectors and almost every country in the world. Our portfolio comprises, as core businesses, the segments Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, and Nutrition & Care; our standalone businesses are bundled in the segments Surface Technologies and Agricultural Solutions. BASF generated sales of €65.3 billion in 2024. BASF shares are traded on the stock exchange in Frankfurt (BAS) and as American Depositary Receipts (BASFY) in the United States. Further information at www.basf.com .

jobs.name: IAM Architect - Identity & Access Management (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
WELCOME TO OUR TEAM In the Coatings division, we focus on developing, producing, and marketing innovative coating solutions – from applied surface technologies to automotive paints. We drive innovation, design, and new applications to meet the needs of our partners worldwide in globally connected teams. This portfolio is complemented by “Beyond Paint Solutions,” enabling new surfaces and advanced materials WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT As an IAM Architect, you are responsible for designing, evolving, and ensuring the effective implementation of our global Identity & Access Management (IAM) landscape. You combine strategic architecture ownership with hands-on expertise, acting as the IT-Infrastructure key interface between internal teams (esp. Cybersecurity, SAP, Applications, business units) and Managed Service Providers (MSP). In cooperation with the MSP, you ensure that IAM solutions are secure, scalable, and aligned with business and compliance requirements. You will take ownership across the following IAM domains: Entra ID / Azure AD, Access Governance, SSO, MFA, PIM/PAM, Joiner–Leaver–Mover Integration, Password Management Vault, PKI & Key Management. Your key responsibilities include: Define and evolve the global IAM strategy together with security and infrastructure experts Design end-to-end IAM architecture across all identity lifecycle processes (Joiner–Mover–Leaver) Act as professional counterpart towards MSPs: steer and govern external service delivery Ensure stable, secure, and compliant IAM operations as well as integration with enterprise architecture (I&O Platform, applications, cloud) Provide hands-on expertise in solution design, integrations, and complex troubleshooting scenarios Support and advise projects and business stakeholders on IAM-related topics WHAT YOU OFFER Degree in computer science, business informatics, or comparable qualification Several years of practical experience in IAM, ideally in an international industrial environment with strong SAP footprint Broad expertise as an IAM generalist across multiple domains Hands-on experience across core IAM domains, leveraging solutions such as Entra ID, SailPoint, CyberArk, SuccessFactors & ServiceNow, Keeper and DigiCert Strong expertise in: Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD Identity Governance solutions (e.g., SailPoint, One Identity) Authentication protocols (SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect) Directory services (LDAP, Active Directory) Cloud platforms (Azure, & AWS) Experience working with and steering Managed Service Providers Solid understanding of IT infrastructure and hybrid cloud environments Strong collaboration mindset with willingness to work closely with international teams and travel to sites esp. headquarter Münster, Germany Ability to translate business requirements into pragmatic, scalable solutions Structured, self-driven, and solution-oriented working style Strong communication skills and experience working in global teams Fluent in Spanish and English WHAT WE OFFER Continuous learning and career development through our internal job opportunities. A safe work environment where we actively promote your health and well-being. Subsidized canteen on site. Free company shuttle service between Alcalá and Marchamalo. Competitive compensation package including a fixed salary and performance-based variable pay. Opportunities to connect outside the office and stay active through company sports groups. Flexible benefits package, which can be allocated voluntarily to transportation, training, childcare, and more. Financial support for schooling and additional benefits for families. HOW TO REACH US Submit your CV in English through the job posting so we can get to know each other. If your profile matches, our Spanish Talent Acquisition team based in Germany will contact you (phone prefix +49) and guide you through the process. With each step, you’ll be closer to meeting your future team! If you have any questions about the process, feel free to contact Liliana (liliana-marcela.quiroga-duarte@basf.com*). *Please note that we will not be able to accept applications via this email address. Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief. Impulsamos la innovación, el diseño y nuevas aplicaciones para satisfacer las necesidades de nuestros clientes y socios en todo el mundo, trabajando en equipos globales e interconectados. Nuestra cartera se complementa con “Beyond Paint Solutions” , una propuesta que va más allá de la pintura tradicional para crear nuevas superficies y materiales avanzados. LO QUE PUEDES ESPERAR Como IAM Architect, serás responsable de diseñar, evolucionar y garantizar la correcta implementación de nuestro entorno global de Identity & Access Management (IAM). Combinarás la visión estratégica de arquitectura con conocimientos técnicos prácticos, actuando como interlocutor clave de IT Infrastructure entre los equipos internos —especialmente Cybersecurity, SAP, Applications y las unidades de negocio— y los proveedores de servicios gestionados (MSP). En colaboración con el MSP, asegurarás que las soluciones IAM sean seguras, escalables y estén alineadas con los requisitos del negocio y de cumplimiento normativo. Asumirás la responsabilidad en los siguientes ámbitos de IAM: Entra ID / Azure AD, Access Governance, SSO, MFA, PIM/PAM, integración Joiner–Leaver–Mover, Password Management Vault, PKI y Key Management. Tus principales responsabilidades incluirán: Definir y evolucionar la estrategia global de IAM junto con los expertos de seguridad e infraestructura. Diseñar la arquitectura IAM end-to-end en todos los procesos del ciclo de vida de identidades: Joiner–Mover–Leaver. Actuar como contraparte profesional frente a los MSP, coordinando y supervisando la prestación de servicios externos. Garantizar operaciones IAM estables, seguras y conformes, así como su integración con la arquitectura empresarial, incluyendo I&O Platform, aplicaciones y cloud. Aportar experiencia práctica en el diseño de soluciones, integraciones y resolución de incidencias complejas. Dar soporte y asesoramiento a proyectos y stakeholders de negocio en temas relacionados con IAM. LO QUE OFRECES Titulación universitaria en Informática, Informática de Gestión o una cualificación equivalente. Varios años de experiencia práctica en Identity & Access Management (IAM), idealmente en un entorno industrial internacional con una fuerte presencia de SAP. Amplios conocimientos como profesional generalista de IAM, abarcando múltiples áreas de especialización. Experiencia práctica en los principales ámbitos de IAM, utilizando soluciones como Entra ID, SailPoint, CyberArk, SuccessFactors, ServiceNow, Keeper y DigiCert. Sólidos conocimientos en: Soluciones de Identity Governance (por ejemplo, SailPoint o One Identity) Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD Protocolos de autenticación (SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect) Servicios de directorio (LDAP, Active Directory) Plataformas cloud (Azure y AWS) Experiencia trabajando con y coordinando Managed Service Providers (MSP). Conocimientos sólidos de infraestructura IT y entornos híbridos en la nube. Alta capacidad de colaboración y disposición para trabajar estrechamente con equipos internacionales y viajar a diferentes centros de trabajo, especialmente a la sede central en Münster (Alemania). Capacidad para transformar requisitos de negocio en soluciones prácticas, escalables y sostenibles. Estilo de trabajo estructurado, autónomo y orientado a la búsqueda de soluciones.Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y experiencia trabajando en equipos globales. Nivel fluido de Español e inglés. LO QUE OFRECEMOS Formación continua y desarrollo profesional con nuestras vacantes internas. Entorno seguro y donde promovemos tu salud. Ticket restaurante. Oferta económica competitiva con un salario base más un variable por buen desempeño. Modelo híbrido de trabajo y adaptar tus horarios, según tus circunstancias. Conectar fuera de la oficina y practicar deportes con compañeros/as mediante Grupos de empresa. Retribución flexible que puedes destinar voluntariamente a servicios de transporte, formación, guardería, etc. Planes de pensiones, seguro de vida y accidentes, préstamos personales y participar en programa de acciones de la compañía. Ayudas económicas para la escolarización y otras medidas para las familias. CÓMO CONTACTAR CON NUESTRO EQUIPO Envía tu CV en inglés a través de la oferta para poder conocernos. jobs.name: Assistant Manager - EHS
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities. Main responsibilities EHS Management System Gap analysis and implementation for the new EHS regulation and requirement. Maintains EHS management system (IMS) and documentations. Support to implement EHS standards to compliance according local and BASF requirement. Define training needs, coordinate/arranges/delivery EHS training. Introduce and initiate country EHS TA together with site TA. Work with the country EHS to deliver competitive, reliable and high quality EHS services according to site needs. Benchmarks the EHS performances in the site (i.e. Initiates measures and proposals to contain the potential issues and continuously improves EHS standards of the Sites). Stakeholder Management Interfaces with site management & Business unit. Interfaces with local industry groups on behalf of BASF for issue management and advocacy. Represents BASF to participant local industry organization. Dialogues regularly with site managements to evaluate level of service, prioritizes & allocates resources and improves effectively and efficiency of the EHS service. Implement service catalogue and conducts service dialogue with site and business unit to fine-tune the service scopes. TDS (Transportation & Distribution Safety) Ensure safety and security standards for all modes of transportation are implementing and compliance. Nomination as Country/Site Dangerous Goods Safety Advisor. Training and Guidance to TDS related personnel involved in distribution safety processes. Conduct TDS Reviews for all Responsible person. Conduct Safety and Quality Assessments of suppliers, service providers and customers that transport or store our raw materials or goods. Incorporation of Transportation and Distribution Safety Performance in the Procurement Process. Carrier/Trucker Qualification Checks and Performance Evaluation. Incident Investigation, Corrective Actions and Reporting. ER (Emergency Response) Nomination as Country Emergency Expert. Assist to develop, review On-site Emergency Response Plans and scenario, fire prevention concept and compliance to legal and BASF requirement. Conduct Fire prevention assessment and fire prevention concept to meet as per requirement. Provide expertise to support and review for fire prevention design and equipment installation. Crisis and Security Management Nomination as Country/Local Security Manager as per BASF requirement. Provide expertise to support Site Security concept. Conduct self-assessment site security and security risk assessment. Coordinate with regional team to provide security review. Lead to investigate security incident. Develop and prepare readiness Country Incident Management. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in EHS, Science, Engineering, Production, Chemical Engineering, or a related field is required. A Master’s degree or PhD is an advantage. At least 5 years of experience in production, engineering, or EHS is required. Leadership experience is an advantage. A professional-level Safety Officer must hold at least a Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health and Safety or a related field. Proficiency in both spoken and written English is required. Strong communication and management skills, familiarity with local EHS legislation and legal requirements, and a solid understanding of EHS unit scope and functions are required. Work location Emporium office, Bangkok BASF has been present in Thailand for more than 50 years. The company offers a wide range of products and solutions to support almost all the key industries in the country, including Agricultural Solutions, Intermediates and Process Catalysts, Monomers, Petrochemicals, Coatings, Dispersions and Resins, Performance Chemicals, Care Chemicals, Nutrition and Health, and Performance Materials. BASF in Thailand was established in 1966 and maintains its head office in Bangkok. It operates three production sites in Samutprakarn, Chonburi and Rayong, an Automotive Coatings Technical Competence Center, and a Performance Materials Technical Development Center in Samutprakarn. In 2024, BASF posted sales of €531 million to customers in Thailand and had 623 employees as of the end of the year. Further information is available on www.basf.com/th .

jobs.name: Technical Sales Manager- Advanced Metallization
jobs.description: Now hiring! Technical Sales Manager- Advanced Metallization Hillsboro, OR (Onsite) Come create chemistry with us! The Technical Sales Manager – Advanced Metallization will join BASF’s Electronic Materials team, focusing on driving growth and innovation in metallization solutions for advanced semiconductor manufacturing. This role is responsible for managing customer and equipment supplier projects, identifying new business opportunities, and supporting the development and commercialization of next-generation metallization products (e.g., copper, cobalt, ruthenium, and related chemistries for sub-10nm nodes and advanced packaging). At BASF Electronic Materials, we uphold a relentless passion to innovate the future of electronics with our customers by equipping them with the essential solutions and technologies to continuously succeed in the competitive electronics industry. BASF has been supplying electronic materials for more than 30 years. The experience we have earned and the chemical expertise we possess enables us to offer outstanding products and solutions to our customers. At BASF, we offer high purity and quality process chemicals and specialized solutions for semiconductors, flat panel displays, and lighting such as LED. With our team of passionate, dedicated experts from all facets of the industry fields working closely with our customers worldwide, we are steadfast in our philosophy to deliver the quality excellence, reliable services, and innovative solutions that exceed the highest standards. As a Technical Sales Manager- Advanced Metallization, you create chemistry by... As a Technical Sales Manager - Advanced Metallization, you create chemistry by... Identify industry trends, unmet customer needs, and key growth drivers in advanced metallization for semiconductor devices. Lead cross-functional projects with US customers and equipment suppliers (e.g., deposition tool vendors), ensuring timely execution and alignment with global technical teams. Evaluate business potential and secure new opportunities by launching new products or expanding existing product lines. Initiate and foster strategic collaborations with customers and tool suppliers to accelerate innovation and adoption of BASF’s metallization solutions. Gather and analyze market intelligence on emerging technologies, customer requirements, and competitive landscape. Provide technical support for new applications and product development, working closely with R&D, sales, and manufacturing teams. Translate customer and market requirements into actionable product specifications and project plans. Inspire creativity and manage abstract concepts in a highly collaborative, global environment. If you have... Experience with semiconductor industry standards, advanced node requirements (sub-10nm) and/or advanced packaging. Familiarity with process integration and qualification of metallization materials Management experience in directing, coordinating and managing team activities to accomplish highly technical tasks. Bachelor’s degree or higher in Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field. Minimum 10 years of experience in the semiconductor industry, with a focus on metallization, film deposition (CVD, PVD, ALD), electrochemical plating, or advanced packaging. Proven track record of managing complex technical projects and collaborating with leading semiconductor manufacturers and/or equipment suppliers. Strong technical communication skills, with the ability to convey detailed requirements and results to both technical and non-technical audiences. Demonstrated leadership and influencing skills in cross-functional, multicultural teams. Self-starter with excellent organizational skills and the ability to work independently. Willingness to travel up to 25%. Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF . We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us As one of the largest chemical companies in North America we have been finding solutions for your everyday needs and addressing the most complex economic, environmental, and sustainability challenges for more than 150 years! At BASF we empower our employees with the tools, guidance and opportunities they need to advance and succeed in work and life. Giving you the support you need to be your best and fulfill your personal ambitions is what helps us create chemistry. After all, our success is linked to yours. Whatever path you envision, BASF is a great place to build a rewarding, successful career. Belong to Something Bigger. #belongatBASF Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. Equal employment opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

jobs.name: Senior Specialist Digitalization Digital Plant (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF Our GDD/D – Digitalization of Operations unit implements digital technologies and applications in production plants. This enables us to increase production effectiveness. At the same time, processes become more efficient and safer. RESPONSIBILITIES Our goal is the implementation of digital technologies and applications in chemical plants, to improve work processes and increase the production efficiency. As a part of the global Digital Plant team you will coordinate the creation of a digital, intelligently linked representation of a real asset – the so-called digital twin. The digital twin will therefore enable many future use cases in other products like augmented reality or artificial intelligence. Your activities will include the digitalization of a real plant, by following a standardized and proven procedure create validated 2D- and 3D-data. The implementation of the necessary technology, digital workflows and roles within the whole organization of a plant and the respective service providers will be part of your activities, too. You will guide users how to use digital methods and processes during the asset lifecycle, to raise the potentials of cost and lead time reduction combined with quality increase in engineering, construction, brownfield projects, plant modifications, maintenance, TARM and operations. On the way to the digital asset lifecycle, you will offer change management support, accompanied by training and coaching on easy-to-use tools and enhanced digital processes. QUALIFICATIONS Master Degree in Chemical/Process Engineering or Mechanical Engineering Minimum 3+ years’ experience in planning or construction of or in chemical plants Experience in usage of digital tools and methods in data driven engineering projects Very good project management and coordination skills Ideally working Experience in international projects and agil methods The will and ability to drive change and an entrepreneurial spirit Creative and motivated working style with a strong focus on innovation Ability to work in a multicultural and virtual team Excellent communication skills in English WHAT WE OFFER A secure work environment because your health, safety and wellbeing is always our top priority. Flexible work schedule and Home-office options, so that you can balance your working life and private life. Learning and development opportunities 25 holiday days per year 5 additional days (readjustment) A collaborative, trustful and innovative work environment Being part of an international team and work in global projects Relocation assistance to Madrid provided At BASF, the chemistry is right Because we are counting on innovative solutions, sustainable actions, connected thinking and on you, become a part of our formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.At BASF, we are committed to upholding and ensuring compliance with company standards related to quality, environment, health, safety, and energy, in line with our global guidelines.We actively promote a culture of prevention and continuous improvement, encouraging collaboration in initiatives related to quality, environmental protection, health, safety, and energy performance.We foster responsible energy use, promoting efficiency in daily operations and supporting the identification of improvement projects and energy-saving opportunities

jobs.name: Global Strategic Marketing Manager
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities. About The Role Global Business Management Hydrogenation & Specialty Catalysts, we are promoting and selling catalysts based on a profound market research. We are developing and advertising new products to drive sustainable innovations together with our customers . How Will You Do It Strategic Market & Portfolio Management Define and drive the global market strategy for the assigned market segment, ensuring alignment with overall business objectives and long-term growth ambitions. Manage and continuously optimize the product portfolio, including prioritization of strategic focus areas and lifecycle decisions. Identify and evaluate new applications, adjacent markets, and growth opportunities to expand the business footprint. Market Intelligence, Data Management & Customer Insights Establish, maintain, and continuously enhance a structured market intelligence database for the assigned segments, ensuring availability of reliable and up-to-date market data. Develop a deep understanding of market dynamics by analyzing market size, growth trends, demand drivers, and value chains. Monitor competitor activities, including pricing strategies, capacity developments, and market positioning. Derive actionable insights from industry trends and customer needs to inform strategic decision-making. Value Proposition & Pricing Strategy Develop differentiated, customer-centric global value propositions that clearly position products in target markets. Define and implement pricing strategies, including value-based pricing concepts and regional adaptations, to maximize profitability and competitiveness. Ensure consistent positioning and messaging across regions and applications. Go-to-Market & Demand Generation Design and lead global go-to-market strategies, including the development of impactful marketing campaigns and coherent messaging frameworks. Coordinate and manage global product launches, ensuring cross-functional alignment and successful market introduction. Support demand generation by strengthening market visibility and customer engagement. Sales Enablement & Cross-Functional Collaboration Equip regional sales teams with effective tools and materials, such as pitch decks, use-case driven content, and application-focused messaging. Collaborate closely with sales, technology, and other relevant functions to ensure alignment between market needs, product capabilities, and commercial strategies. Act as a central interface between global and regional teams to ensure consistent execution of strategies. What We Look For Master's degree in economics or business administration or chemistry, chemical engineering. 5-8 year professional experience within business environment Good knowledge of commercial marketing or product marketing mandatory Strong entrepreneurial drive and willingness to take difficult decisions. Deep P&L and business expertise required. Innovative and solution-oriented mindset to drive and implement creative, out-of-the-box ideas. Excellent communication, negotiation and influencing skills (including English). Strong change management, interpersonal skills, and deep organizational awareness. Strong project steering and management Work Location Godrej One - Vikhorli

jobs.name: Production Engineer
jobs.description: Objective of the Position Responsible for ensuring day-to-day plant operations run smoothly, with a strong focus on daily production safety, process reliability, quality, and regulatory compliance, while optimizing asset utilization and production efficiency. Assist the Production Manager in ensuring the operation of the production section is carried out on time according to EHS, quality and other agreed requirements. Key in driving continuous improvement, cross-shift standardization, and effective problem-solving to sustain high-performance operations. Main Areas of Responsibilities and Key Activies EHS Strictly comply with and implement the company's EHS policies and ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 certification requirements. Guide and ensure shift operations to strictly follow SOPs regarding safety, environment, and occupational health in their operations. Take appropriate measures for any safety, environmental, or occupational health incidents and report to the Production Manager as per procedures. Using personal protective equipment (PPE) according to the Safe Work Guidelines or PPE Matrix Carry out emergency actions as required by procedures during emergency response events. Operations Ensure all environmental, health and safety rules and guidelines are being adhered to and maintained by the production personnel. Providing technical and operational leadership to support day-to-day plant operations, ensuring safe execution of production plans in full compliance with BASF Process Safety standards, and applicable environmental regulation. Acting as a technical authority and trusted advisor to Operations, leading complex troubleshooting efforts and guiding Daily Operations teams toward effective, sustainable solutions for process, production, quality, and EHS challenges. Driving continuous improvement initiatives using Lean Six Sigma methodologies to improve asset efficiency, optimize equipment cycle times, reduce waste, and sustain nameplate production capacity. Influencing cross shift standardization, cost optimization, and asset performance by working collaboratively with Operations, Maintenance, and Asset Effectiveness teams to align priorities and maximize plant utilization. Leading cross functional coordination and technical input for inspections, outages, capital projects, and investigations (RCA, NCM), partnering with Engineering, Maintenance, Quality, and Regulatory teams to prevent repeat incidents and improve first pass quality. Lead production team in trial production of new products and internal test products (PTO). To check and revise if necessary; HIRA, Procedures, Working Instructions, and Work Checklists. Manage the inventory of materials and tools, including staging materials for production and packaging by conducting periodic stock counts. Support on evaluating training needs for the operation, to ensure they are provided the adequate training for operation and continuous improvement. Responsible as 5S leader coordinator for Production Department. Review process condition and downtime report, GAP reporting and propose for improvement. Represent the Production Manager on production matter during the Production Manager absence. Ensure effectiveness of the implementation audit for Integrated Management System (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001) and IATF 16949 Quality Management System for the automotive industry. Ensure good housekeeping and proper handovers among shift team members. Other production-related tasks assigned by superiors. Job Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Polymers Science or Chemical Engineering. At least 5 - 8 years’ of experience in delivering technical expertise in a plastics compounding manufacturing plant. Posses demonstrated track record of leading through influence, providing expert technical guidance, and partnering with Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, and EHS teams to achieve safe and reliable plant performance. Proficient in production management software (e.g., ERP systems, MES). Hold strong production and operations background with the ability to independently support troubleshooting, root cause failure analysis, and investigations across Production, EHS and Quality. Have proven continuous improvement capability, including practical application of Lean Six Sigma methodologies to drive efficiency, waste reduction, asset utilization, and sustained nameplate performance. Highly effective collaborator with strong attention to detail and communication skills, able to coordinate complex activities and influence priorities across cross functional teams without formal supervisory authority. Knowledgeable on ISO 9001, ISO 14001, TS 16949 and ISO 45001 requirements. BASF has been present in Malaysia since 1989, and operates a manufacturing plant in Pasir Gudang, Johor. BASF’s Regional Service Hub in Kuala Lumpur provides functional support services to BASF companies in 20 markets across Asia Pacific. BASF also provides infrastructure and utilities support services to its joint ventures BASF PETRONAS Chemicals and Toray BASF Resins at an integrated Verbund site situated in the Gebeng Industrial Zone, Pahang. BASF posted sales to customers in Malaysia of approximately €340 million in 2024 and had 2,579 employees as of the end of the year. Further information is available on www.basf.com/my

jobs.name: Global Customs Operations & Performance Management (Manager)
jobs.description: O bjectives of the Position Lead and oversee the team in delivering customs services, including customs verification and documentation review, ensuring alignment with service expectations. Foster strong relationships with internal business partners by understanding their requirements and delivering high-quality, collaborative, and responsive support. Coordinate effectively with external service providers to ensure seamless operations and alignment with service standards through proactive engagement and collaboration. Manage quality assurance related to overseas delivery services, ensuring timely resolution and continuous improvement. Oversee risk management activities for the team, including access control, data protection, business continuity planning, and regular risk assessments. Drive knowledge management initiatives by maintaining up-to-date documentation, facilitating structured reviews, and assigning clear process ownership to ensure knowledge retention. Monitor team performance, provide regular coaching and guidance, and support professional development to achieve operational excellence. M ain Areas of Responsibilities and Key Activities 1.  Customs Services Define goals and target for the team to support business as usual Stay updated on changes to country-specific regulations and requirements to ensure compliance with all services. Maintain up-to-date knowledge of regional customs regulations and free trade agreements (FTAs). 2. Project Management Lead/ Support and coordinate customs-related projects such as system implementations, process improvements, and regulatory change initiatives. jobs.name: Technical Account Manager FCC Catalysts
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF The Catalysts Division is the world's leading supplier of environmental and process catalysts. We develop technologies for air protection, fuel production and for efficient manufacturing of chemicals and other products, including battery materials. We help our customers to be even more successful with our knowledge of precious and base metals and our passion for innovation. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Serving as the priary technical expert for FCC catalyst applications at customer sites, providing hands-on technical support, troubleshooting, unit optimization, performance improvement, and advising refinery operations and technical teams on catalyst selection and operational strategy. Conducting FCC technical evaluations, simulations, and modeling to support recommendations, customer proposals, and performance improvement initiatives. Owning full P&L responsibility for assigned FCC accounts, including volume, margin, pricing, receivables, sales forecasting, CRM management, and account planning. Developing and executing account strategies aligned with BASF’s FCC business objectives, including pricing, contract negotiations, and commercial terms with refinery customers. Identifying and capturing new FCC business opportunities within existing and new refinery accounts, expanding account penetration through relationship mapping across technical and commercial stakeholders, and positioning BASF’s FCC catalyst portfolio to maximize market share in the region. Building strong relationships with refinery engineers, operations teams, and decision-makers, acting as the interface between customers and internal BASF technical, R&D, and business teams, and representing BASF in customer meetings, technical reviews, and industry engagements. Location: Fully remote role, ideally based in Southern Europe or the Mediterranean region to ensure proximity to key refinery customers. Territory: Responsible for refinery accounts across Southern Europe and the Mediterranean area, with a dedicated focus on FCC catalyst applications. Travel: Expected travel of approximately 30–50% to visit customer sites, support technical discussions, and strengthen business relationships across the assigned region. WHAT YOU OFFER Degree (BSc/MSc/PhD) in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, or related discipline. Strong experience in refining with deep expertise in FCC operations and catalysts (mandatory). Proven track record in a customer-facing FCC technical or commercial role. Ability to perform FCC process analysis, modeling, and technical evaluations. Experience managing multiple refinery accounts in an international environment. Strong commercial mindset with demonstrated success in pricing and contract negotiations. Familiarity with Southern Europe / Mediterranean refining landscape. Expertise in FCC technology and refinery processes. Strong analytical, problem-solving capabilities and strategic thinking. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. Ability to operate independently in a remote, regional role. WHAT WE OFFER CCNL (National Chemical Collective Agreement). Gross annual salary (RAL) between €70,000 and €85,000, to be assessed based on the candidate’s skills and relevant experience. Variable bonus. Corporate welfare program. Company car for both business and personal use. High-impact regional role focused purely on FCC catalysts. Combination of technical leadership and commercial ownership. Flexible remote working within Southern Europe. Opportunity to work with leading refinery customers in the region. HOW TO REACH US Do you have questions about the selection process or the position? You can contact: talent-acquisition-italy@basf.com Initial information about the application process is available here: http://on.basf.com/applicationprocess . ABOUT US Join a global FCC leader and contribute to advancing refinery performance through technical excellence and strong customer partnerships.

jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities. Objectives of the Position Take the functional leadership of the sub-team of ID Analysis (FTIR, DSC and TGA) and failure Analysis to assist lab leader of EP Material Testing lab to manage EP material testing lab, and thus to assist head of Materials & Parts Testing to provide ID analysis and failure analysis supports to Research & Development, production, sales and marketing, business development, technical research & development and strategic objectives for company’s Engineering Plastics related PM business in China and Asia Pacific in an effective way. How You Will Do It Be responsible for operation of ID analysis (FTIR, DSC and TGA) and failure analysis related part of EP Material testing lab. Review test results; monitor progress of testing requests; participate in the process changes to be made; contribute to customer on-site audit; participate in the investigation on customer complaints on EP Material mechanical tests. Lead the execution of testing tasks and make the routine maintenance plan of equipment related to ID analysis and failure analysis of EP materials. Devise tests, procedures and apparatus required to achieve experimental results, help to develop new testing methods to meet requirements, and lead the training for new employees on ID analysis and failure analysis of EP materials. Write comprehensive reports and evaluations on the data obtained relating to ID analysis and failure analysis of EP materials. Participate in the CAPEX plan relating to ID analysis and failure analysis of EP material and execute the plan accordingly. Oversee the new equipment purchase for related tests and contact from the negotiation period of the deal. Contribute to the Asia Pacific part of global testbox program and the discussion for improve testing procedures relating to ID analysis and failure analysis. Contribute to the Asia Pacific part of testing harmonization and the global testing harmonization relating to ID analysis and failure analysis of EP materials. Contribute to the management of external resource of EP material testing relating to ID analysis and failure analysis, conduct external resource screening, audit, negotiation and monitoring. Co-operate with development/technical service/manufacturing/sales & marketing in providing technical assistance to demonstrate company products, and to solve field problems. Contribute to safety, health and environmental standards of EP & FR lab. Coordinate to maintain EP Material Testing lab to fulfil Quality Management System (ISO/IEC 17025, ISO 9001, ISO/TS 16949, etc.). What We Look For Education: Master or Bachelor in polymer chemistry, analytics chemistry, material science or other polymer or chemistry related. Working Experience: Master with more than 5 years’ experience or bachelor with more than 8 years’ experience in material analysis (more than 3 years’ experience on FTIR, DSC and TGA of EP materials) and material testing of polymer materials. Over 3 years’ supervisor or leadership experience. Over one year’s ISO 17025 experience will be plus. Technical & Professional Knowledge: Knowledge and hand-on experience on material analysis and material testing of polymer materials. Ability to deliver technical presentations in Mandarin and English. Ability to write comprehensive technical report by English. Knowledge on ISO 17025 system management will be a plus. Language: Ability to communicate with written and spoken English smoothly. 请时刻警惕任何可能的招聘欺诈行为！请注意，巴斯夫绝不会在任何情况下向候选人以任何形式收取任何费用

jobs.name: Technical Account Manager - Refinery Catalysts (m/f/d)
jobs.description: The world needs innovations, and our team needs you! BASF is the world's leading chemical company #WeCreateChemistry and one of the best places to work and develop your career. We are looking for diverse, passionate, and creative talent who wants to make a difference. BASF Española S.L. markets more than 5,000 products to meet the needs of our customers and society across a wide variety of sectors. The chemical industry is changing; and so is BASF. Discover our new strategy: #WinningWays Do you want to boost your career to the next level and create chemistry with us? WHAT YOU WILL DO By joining BASF’s Catalysts division, with exclusive focus on Fluid Catalytic Cracking (FCC) applications within refinery customers across Southern Europe and the Mediterranean region, you will be: Serving as the primary technical expert for FCC catalyst applications at customer sites. Providing hands-on technical support, including troubleshooting, unit optimization, and performance improvement. Conducting FCC technical evaluations, simulations, and modeling to support recommendations and proposals. Advising refinery operations and technical teams on catalyst selection, performance, and operational strategy. Owning full P&L responsibility for assigned FCC accounts (volume, margin, pricing, receivables). Developing and executing account strategies aligned with BASF’s FCC business objectives. Managing pricing, contract negotiations, and commercial terms with refinery customers. Delivering accurate sales forecasts and managing CRM tools for account planning. Identifying and capturing new FCC business opportunities within existing and new refinery accounts. Expanding account penetration through relationship mapping across technical and commercial stakeholders. Positioning BASF’s FCC catalyst portfolio to maximize market share in the region. Building strong relationships with refinery engineers, operations teams, and decision-makers. Acting as the interface between customers and internal BASF technical, R&D, and business teams. Representing BASF in customer meetings, technical reviews, and industry engagements. WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU University degree (BSc, MSc or PhD) in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, or related disciplines. Strong background (at least 5 years of experience) in refining with deep expertise in FCC operations and catalysts. Proven track record in a customer-facing FCC technical or commercial role with demonstrated success in pricing and contract negotiations. Ability to perform FCC process analysis, modeling, and technical evaluations. Familiarity with Southern Europe / Mediterranean refining landscape. Strong communication skills in English, both verbal and written. Knowledge on any Mediterranean language is a plus. Availability to travel ~30–50% of your working time. WHAT WE OFFER Healthy work environment : where your safety and health (both physical and mental) are always our priority. Attractive salary package : based on a fixed salary and a bonus based on performance. Flexible working model : you will be able to work remotely within the country and adjust your schedule. Flexible compensation plan : to take advantage of ser vices such as Health Insurance, Childcare, Transportation Card, and Training, among others. Professional development : we promote continuous training and access to internal vacancies to keep growing at BASF. Investments for your future: with a Pension Plan, Accident Insurance, Life Insurance, and even the opportunity to participate in the Stock Program after one year in the company. Work-life balance measures : as well as financial assistance for the schooling of children. Sports sections : where you can connect with colleagues and play football, paddle, basketball, cycling, yoga, etc. And much more. HOW TO PARTICIPATE IN THE PROCESS Send your CV through the job offer so we can get to know each other. If your profile is a match, we will call you from the Spanish Talent Acquisition team in Germany (prefix +49) and support you throughout the process. With each step, you will be closer to meeting your future team! If you have any further questions about this process, please contact: talent-acquisition-spain@basf.com * *Please note that we will not be able to accept your resume via this email. MORE ABOUT BASF We celebrate diversity and actively promote an inclusive work environment where every voice is heard, and every idea is valued, regardless of age, gender, marital status, ethnicity, religion, physical/mental condition, or sexual orientation. #BeYourself We are C reative, O pen, R esponsible and E ntrepreneurial people. This are o ur values , they guide us and describe who we are and how we act. If you identify with them, BASF is the place for you! Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.name: Senior Specialist Digitalization Digital Plant (m/f/d) 1
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF Digitalization is a true part of BASF's DNA — creating new customer experiences, driving business growth, and making processes more efficient. Global Digital Services drives BASF's digital transformation through innovative, global, high-quality digital products and a strong agile culture, and the Digital Hub Madrid is one of our key global delivery locations. We are seeking a hands-on AI Engineer for BASF's DevHub — the Internal Developer Platform (IDP) used by thousands of engineers and product teams across BASF. DevHub already ships an enterprise AI Gateway (50+ governed models, Entra ID, EU data residency, per-cost-center billing, Grafana observability) and a catalog that is a schema-validated knowledge graph of every product and its infrastructure. Your mission is to make AI a first-class platform capability: build reusable, production-grade AI services and developer experiences that help users discover, create, configure, operate, scale and govern their products, surfaced where they already work — the portal, the IDE (GitHub Copilot/MCP) and Teams. You will treat the platform as a product — shipping paved-road components other teams reuse, serving both humans and agents, with the multi-tenant scoping, cost-tracking, guardrails and governance an enterprise platform demands. RESPONSIBILITIES Treat the platform as a product. Build paved roads and self-service: reusable AI building blocks (shared retrieval/"context engine," guardrail & evaluation libraries, an MCP/tool layer), scaffolder templates, SDK/API access and stable, versioned interfaces — built once, reused across features. Ship AI experiences that delight developers. Grounded, well-cited assistants, copilots and wizards across the product lifecycle (e.g. a conversational knowledge assistant over our docs and catalog), meeting users on the portal, IDE (Copilot/MCP) and Teams via one shared API. Serve humans and agents. Expose platform capabilities through an MCP / SDK / API surface — read-first, RBAC- and tenant-aware — so internal and external AI clients can query and (later, gated) act on the platform. See the AI-Assisted Platform Strategy RFC. Own evaluation and quality. Build eval harnesses, golden tests and retrieval-quality metrics so features are correct, grounded and regression-tested in CI; invest in context engineering over model-shopping — the Gateway already solves model choice. Pick the right pattern. Prefer deterministic pipelines + structured outputs + human-in-the-loop where outcomes are structured; reserve multi-step/multi-agent orchestration (Azure AI Foundry Agent Service, LangGraph / Microsoft Agent Framework) for genuinely open-ended tasks, keeping state-changing actions gated. Strengthen MLOps / LLMOps. Improve prompt/version management, model adaptation, CI/CD and the path from experiment to production; treat prompts and retrieval as versioned, tested production assets. Build for multi-tenancy. Default to per-product / per-tenant scoping of context, tools and actions; bake in observability (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, distributed tracing) and per-product cost/FinOps visibility. Help advance security, safety & governance. Inherit platform RBAC (Entra ID / AccessIT), defend against the OWASP LLM Top 10, keep AI usage auditable, and respect BASF / EU AI Act and data-residency requirements. QUALIFICATIONS BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI, or related field. 4+ years in Software Engineering or Platform Development, with demonstrable recent experience in Generative AI and/or Agentic Systems. You don't need to tick every box. Strong Python + hands-on LLM application experience + a platform/developer-experience mindset matter most; we expect you to grow into the rest. AI / LLM engineering. Practical experience building LLM-powered applications; familiarity with RAG and agentic patterns (ReAct, plan-and-solve, multi-agent) and a clear sense of when not to use an autonomous agent. Evaluation & quality (core). Designing eval harnesses, golden tests and retrieval-quality metrics for LLM/RAG systems (grounding, retrieval precision, hallucination control); context engineering over model selection. Backend & API development. Python proficiency is highly desired (FastAPI, Pydantic, async); designing and operating production backend services and well-versioned APIs. Platform / Developer-Experience engineering. Building reusable, self-service components and paved roads (templates, SDKs, golden paths) and operating multi-tenant services in production (SLOs, observability, "you build it, you run it"). Software development across the stack. Enough context across frontend, backend, and infrastructure to contribute across DevHub's stack (with AI-assisted coding) — no need to be a full-stack expert in every layer. Cloud & infrastructure. Hands-on Azure and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes/AKS); infrastructure-as-code (HCL/Terraform, modular). Data & state management. Relational/non-relational databases (PostgreSQL) and vector stores (e.g. Azure AI Search); managing context and state at scale. DevOps & production operations. CI/CD (Git, GitHub Actions), monitoring/observability, and security best practices in production. AI / LLM ecosystem. LLM providers/APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral), managed AI services (Azure AI Foundry, Databricks), and the MCP standard. (At DevHub, models are consumed through the internal AI Gateway, not provider SDKs directly.) Security & multi-tenancy. Authentication/authorization, RBAC, tenant isolation, guardrails, auditability; awareness of the OWASP LLM Top 10. Agentic standards beyond MCP (e.g. A2A); spec-driven ("spec-kit") agentic development with AGENTS.md / skill conventions. Nice to Have Databricks / Unity Catalog — DevHub's core data platform; DevHub governs the Databricks account and environments (workspaces, Unity Catalog, blueprint lifecycle), not the Enterprise Data Lake or data distribution. Familiarity is a strong plus. TypeScript alongside Python; Grafana; MLflow and data pipelines. FinOps / cost attribution for AI features. Message queues / event-driven & data-intensive architectures (e.g. RabbitMQ, Azure Event Grid). Workflow engines / state machines; OpenTelemetry & distributed tracing. Experience with EnvoyProxy WHAT WE OFFER A secure work environment because your health, safety and wellbeing is always our top priority. Flexible work schedule and Home-office options, so that you can balance your working life and private life. Learning and development opportunities 25 holiday days per year 5 additional days (readjustment) A collaborative, trustful and innovative work environment Being part of an international team and work in global projects Relocation assistance to Madrid provided At BASF, the chemistry is right Because we are counting on innovative solutions, sustainable actions, connected thinking and on you, become a part of our formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.At BASF, we are committed to upholding and ensuring compliance with company standards related to quality, environment, health, safety, and energy, in line with our global guidelines.We actively promote a culture of prevention and continuous improvement, encouraging collaboration in initiatives related to quality, environmental protection, health, safety, and energy performance.We foster responsible energy use, promoting efficiency in daily operations and supporting the identification of improvement projects and energy-saving opportunities

jobs.description:
WELCOME If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. Please do not be confused by this: All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application will be submitted to us. At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships. We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT As a newly standalone business, we are also adapting our Controlling organization with a strong focus on value creation. As Controlling Manager – Value & Cost Controlling, you will build and lead a team that ensures financial transparency, drives performance management, and supports value-oriented steering across our global business. Your team owns three key areas: functional cost controlling, the financial steering of the company's value creation initiatives, and the controlling of our Transitional Service Agreements (TSAs) and other external service providers during the first phase of our standalone journey. As the direct finance partner for senior management on all cost and value creation topics, you play a key role in achieving the company's financial targets. In your new role, you lead and develop the Value & Cost Controlling team, foster a collaborative, business-partner-oriented culture, and ensure the delivery of accurate, timely, and decision-relevant financial insights to senior management. You further enhance reporting on primary cost controlling, implementing new allocation models and driving process automation. In addition, you oversee the financial steering of value creation initiatives, ensuring transparency on the financial impact, milestones, and progress of the company’s strategic initiatives portfolio and providing management with clear insights into status, risks, and opportunities. Furthermore, you steer the controlling of all Transitional Service Agreements (TSAs) and other external service providers, ensuring transparency on scope, costs, service levels, and timelines while supporting a smooth and timely transition into the target setup; always in close collaboration with internal stakeholders. You design and implement a robust performance management framework, including KPI definition, target setting, variance analysis, and continuous monitoring of profitability and efficiency initiatives, and you play a key role in budgeting, forecasting, and long-term planning cycles, ensuring consistent alignment between corporate strategy, financial planning, and execution. Last but not least, you partner closely with finance leadership, business units, and operational functions to identify performance improvement opportunities, support strategic and operational targets, and drive the standardization, automation, and digitalization of controlling processes to enable data-driven decision-making. WHAT YOU OFFER university degree in finance, controlling, business administration, economics, or a related field; CFA or MBA is an advantage 8–10+ years of professional experience in controlling, FP&A, or performance management within a multinational corporation, including several years in a leadership role strong analytical background, ideally complemented by experience in strategy, corporate or business development proven track record in cost controlling, profitability steering, and performance improvement; experience in service agreements or shared services controlling is a plus, as well as experience in the chemicals industry or in business transitions strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and leadership skills, with the ability to engage and influence diverse stakeholders in a multicultural environment proficiency in SAP S/4HANA, BI and planning tools such as SAC, Power BI, or Anaplan, as well as advanced MS Office skills very good language skills in English WHAT WE OFFER We offer an attractive salary with individual benefits such as performance-related bonuses. Company-funded supplementary health insurance, accident insurance and pension related benefits We offer a wide range of local and global development and career opportunities for professional and personal development Surventis stands for diversity - we are proud of our Coatings employee networks WomenInCoatings, Color Pride and CultiConnect The feedback culture is firmly integrated into our corporate culture, e.g. through regular employee surveys and management feedback At our location in Münster, we have our own fitness studio "Freizeit" with a physiotherapy practice, permanently employed company doctors, a company restaurant "Auszeit" including a café bar, a bilingual company daycare center "LackiKids" and a vacation program "LackiKids on Tour". jobs.name: AI Data Architect (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF Digital Hub Madrid attracts, grows, and develops passionate people who will meaningfully impact the digital future of BASF. Come join us and be a part of our digitalization journey. Describe your Product Mission here / objective of the role: The AI & Automation Enablement team designs and engineers scalable AI and automation solutions that deliver measurable business value. By combining strong architecture, engineering excellence, and industrialization capabilities, we enable BASF to turn opportunities into production-ready systems – consistently, reliably, and at scale. About the Job: AI Data Architect in a project-oriented team who designs scalable, enterprise-grade data architectures and leads the engineering of robust data platforms, collaborating across domains and teams to enable the development and industrialization of AI solutions that deliver measurable business value. RESPONSIBILITIES Define and own the end-to-end data architecture for AI solutions, from ingestion and storage to serving layers powering models and analytics (e.g., batch pipelines, real-time APIs). Design the data foundations for compound AI systems, including retrieval architectures (e.g. RAG), vector and knowledge stores, and feature/embedding layers. Establish data modelling standards, semantic layers, and reusable reference architectures across workloads (batch, streaming, real-time, analytical, AI-driven) across the organization. Define and enforce governance frameworks for data quality, lineage, security, and compliance, ensuring trustworthy and well-managed data products. Set architectural guidelines and best practices for scalable data platforms and pipelines, and ensure their consistent adoption Provide technical leadership and guidance to data engineers, data scientists, and business partners on data and AI architecture. Evaluate emerging technologies and define the strategic roadmap for the data and AI platform. Stay current with trends and best practices in data architecture, AI, and cloud platforms. QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor’s degree or Master’s in computer science, Information Systems, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in data engineering and data architecture, including designing data models, platforms, and end-to-end data pipelines. Proven experience defining data architecture for AI/analytics solutions on a major cloud platform (Azure preferred; AWS a plus) and Big Data architectures. Data architecture and modelling for relational and NoSQL systems, including modern storage paradigms (e.g., object storage, lakehouse, warehouse). Design of scalable data platforms and architectural patterns (e.g., Lakehouse, Data Mesh, Medallion), including governance, lineage, and quality considerations. Architecture of compound AI systems, including data layers for AI solutions (e.g., RAG, GraphRAG), vector stores, graph databases, and embedding pipelines. Strong programming skills in Python, including asynchronous programming (asyncio) and data processing. Apache Spark and Databricks platform Cloud data platform expertise, preferably Azure Could and Azure data platform services. Streaming and event-driven architectures, using streaming services such as RabbitMQ or Apache Kafka Big data and large-scale compute architectures, including batch and real-time processing patterns. Design of microservices and distributed systems, including API-based data services. Containerization and deployment practices using Docker (and Kubernetes as a plus) Data security, privacy, and compliance (e.g., GDPR), including encryption, access control, and data masking/anonymization Software engineering practices, including Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and DevOps (CI/CD with GitHub Actions) Container orchestration platforms: Kubernetes Graph database technologies and data modelling Workflow orchestration and task management frameworks such as Apache Airflow and Celery AI/ML platforms and cloud AI services LLM and agentic solution patterns, including prompt engineering and orchestration of AI agents. MLOps practices, including model lifecycle management, CI/CD for ML, deployment, monitoring, and retraining pipelines. Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in cross-functional teams. Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to translate business needs into technical architectures and influence decision-making across teams. WHAT WE OFFER A secure work environment because your health, safety and wellbeing is always our top priority. Flexible work schedule and Home-office options, so that you can balance your working life and private life. Learning and development opportunities 25 holiday days per year 5 additional days (readjustment) A collaborative, trustful and innovative work environment Being part of an international team and work in global projects Relocation assistance to Madrid provided At BASF, the chemistry is right Because we are counting on innovative solutions, sustainable actions, connected thinking and on you, become a part of our formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.At BASF, we are committed to upholding and ensuring compliance with company standards related to quality, environment, health, safety, and energy, in line with our global guidelines.We actively promote a culture of prevention and continuous improvement, encouraging collaboration in initiatives related to quality, environmental protection, health, safety, and energy performance.We foster responsible energy use, promoting efficiency in daily operations and supporting the identification of improvement projects and energy-saving opportunities
