jobs.name: EHS Specialist Italy
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF Agriculture is all about balance. The balance that is crucial to everyone’s existence – also for our Agricultural Solutions division. We connect innovative thinking with practical action to find the right balance for success – for farmers, agriculture and future generations. With seeds and traits, crop protection and digital solutions, we help farmers produce food more efficiently, protect the land and meet the needs of society. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT You will employed by BASF Agricultural Solutions Italy S.r.l. Managing EHS Specialist and RSPP responsabilities for BASF small sites in Italy, ensuring compliance with Italian Health & Safety legislation and internal EHS standards. Lead the implementation and continuous improvement of the EHS management system, including BASF Responsible Care requirements, procedures, and governance. Promote a strong safety culture across Italian sites through EHS campaigns, training initiatives, Safety Days, and Behavior-Based Safety programs. Monitor regulatory developments and ensure the timely implementation of required actions related to health, safety, environment, process safety, and security. Coordinate risk assessments, incident investigations, corrective actions, emergency preparedness activities, and site safety reviews. Support environmental compliance activities, including emissions, water, waste management, supplier audits, and environmental assessments. Functionally coordinate EHS representatives across sites, organize follow-up meetings, monitor action plans, and support management reviews. Collaborate with internal stakeholders, external service providers, contractors, authorities, and regional EHS teams to drive operational excellence and continuous improvement. WHAT YOU OFFER Degree in EHS, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical field, with relevant experience in an industrial environment. 3–5 years of experience in Health, Safety & Environment roles, preferably within manufacturing, chemical, or industrial sites. Solid knowledge of Italian Health & Safety legislation, including D.Lgs. 81/08, and familiarity with RSPP responsibilities. Strong understanding of EHS management systems, risk prevention, process safety, environmental protection, and compliance requirements. Experience in risk assessments, incident investigations, safety procedures, emergency management, audits, and continuous improvement initiatives. Ability to promote safety culture through training, communication campaigns, and engagement with internal and external stakeholders. Proactive, autonomous, and rigorous working style, with strong communication skills and the ability to adapt messages to different audiences. Fluent English, both written and spoken, is essential. Residence in Bologna or the surrounding area is required. Regular travel to the assigned sites: Lugo (RA), Fasano (BR), Colognola ai Colli (BI), Sant'Agata Bolognese (BO), and Ascoli Satriano (FG) is an essential requirement of the role. WHAT WE OFFER CCNL (National Chemical Collective Agreement). Indicative gross annual salary (RAL) between €50,000 and €55,000, to be assessed based on the candidate’s skills and relevant experience. Performance-based variable bonus. Company participation bonus. Corporate welfare program. Company car for both business and personal use. HOW TO REACH US Do you have questions about the selection process or the position? You can contact: talent-acquisition-italy@basf.com Initial information about the application process is available here: http://on.basf.com/applicationprocess . ABOUT US We are BASF in agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. We do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture by connecting innovation, customers and society. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth Take a look at our Agricultural Solutions: Vision & Mission Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.name: - Cyber Security Risk Specialist (m/f/d)
jobs.description: ABOUT US At BASF Digital Hub Madrid we develop innovative digital solutions for BASF, create new exciting customer experiences and business growth, and drive efficiencies in processes, helping to strengthen BASF´s position as the digital leader in the chemical industry. We believe the right path is through creativity, trial and error and great people working and learning together. Become part of our team and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities. We are seeking an experienced Cyber Security Risk Specialist to join our CISO organization. As part of the Cyber Security Risk Management team, you will contribute to the development, implementation, and maintenance of our cyber security risk management framework. RESPONSIBILITIES You will be a part of our Cyber Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) Product Family, which is the pilar of the second Line of Defense (2LoD) and manages the Cyber Security Framework for the whole BASF Group, following a risk-based approach. One major part of that is to develop and implement risk management tools, policies, and procedures in line with ISO 27001 and other relevant standards. Your core responsibilities will be: Provide support to Asset Owners and Risk Owners to facilitate the operationalization of Cyber Risk Management-related processes across both IT and OT (Automation Technology) environments, Foster collaboration with our global Risk Community, incl. OT stakeholders, by actively gathering their feedback, while effectively communicating updates and enhancements to ensure alignment and engagement. Provide awareness materials and moderate training sessions on Cyber Security Risk Management with dedicated modules for OT environments to promote continuous learning and compliance towards BASF Business Units Derive new processes or pilots to strengthen GRC in response to the evolving threat landscape in IT and OT (Automation Technology) Conduct research on new threats by leveraging different sources such as Google Threat Intelligence or Dragos Execute strategic risk assessments on-demand to identify and evaluate emerging risks in IT and OT, including risks to production continuity, safety, and environmental impact, that could negatively affect or harm BASF Maintain and improve the toolset that our team provides (RSA Archer, Power BI, Knowledge Base within SharePoint) ensuring integration of OT-specific risk scenarios, asset classifications, and network segmentation (e.g., Purdue model layers) Aggregate operational risks and translate asset-specific risks to generic risk scenarios on enterprise level to support senior management reporting and strategic as well as tactical decision-making Support the lifecycle update of group-wide cyber security governance regulations based on generic BASF risk landscape Work closely with cross-functional teams to support compliance of risk management processes with ISMS according to ISO 27001 and OT security requirements Collaborate with Asset Owners and Risk Owners to maintain a risk register of IT and OT risks and associated risk treatment plans up to date Monitor and report on the effectiveness of risk management controls including OT-specific compensating controls (e.g., network segmentation, jump hosts, monitoring) and support the reporting of significant risks to senior management. QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field Experience with developing, implementing, and maintaining an ISMS based on ISO 27001 and familiarity with IEC 62443 or comparable OT security frameworks Profound experience in cyber security, particularly in GRC and cyber security risk management across IT and OT environments Strong experience in security for automation and laboratory environments, including industrial control systems (ICS), SCADA, DCS, PLCs, and LIMS/PIMSSolid understanding of OT architectures and concepts (e.g., Purdue Model, network segmentation, zones and conduits) and their implications for cyber risk management Strong understanding of risk management principles, frameworks and practices, especially in the field of risk aggregation as well as definition and evaluation of generic risks on enterprise level Experience with risk assessments, cyber threats and vulnerabilities Knowledge of relevant laws and regulations related to cyber security and OT security Ability to bridge communication between IT security teams and OT/engineering stakeholders in production environments Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with internal team members and cross-functional teams Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC are a plus additional OT-focused certifications (e.g., GICSP, ISA/IEC 62443) are highly desirable BENEFITS A secure work environment because your health, safety and wellbeing is always our top priority. Flexible work schedule and Home-office options, so that you can balance your working life and private life. Learning and development opportunities 25 holiday days per year 5 additional days (readjustment) A collaborative, trustful and innovative work environment Being part of an international team and work in global projects Relocation assistance to Madrid provided At BASF, the chemistry is right. Because we are counting on innovative solutions, sustainable actions, connected thinking and on you, become a part of our formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief. At BASF, we are committed to upholding and ensuring compliance with company standards related to quality, environment, health, safety, and energy, in line with our global guidelines. We actively promote a culture of prevention and continuous improvement, encouraging collaboration in initiatives related to quality, environmental protection, health, safety, and energy performance. We foster responsible energy use, promoting efficiency in daily operations and supporting the identification of improvement projects and energy-saving opportunities. Maar ons ultieme doel is om de eerste klimaat-neutrale site te worden. En daarmee zijn we goed op weg. Wil jij ons warm en divers team komen versterken en mee bijdragen aan onze duurzame toekomst? Dan kan jij bij ons als Technieker verspaning misschien wel floreren! JOUW UITDAGING Als draaier/frezer werk je met conventionele machines zowel als met CNC of Teach-In machines. Er wordt regelmatig van machine gewisseld. Dit betekent dat je niet altijd achter dezelfde machine staat, maar ook met andere machines kan en mag werken. Je kan afwisselende werkzaamheden verwachten en je zal werken in een klein teamverband. De werkzaamheden bestaan voornamelijk uit: Het ontwerpen en vervaardigen van opspangereedschappen wanneer de situatie dit vereist. Het produceren van onderdelen op basis van een werkplaatstekening of aan de hand van een bestaand onderdeel dat vervangen moet worden. Het opvolgen en controleren van het verspaningsproces en het uitvoeren van eventuele correcties. Het controleren van de maatvoering en de kwaliteit van de afgewerkte onderdelen. Het actief meedenken over efficiënte bewerkingsmethoden en technische oplossingen voor complexe opdrachten. ONZE IDEALE MATCH Je beschikt over ruime ervaring in draaien en/of frezen. Ervaring met het programmeren van CNC-machines is een sterke troef. Je werkt nauwkeurig, kwaliteitsbewust en hebt veiligheid steeds hoog in het vaandel. Je hebt een uitgesproken passie voor techniek en verspanende bewerkingen. Je bent creatief en denkt oplossingsgericht bij het vervaardigen van uitdagende werkstukken. Je bent flexibel en bereid om tijdens drukke periodes extra inspanningen te leveren. Je staat open voor continue ontwikkeling, leert graag bij en deelt jouw kennis en ervaring met collega's. Je werkt graag samen in teamverband en draagt bij aan een positieve en veilige werkomgeving. ONS AANBOD Een uitdagende en dynamische functie in een stabiel bedrijf met een familiale sfeer. Een hartelijke ontvangst tijdens onze onthaaldagen en begeleiding door ervaren collega's. Een groeiend salarispakket met een keuzeplan waarmee je brutoloon kan omzetten in andere voordelen, zoals extra verlof, een leasefiets, een elektrische leasewagen of gadgets zoals laptop, smartphone of tablet. Diverse sociale voorzieningen, waaronder een pensioenplan, hospitalisatie- en ambulante zorgverzekering voor jou en je gezin. Een goede balans tussen werk en privé: profiteer van glijtijd en geniet van wel 49 vrije dagen per jaar. Je kan ook regelmatig thuis werken. Een goed gevulde maag dankzij ons uitgebreide aanbod in het bedrijfsrestaurant, maandelijkse fruitbedeling en maaltijdcheques. jobs.name: Observability Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description: ABOUT US At BASF Digital Hub Madrid we develop innovative digital solutions for BASF, create new exciting customer experiences and business growth, and drive efficiencies in processes, helping to strengthen BASF´s position as the digital leader in the chemical industry. We believe the right path is through creativity, trial and error and great people working and learning together. Become part of our team and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities. You will join the Visibility Team of BASF whose mission it is to build an AI and big data fueled observability solution to predict, avoid and analyze complex disturbances in BASF’s global infrastructure. The team provides and develops the platform that stakeholders such as infrastructure operations, application teams and other business partners can get the required insights from. Aim is to give BASF an end to end visibility solution for Application Performance Management (APM), Network Performance Monitoring (NPM) and IT Infrastructure Monitoring (ITIM). RESPONSIBILITIES Understand the needs of internal Business Partners and their use cases regarding observability. Steering of managed services. Own end-to-end accountability for the BASF observability landscape—from infrastructure design and tooling development through CI/CD deployment, operational monitoring, and continuous improvement. Combine the strengths of observability tools in place, e.g. Grafana. Gigamon. Traffic Broker. Zabbix. Cisco. Thousand Eyes. ELK. Find additional ways to leverage the collected system data to generate value for BASF. Leverage AI capabilities to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort in daily business QUALIFICATIONS Good overview across enterprise IT landscape architectures. Expertise in network infrastructure desirable. Proactive mindset. Cloud experience (AWS, Azure) highly beneficial. Python/JavaScript/Shell scripting. Experienced in using code repository (GitLab, Bitbucket). Knowledge about CI/CD tools is also a plus. Monitoring tools (not all mandatory, some background/understanding): APM: Datadog, Dynatrace. NPM: SolarWinds, NetScout. ITM: Zabbix, Nagios, checkMK. Log engines: ELK, Splunk. Steering managed services experience. Daily usage of AI tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot). Well understanding about AI concepts like: LLM. MCP Server. Agent. Skills. Good ability to gain competence in new assignment areas quickly and independently covering new technologies, methods and skills is essential. Extraordinary analytical thinking and troubleshooting skills. Out of the box thinking is desirable to understand and eliminate complexity and to find innovative solutions for complex problems. Able to work as part of a globally spread, virtual team. Strong will and ability to communicate within and outside the team is key. Education and Work Experience Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree / University degree / University of applied Sciences degree (IT, Business IT) is required. Professional English skills mandatory. Minimum 5+ years job experience in security operations within mid & large-size enterprise environments. Technical career preferably in information technologies, telecommunications technologies, process control technology, communication technologies. Ability to work within small, creative teams as well as cross-functional teams. BENEFITS A secure work environment because your health, safety and wellbeing is always our top priority. Flexible work schedule and Home-office options, so that you can balance your working life and private life. Learning and development opportunities 25 holiday days per year 5 additional days (readjustment) A collaborative, trustful and innovative work environment Being part of an international team and work in global projects Relocation assistance to Madrid provided At BASF, the chemistry is right. At BASF, we are committed to upholding and ensuring compliance with company standards related to quality, environment, health, safety, and energy, in line with our global guidelines. El objetivo de la posición será liderar y gestionar la operación de Servicio al Cliente para la Unidad de Negocio EM de Estados Unidos desde México, contribuyendo al crecimiento sostenible del negocio. Coordinar y asegurar entregables claros, estableciendo y cumpliendo plazos, gestionando acciones pendientes, compartiendo información con los stakeholders clave, facilitando la toma de decisiones, promoviendo la colaboración y presentando resultados finales. Colaborar con líderes y stakeholders clave en iniciativas operativas destinadas a optimizar la eficacia y eficiencia de los procesos de Servicio al Cliente, incluyendo Order to Cash, gestión de precios, reportes de negocio, entre otros. Experiencia trabajando en organizaciones globales y entornos altamente colaborativos, con responsabilidad sobre clientes estratégicos, gestión de stakeholders clave y operaciones orientadas a los mercados de Estados Unidos y/o Canadá. jobs.name: Resident Site Manager
jobs.description: Now hiring! Resident Site Manager Greenville area, SC (On-site) Annual bonus / Relocation support We are looking for a Resident Site Manager to join our Care Chemicals team in Mauldin, SC. Come create chemistry with us! BASF’s Care Chemicals division is a globally leading supplier to the cosmetics, detergents and cleaning industries. We also offer solutions for technical applications and crop protection. Together with our customers, we create innovative solutions to meet the current and future needs of society more sustainably. We contribute to the long-term success of our customers’ brands with a broad range of products and concepts via our global network of production and development site. As Site Manager, you will lead the safe, efficient, and compliant operation of manufacturing, engineering, maintenance, and quality functions at the Mauldin, SC site, while ensuring adherence to BASF policies and standards for safety, quality, environmental responsibility, and financial stewardship. You will also serve as the primary liaison between the site, commercial organization, and key external stakeholders, including local communities, government agencies, and industry associations, to support business objectives, maintain the site’s license to operate, and ensure customer satisfaction. As a Resident Site Manager, you create chemistry by… Leading the Mauldin site to achieve excellence in EHS, manufacturing performance, quality, service, and customer delivery. Driving continuous improvement in safety, quality, cost efficiency, asset utilization, and operational performance through best practices and emerging technologies. Managing operational risks and ensuring compliance with EHS, regulatory, quality, reliability, and cost requirements. Developing and executing manufacturing, workforce, capital, and asset strategies aligned with business objectives and long-term site goals. Partnering with business stakeholders to ensure reliable customer supply, support growth initiatives, and lead site investment projects focused on infrastructure, utilities, and compliance. Promoting operational discipline, successful technology transfers, and a high-performing culture that develops, empowers, and engages employees while reflecting BASF's Values. If you… Hold a bachelor's degree in a science or engineering related field. Advanced degree is a plus. Bring 10+ years of experience in manufacturing environments, preferrably within chemical industry. Possess progressive leadership experience in manufacturing operations, engineering, maintenance, project management, or related disciplines. Possess a proven track record of driving EHS excellence, quality, operational performance, cost efficiency, and asset optimization.Have demonstrated success in building high-performing teams, leading organizational change, and fostering a strong safety culture. Have experience translating technical, operational, and financial insights into effective business, workforce, and capital strategies. Bring strong project leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across commercial, business, and support functions. Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF . We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us As one of the largest chemical companies in North America we have been finding solutions for your everyday needs and addressing the most complex economic, environmental, and sustainability challenges for more than 150 years! At BASF we empower our employees with the tools, guidance and opportunities they need to advance and succeed in work and life. Giving you the support you need to be your best and fulfill your personal ambitions is what helps us create chemistry. After all, our success is linked to yours. Whatever path you envision, BASF is a great place to build a rewarding, successful career. Belong to Something Bigger. #belongatBASF Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. If you have experienced any of the above, please contact Careers.NorthAmerica@basf.com to report fraud. Equal employment opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

En caso de requerir algún apoyo, favor de comunicarlo durante tu primer contacto con Atracción de Talento. Estamos buscando un(a) Especialista Senior de Servicio al Cliente. A través de una gestión proactiva y orientada a resultados, contribuirá a la continuidad operativa, la satisfacción del cliente y el cumplimiento de los objetivos estratégicos del negocio. En este rol estarás a cargo de: Gestionar el proceso end-to-end de Order-to-Cash / Order-to-Invoice para la cartera de clientes asignada, garantizando una experiencia de servicio excepcional y el cumplimiento de los estándares corporativos. Actuar como punto de contacto principal para clientes y stakeholders internos, asegurando una comunicación efectiva y una gestión proactiva de requerimientos, incidencias y oportunidades de mejora. Coordinar de manera estrecha con las áreas de Supply Chain, Logística, Ventas y Finanzas para asegurar la ejecución oportuna de pedidos y la continuidad de las operaciones. Resolver situaciones complejas relacionadas con pedidos, facturación, disponibilidad de producto, entregas, devoluciones y servicio al cliente, garantizando soluciones ágiles y sostenibles. Analizar y gestionar procesos complejos de Customer Service y Supply Chain, anticipando riesgos y tomando acciones que contribuyan a la satisfacción del cliente y al cumplimiento de los objetivos del negocio. Monitorear y analizar indicadores clave de desempeño (KPIs), identificando oportunidades de mejora e impulsando iniciativas orientadas a incrementar la eficiencia operativa, los niveles de servicio y la productividad. Desarrollar e implementar soluciones de mejora continua, promoviendo mejores prácticas y contribuyendo a la optimización de procesos, herramientas y sistemas. Contribuir al fortalecimiento de las relaciones con clientes estratégicos, asegurando una experiencia de servicio de alta calidad y generando valor para el negocio. Si cuentas con: Título universitario en Administración, Cadena de Suministro, Logística o carreras afines. Entre 5 y 8 años de experiencia en Servicio al Cliente, Order-to-Cash, Order Management, Supply Chain o áreas relacionadas, preferentemente en entornos multinacionales. Experiencia gestionando procesos operativos complejos e interactuando con múltiples stakeholders en entornos dinámicos e interfuncionales. Experiencia trabajando con clientes y operaciones orientadas a los mercados de Estados Unidos y/o Canadá. Dominio de SAP aplicado a procesos de Customer Service y Supply Chain. jobs.description: Objectives of the Position • Manage import export, customs and trade compliance for Japan, jointly with hub and country GB. • Key contact in Japan for import export, customs and trade compliance relevant interactions with customer, service providers and local business units / stakeholders • Lead performance and development of import export and customs operations in Japan, with collaboration from regional / global supply chain • Lead management of logistics service providers (LSP+ and LSP) in Japan, leading to performance steering for import export & customs in Japan, meeting regional and global import export performance results. This includes effective monitoring and leveraging analytics to sustain high level of operating discipline • Responsible for risk management pertaining to team and service provider operations including but not limited to access management, data protection, business continuity process and periodic risk management reviews • Ownership, participation and collaboration on global and regional import export and customs community and initiatives and projects relevant to supply chain operations serviced by Global Business Service • Responsible for establishment, adherence, and adequate documentation of supply chain, import export and customs processes and compliance to global, regional policies and procedures. • Initiate continuous improvement measures with stakeholders, with focus on automation and digitalization initiatives Main Tasks General • Responsible for import export and customs operations targets, performance, deliverables and compliance • Responsible for service provider management of forwarder/customs brokers and liner /carrier / tank operators including performance management, service requirement and freight cost management. • Provide and recommend logistics solution and/ or subject matter advice to business, country, regional and global stakeholders, • Collaborate and support Japan supply chain caretaker in country operational matters and with regional shipping management, operational vendor management and regional customs • Active participation in global, regional, and country level projects and initiatives for companywide projects, continuous improvement, and business requirement, where relevant to the scope of service Customs & Foreign Trade • Responsible compliance to company policies and local regulatory and statutory requirements specifically on customs and trade • Responsible for customs operations processing by both internal team and service providers to ensure accurate duty & import tax processing up to duty payment processing within the scope of customs and foreign trade team. To ensure adequate verification and documentation of duty process and payment to customs authority in line with established payment process with finance Internal • Manage customs and authority (relevant) contact point for customs and trade relevant liaison, updates, communication, audits and disputes • Optimize Free Trade Agreement and/or other trade benefits where eligible and ensure adherence to rules as stipulated in the respective trade agreements • Responsible for customs broker management in line with global policies and customs broker management framework and guidelines • Manage operations of trade facilities within the country e.g. Free trade zone, Bonded facilities, AEO, Green Lanes, special exemptions where applicable and relevant to customs operations • Conform to global and regional customs requirements on reporting, information on dashboards, community reviews, global inquiries responses, initiative participation, etc Operation Vendor Management (Logistics Service Providers): • Management of service provider (LSP+/3PL) service requirement, change management, knowledge transfer / transition, service performance, contract adherence and risk management transport management • Cost management of LSP services National Trade Compliance • Act as National Trade Compliance Officer (NTCO) for Japan • Monitor & interpret trade compliance relevant regulatory changes; derive business impact • Evaluate regulated goods and sanctioned parties against national laws relevant o trade compliance • Maintain the Internal Compliance Program (ICP) for own jurisdiction Minimum Education and Qualification Required for the Position • Education: Degree in Business Administration or equivalent, Supply Chain Management, and other Degree with relevant work experience • Working Experience: Minimum 5 years in Customs & Foreign Trade, Supply Chain Management in Multinational Company with international exposure • Technical & Professional Knowledge: Supply chain management / operational logistics knowledge, Customs and International trade and regulation preferred, SAP experience preferred, Business Intelligence Tools, Non-conformance management, good jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF You will be part of the Knowledge Management unit, responsible for the two main company-wide search & knowledge platforms containing 500M+ documents from various domains like R&D, Production & Technology, Rules & Regulations and more RESPONSIBILITIES Taking care of the external data management lifecycle, from data demand assessment, through purchasing and contract-related processes, to data delivery. Managing and continuously optimizing the external data provider portfolio, ensuring standardization in line with business needs. Handling purchasing and work cycle processes in SAP in line with Procurement. Serving as central point of contact for the external data portfolio, acting as the knowledge authority for subscription packages, licensing models, and permitted usage across the organization. Supporting the implementation of our standardization strategy, particularly by managing and evolving the charging model towards a transparent and standardized cost allocation. Communicating with data consumers and controlling stakeholders, including cost transparency, charging logic, supplier updates, disruptions, and invoicing-related questions. Enabling sufficient understanding of the underlying data to effectively support procurement in discussions with data providers and stakeholder related questions. Working closely with legal and procurement units to negotiate favorable publisher agreements maximizing usage rights for BASF. QUALIFICATIONS University degree in Law, Business Administration or a comparable field. Several years of working experience in supplier & license management Relevant professional experience in external data management, data provisioning, or data-related procurement processes. Structured and analytical working style with a high level of ownership and reliability. Working knowledge of Microsoft tools, especially Excel and Power BI and ideally first experience in SAP. Strong negotiation skills Strong communication skills and the ability to interact confidently with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Nice to have Familiarity with scientific literature and patents as well as general experience in R&D WHAT WE OFFER A secure work environment because your health, safety and wellbeing is always our top priority. Flexible work schedule and Home-office options, so that you can balance your working life and private life. Learning and development opportunities 25 holiday days per year 5 additional days (readjustment) A collaborative, trustful and innovative work environment Being part of an international team and work in global projects Relocation assistance to Madrid provided At BASF, the chemistry is right Because we are counting on innovative solutions, sustainable actions, connected thinking and on you, become a part of our formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.At BASF, we are committed to upholding and ensuring compliance with company standards related to quality, environment, health, safety, and energy, in line with our global guidelines.We actively promote a culture of prevention and continuous improvement, encouraging collaboration in initiatives related to quality, environmental protection, health, safety, and energy performance.We foster responsible energy use, promoting efficiency in daily operations and supporting the identification of improvement projects and energy-saving opportunities

jobs.name: Technical Marketing Manager, Gas Treatment
jobs.description: Objectives of the Position Responsible for the profitable and sustainable growth of BASF’s OASE gas treatment business in selected subregion/countries of Asia Pacific. Job Responsiblities: To develop customized solutions for greenfield/brownfield gas treatment projects through a combination of licensing OASE technologies, offering technical services and marketing chemicals supply. To license OASE gas treatment process technologies in strategically relevant markets such as natural gas/LNG, syngas, post-combustion flue gas, biogas, and refinery tail gas To defend existing solvent refill business from licensed customers in Asia Pacific (<100 in AP) by serving their needs at the highest service level To build and maintain long-term relationships with industry partners (project owners, licensors, engineering contractors, vendors) to benefit BASF’s business on a global scale To contribute to and implement global and regional Gas Treatment strategies To collect, monitor, analyze and share competitive & market intelligence to gain competitive advantage for BASF To increase the level of technical expertise within the gas treatment team by documenting and sharing design and engineering knowledge/experience To represent BASF in positive manner in industry associations, conferences, trade shows, customers events etc. through presenting technical and/or industry-relevant topics and networking To collaborate with other BASF business units (eg. catalysts and adsorbents) to present BASF’s collective offerings to the customers in gas purification market To ensure quality management and efficiency of sales, customers service and order processing processes by conducting internal training and improving internal procedures To take on special projects/initiatives as required Job Requirements: Bachelor’s degree or higher in Chemical Engineering - MBA or PhD is an advantage Have 8-10 years’ experience in relevant process engineering roles preferably in gas treating  Internal applications (natural gas, syngas, refinery tail gas, flue gas, hydrogen etc. as mentioned above regarding customers’ applications) Experience in technical marketing and sales High degree of knowledge related to the design and/or operation of process units, preferably Acid Gas Removal and CO2 capture processes About BASF BASF has been present in Malaysia since 1989, and operates a manufacturing plant in Pasir Gudang, Johor. BASF’s Regional Service Hub in Kuala Lumpur provides functional support services to BASF companies in 20 markets across Asia Pacific. BASF also provides infrastructure and utilities support services to its joint ventures BASF PETRONAS Chemicals and Toray BASF Resins at an integrated Verbund site situated in the Gebeng Industrial Zone, Pahang. jobs.name: SAP EWM, StRM, IM Consultant - (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF At BASF Digital Hub Hyderabad we develop innovative digital solutions for BASF, create new exciting customer experiences and business growth, and drive efficiencies in processes, helping to strengthen BASF´s position as the digital leader in the chemical industry. We believe the right path is through creativity, trial and error and great people working and learning together. Become part of our team and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities. The role provides Application support for SAP logistics processes, ensuring stable operations, fast incident resolution and continuous improvement across SAP EWM, Inventory Management and Stock Room Management (SAP MM-IM or/and SAP WM) Key Responsibilities : • Application support: Receive, prioritize and document incidents and service requests with impact, evidence and reproduction steps. jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities . About BASF At BASF, we create chemistry for a sustainable future. We combine economic success with environmental protection and social responsibility. Around 112,000 employees contribute to the BASF Group’s success worldwide. Our business comprises the Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, Surface Technologies, Nutrition & Care and Agricultural Solutions segments. We want to contribute to a better world with enhanced quality of life for everyone. That is why we have firmly anchored the three pillars of sustainability – the economy, environment and society – into our corporate purpose, our strategy, our targets and our operations. They are the core of what we do, a driver for growth and an element of our risk management. We believe that chemistry has a critical role to play in achieving greater sustainability. We are determined to move forward in this respect. Our employees are at the forefront of this transformation, across every role and function in the organization. Join us today in shaping a sustainable future together. About The Role At BASF we are entering an exciting time within our Agriculture business with an existing portfolio of world class products and a pipeline of new products that will bring significant benefits to the agriculture industry. As a Canola Site Operations Lead, you will enjoy a diverse role overseeing the safety, compliance and efficient operation of BASF's canola seed sites across Australia. You'll be responsible for site governance, infrastructure, EHS and regulatory compliance, audit readiness, and CAPEX delivery while working closely with breeding, seed production and operations teams to drive operational excellence across multiple locations. How You Will Do It Lead the safe, compliant and efficient operation of BASF’s Australian canola seed sites, ensuring consistent standards across multiple locations. Drive site governance, infrastructure maintenance and asset management to support reliable and audit-ready operations. Coordinate contractors, suppliers and service providers, ensuring strong performance, compliance and operational excellence. Champion EHS, stewardship and regulatory compliance through audits, inspections, training and continuous improvement initiatives. Lead site CAPEX activities, partnering with key stakeholders to deliver operational improvements and business outcomes. Collaborate closely with breeding, seed production and operations teams to support successful canola seed production programs across Australia. What We Look For To be successful in this role, you'll bring experience in agricultural operations, along with a strong commitment to safety, compliance and operational excellence. You'll enjoy working across multiple sites, building relationships with diverse stakeholders and driving efficient, well-governed operations. You will: Hold a qualification in Agricultural Science, Business, or a related discipline. Have experience in agricultural operations, farming, seed production or rural business coordination, ideally within a multi-site environment. Demonstrate knowledge of EHS requirements, auditing processes and regulatory compliance within an agricultural setting. Be highly organised with strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to coordinate contractors, suppliers and site activities effectively. Have a hands-on approach, with experience operating farm machinery or agricultural equipment highly regarded. Be a proactive communicator who can collaborate effectively across operations, breeding, seed production and support teams What We Can Offer You At BASF you get more than just compensation. Our total offer includes a wide range of elements to suit each one of our global team. jobs.name: Technical Services Manager
jobs.description: About BASF At BASF, we create chemistry for a sustainable future. We combine economic success with environmental protection and social responsibility. Around 112,000 employees contribute to the BASF Group’s success worldwide. Our business comprises the Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, Surface Technologies, Nutrition & Care and Agricultural Solutions segments. We want to contribute to a better world with enhanced quality of life for everyone. That is why we have firmly anchored the three pillars of sustainability – the economy, environment and society – into our corporate purpose, our strategy, our targets and our operations. They are the core of what we do, a driver for growth and an element of our risk management. We believe that chemistry has a critical role to play in achieving greater sustainability. We are determined to move forward in this respect. Our employees are at the forefront of this transformation, across every role and function in the organization. Join us today in shaping a sustainable future together. About The Role At BASF we are entering an exciting time within our Agriculture business with an existing portfolio of world class products and a pipeline of new products that will bring significant benefits to the agriculture industry. As a Technical Marketing Manager, you'll play a pivotal role at the intersection of agronomy, technical expertise and commercial strategy. Working closely with sales, customers and industry stakeholders, you'll lead the technical direction of BASF's crop protection portfolio, develop compelling technical marketing programs and drive the successful launch of innovative solutions across New Zealand. How You Will Do It Lead technical strategy and provide expert support for BASF's crop protection portfolio, helping drive customer success and commercial growth. Develop and manage agronomy trials, translating technical data and field insights into practical recommendations and commercial opportunities. Create technical marketing materials, product positioning and data-driven stories that support customer engagement and sales effectiveness. Partner with sales teams, customers and industry stakeholders to provide technical advice, training and product expertise. Lead the planning and execution of new product launches, including business case development, market assessments and launch strategies. Investigate field performance enquiries and provide technical guidance to optimise product performance and customer outcomes. What We Look For To be successful in this role, you'll bring a strong foundation in agronomy and crop protection, combined with the ability to translate technical information into practical solutions for customers and commercial teams. You'll enjoy building relationships, sharing knowledge and influencing outcomes across a diverse stakeholder network. You will: Hold a degree in Agricultural Science or a related discipline. Have significant experience within the crop protection, agrichemical or agribusiness industry, ideally with exposure to a broad range of crop segments. Bring proven agronomic expertise and experience working with crop protection products. Be confident presenting technical information, delivering training and engaging with customers, industry groups and commercial teams. Demonstrate strong analytical skills and the ability to convert data and field observations into actionable business insights. Possess excellent communication, stakeholder management and relationship-building skills. What We Can Offer You At BASF you get more than just compensation. Our total offer includes a wide range of elements to suit each one of our global team. By creating chemistry with us, you can look forward to: A diverse and inclusive environment, with an open and fair internal promotion process A competitive parental leave policy, regardless of gender, and a supportive return to work plan Give back to your community with our corporate volunteering scheme 4 weeks annual leave, with the offer to purchase additional leave throughout the year Opportunities to apply for international assignments – the perks of a global business! Connect to Create Chemistry If you’d like to join a diverse global business and create chemistry for a sustainable future, we want to hear from you! Click ‘apply’ below. BASF is proud to be a WORK180 Endorsed Employer for all women. If you’d like to know more information about how we are supporting our employees, you can view our policies and benefits here . Offers of employment will be subject to background checks including references, police checks and may include a pre-employment medical. Beware, Job Applicants. At BASF, we are committed to providing a safe and transparent recruitment process. Please be aware of job scams and fraudulent job postings. Only apply through the official BASF Career website to ensure your application is received by us. Be cautious of unsolicited job offers or communications that do not come from official BASF email addresses. Verify any doubtful communications through our HR department. Never provide personal information or make payment as part of the application process. #LI-Jobs

jobs.name: Sales Account Manager ES/FR (m/f/d)
jobs.description: The world needs innovations, and our team needs you! BASF is the world's leading chemical company #WeCreateChemistry and one of the best places to work and develop your career. We are looking for diverse, passionate, and creative talent who wants to make a difference. BASF Española S.L. markets more than 5,000 products to meet the needs of our customers and society across a wide variety of sectors. The chemical industry is changing; and so is BASF. Discover our new strategy: #WinningWays Do you want to boost your career to the next level and create chemistry with us? WHAT YOU WILL DO As Area Sales Manager Spain & France / Animal Nutrition Feed Enzymes & Feed Performance Ingredients, your key responsibilities will include: Drive business growth and develop customer-focused solutions through close collaboration with customers. Monitors sales budgets, taking corrective action where necessary. Sales Excellence (Account Plans, FC, accurate on-time reporting, budgeting). Develop/manage customer portfolio and partnerships in order to grow sales with specialty products. Prepares comprehensive local market analysis with focus on market demand, market share and in-depth understanding about the entire value chain. Creates, implements and updates sales concepts for the relevant industry field(s), taking SBU strategies and the local/sub regional characteristics into account. Supports the local/regional implementation of cross regional projects, sponsored by Business Unit. Contribute ideas/ market knowledge to develop innovation pipeline together with technical experts. ensuring mid- to long-term growth options. Accountability for Regional NS and CM1 of the assigned area. Establish best practices / sales excellence and beyond reg. Account Plans, Visit Reports, Market Dialogues, Management Dialogues. Excel CRM activities such as Visit Reports, Chatter Posts, Opportunity Pipeline, Price documentation, IFT Forecasting etc. Management contact and escalation point for decision makers at the customer, in charge of (re-) building a sustainable relationship matrix (including contract board preparation/ involvement of senior management). In charge of leading and guiding the re-negotiation of existing contracts, setting of optimized growth contracts in close alignment. In charge of defining the opportunity pipeline, endorsed by customer management and all BASF stakeholders Tracking of conversion rate, countermeasures (such as customer trials, joint developments, etc). WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU University degree/ master’s degree/PhD or equivalent in Animal Nutrition or Veterinary. 3-5 years sales or technical sales experience in animal nutrition (feed ingredients) or technical background in animal nutrition. Language of assigned customer base and proficient English language skills orally and in writing. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships with an international network. Project management and regional collaboration. Positive mindset, customer focus and strong motivation to capture market share. Negotiation skills and partnership development. Pricing management, entrepreneurial mindset, forecasting and order management. Highly valuable knowledge of SAP, Salesforce, and Microsoft 365 applications. WHAT WE OFFER We provide you with a dynamic and collaborative work environment with exciting challenges, where you can develop and contribute to creating more sustainable products. Additionally, we offer other benefits such as: Healthy work environment: where your safety and health (both physical and mental) are always our priority. Attractive salary package: based on a fixed salary and a bonus based on performance. Flexible compensation plan: to take advantage of services such as Health Insurance, Childcare, Transportation Card, and Training, among others. Professional development: we promote continuous training and access to internal vacancies to keep growing at BASF. Investments for your future: with a Pension Plan, Accident Insurance, Life Insurance, and even the opportunity to participate in the Stock Program after one year in the company. Work-life balance measures: as well as financial assistance for the schooling of children. Sports sections: where you can connect with colleagues and play football, paddle, basketball, cycling, yoga, etc. Flexible work: with the chance to work from home and adjusting your schedule, depending on your position and workplace. And much more. HOW TO PARTICIPATE IN THE PROCESS Send your CV through the job offer so we can get to know each other. If your profile matches, we will call you from the Spanish Talent Acquisition team in Germany (prefix +49) and support you throughout the process. With each step, you will be closer to meeting your future team! If you have any further questions about this process, please contact: Sara Prado (sara.prado-marques@basf.com) * *Please note that we will not be able to accept your resume via this email. MORE ABOUT BASF We celebrate diversity and actively promote an inclusive work environment where every voice is heard and every idea is valued, regardless of age, gender, marital status, ethnicity, religion, physical/mental condition, or sexual orientation. #BeYourself We are Creative, Open, Responsible and Entrepreneurial people. This are our values, they guide us and describe who we are and how we act. If you identify with them, BASF is the place for you! Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.name: Senior Specialist Digitalization | Solution Consultant - B2B Integrations (EDI, O2C/PTP)
jobs.description: Digital Hub Kuala Lumpur attracts, inspire and develop diverse talents who will elevate BASF’s digital journey. As one of the world’s largest chemical companies, BASF is on a mission to create chemistry with a sustainable future. The Digital Hub Kuala Lumpur, alongside four other Digital Hubs across the globe are part of the technology powerhouse driving our vision. Join our organization and make an impact in an inclusive and diverse work environment. We value individual differences and provide opportunities for you to contribute your unique perspective towards our collective goals. Objectives BASF’s Business Process Integration (BPI) team provides and supports digital solutions for B2B integrations with external partners through a variety of systems and processes within the BASF’s architectural landscape.  BPI is considered a strategic tool to digitalize processes and enable seamless exchange of data between applications, businesses, customers and partners in real-time. In this role, you will focus on consulting representatives of BASF businesses and BASF partners on integrating business processes primarily in the Purchase-to-Pay process area, including respective mappings. Main Tasks The Solution Consultant provides customized integration solutions for internal partners and external partners via EDI, API, Micro Services, AI Agents, and similar technologies. The Solution Consultant supports our internal (SAP ERP and Satellite Systems) and external partners to specify their requirements and translates those into best-in-class solution designs based on technical and business process knowledge, aligned with process design and architecture. The consultant will be responsible for supplemental tasks in the daily operation, e.g. operational support (2nd/3rd level), issue resolving, quality assurance, and business interaction. The role does also include assignments to support comprehensive business integration projects. The Solution Consultant works in a global, international setting, interacting with team members in all other regions to provide sustainable digital solutions for our partners. Additional work aspects: strategic contribution to IT architecture and cross-process digitalization efforts, interact with connectivity solutions by supporting API, micro services, generative AI and other industries relevant technical developments. The business processes in scope of this role are: Purchase-to-Pay Job Requirements Education Master's degree in computer science, business or STEM major with 4-6 years of IT or related field experience OR Bachelor's degree in computer science, business or STEM major with 6-8 years of IT or related field experience OR Diploma or comparable training with 6+ years of professional experience in IT and/or business areas Working Experience Minimum 4 years related working experience Experiencing Agile way of working or agile implementation approach Work experience in an international company is a plus Technical & Profressional Knowledge Consult and support internal and external partners when dealing with complex processes and IT application questions. Good business knowledge in various application and process areas, esp. Purchase to Pay (Purchase Orders, Confirmations, Goods Receipts, Migo Movements, Invoices). Conducts and support the technical implementation of the B2B Integration to external partners Showing strong transactional experience in SAP R3 and/or S4/HANA (MM Procurement - SD) Ability to work and navigate in SAP middleware platforms (PO, CPI Integration Suite) Provides a deep technical understanding of standard connectivity messages EDI-APIs and programming protocols (supporting e.g. iDocs, XML, EDIFACT, JSON, UI etc.) Consult and support IT analysis (process and/or data), mentoring, modelling, solution design and optimization of related business processes and models Execute studies in preliminary stages of projects, including evaluation of existing or new solutions Ability to support strategic planning and realization Can assume roles as project manager and related tasks Coordinate and execute prototyping, configuration and testing of solutions based on BASF requirements, while ensuring quality and security aspects Provide structured acceptance, analysis and description of solutions and/or concepts Support and/or steer the formulation of more complex costs estimates for efforts spend solution design, testing and implementation of business solutions Provides Business support and training (processes, tools, reports, etc.) where required Provide guidance and structure to enable day2day operational support incl, advising external support resources Extensive knowledge of standard connectivity messages, related business processes and applications Familiar with Azure DevOps (or GitHub or similar) You can demonstrate fluent communication skills in English (spoken and written) Well-developed sense of teamwork in an international team with strong interpersonal, written and verbal communication and conflict resolution skills. Business consulting skill with a focus on value generation Ambitious, proactive & entrepreneurial character Highly developed sense of responsibility High customer- and innovation-orientation Time flexibility to work across different time zones Experiences as project manager Experiences in strategic planning and realization Experiences in AI Agents and AI based communication Certifications in Agile, SAP S/4 At BASF, we create chemistry for a sustainable future. We combine economic success with environmental protection and social responsibility. Around 112,000 employees in the BASF Group contribute to the success of our customers in nearly all sectors and almost every country in the world. Our portfolio comprises six segments: Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, Surface Technologies, Nutrition & Care and Agricultural Solutions. BASF generated sales of €68.9 billion in 2023. BASF is committed to empowering its employees to pursue their interests and explore emerging technologies. By investing in top-quality tools and promoting cross-functional collaboration, we encourage our team members to drive positive change within our organization. Come join us and be a part of our digitalization journey . Further Information at https://go.basf.net/careers_digitalhubkl

jobs.name: Portfolio Manager/ Trader Energy (m/w/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF BASF's future is climate-neutral - and we are shaping the way there! We give BASF access to renewable electricity and other energy sources with low upstream emissions. We participate in production, conclude long-term supply contracts, trade on wholesale markets and thus competitively supply BASF's European sites with essential energy sources. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT As part of our European portfolio management and trading team at BASF, you will take on a key role in managing energy market exposures and actively contribute to the development of trading strategies. In your new position, you manage and optimize short-term exposure in Gas and Carbon markets. Together with your colleagues, you develop, implement, and execute hedging and trading strategies across European energy markets. Furthermore, you execute trades both OTC and on exchanges across different maturities and instruments. Your expertise is in demand! You closely collaborate with Analytics and Origination teams to support informed trading decisions. Not least, you ensure alignment with internal stakeholders and foster transparent communication within BASF. WHAT YOU OFFER degree in economics, energy economics, natural sciences or a comparable field at least three years of professional experience in trading or portfolio management of energy commodities strong understanding of at least two commodities (power, gas or carbon) as well as hands-on experience in trading, hedging and basic technical analysis very good german and english skills as well as confident use of MS office; programming skills (e.g. python) are a plus analytical team player with strong communication skills, high level of initiative and a structured way of working WHAT WE OFFER Inspiring networks for the development and implementation of your ideas (e.g. Women in BASF) Mentoring programs and learning opportunities for your professional and personal development Career paths as professional development to other positions in the company (including job rotation) Support with childcare (e.g. company daycare, holiday programmes) Fitness and health studio, medical center with numerous offers for your health Deutschlandticket as a discounted job ticket, job bike, availability of e-charging stations for private vehicles HOW TO REACH US Bonnie Gardt (Talent Acquisition), bonnie.gardt@basf.com, Tel: +49 30 2005-59672 will be happy to answer your questions for this position. You can also reach our recruiting team here . First information about our application process can be found here . ABOUT US The future of BASF is climate-neutral – and we are shaping the path to get there! We enable BASF to access renewable electricity and other energy sources. We invest in production facilities, conclude long-term supply contracts, trade on wholesale markets, and thus supply BASF sites with energy at competitive prices. Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.name: Field Officer - rice
jobs.description: Job Description: Position Summary The Field Officer - rice is responsible for supporting demand generation activities, promoting BASF crop protection solutions, and driving product adoption among farmers, distributors, and retailers within the assigned territory. The role focuses on field execution, customer engagement, technical support, and market development to achieve business objectives. Job Responsibilities 1. Product Promotion & Demand Generation * Conduct product demonstrations * Organize farmer meetings, field days, and crop clinics. * Promote BASF products and technologies to farmers and channel partners. * Support marketing campaigns and product launch activities. 2. Farmer Engagement * Develop and maintain strong relationships with farmers and key influencers. * Conduct regular farm visits to understand customer needs. * Provide recommendations on crop protection solutions and best farming practices. 3. Technical Support * Monitor crop conditions, pest, disease, and weed infestations. * Assist farmers with product application methods and stewardship practices. * Collect field performance data and feedback on BASF products. 4. Channel Partner Support * Work closely with distributors, dealers, and retailers to increase product awareness and demand. * Assist in dealer training and promotional activities. * Support inventory movement through demand creation initiatives. 5. Market Intelligence * Monitor competitor activities, product performance, and market trends. * Gather customer insights and provide regular reports to the sales team. * Identify new business opportunities within the assigned territory. 6. Compliance & Stewardship * Ensure all activities comply with company policies, safety standards, and regulatory requirements. * Promote responsible and sustainable use of crop protection products. * Support product stewardship and container recycling programs. Job Requirements * Have at least Diploma or equivalent. * Experience in agriculture, crop protection, seed business, or sales promotion is an advantage. * Good communication and interpersonal skills. * Able to work independently and travel extensively within the assigned territory. * Possess a valid driving license and own vehicle for work purpose. Job Description Footer: BASF has been present in Malaysia since 1989, and operates a manufacturing plant in Pasir Gudang, Johor. BASF’s Regional Service Hub in Kuala Lumpur provides functional support services to BASF companies in 20 markets across Asia Pacific. BASF also provides infrastructure and utilities support services to its joint ventures BASF PETRONAS Chemicals and Toray BASF Resins at an integrated Verbund site situated in the Gebeng Industrial Zone, Pahang. BASF posted sales to customers in Malaysia of approximately €340 million in 2024 and had 2,579 employees as of the end of the year. Further information is available on www.basf.com/my

jobs.name: Communication & Culture Specialist (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF At BASF Digital Hub Hyderabad we develop innovative digital solutions for BASF, create new exciting customer experiences and business growth, and drive efficiencies in processes, helping to strengthen BASF´s position as the digital leader in the chemical industry. We believe the right path is through creativity, trial and error and great people working and learning together. Become part of our team and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities. Key Responsibilities : Drive Communication, Change & Culture for the Digital Hub, designing and executing the overall communication and change activities to support the Hub’s vision, culture, and business goals – and to contribute to the overall global communications and culture strategy and targets of Global Digital Services Oversee all internal and external communication channels relevant for the Hub (news, intranet, social media, LinkedIn, event communications), ensuring consistent messaging and strong employer branding. Organize and manage end-to-end events (onsite and virtual) that promote company culture, support our transformation, foster engagement, and create synergies among IT professionals and across technology domains, promoting integration and knowledge sharing. Act as a cultural ambassador, driving initiatives that strengthen our Winning Culture and digitalization priorities, diversity, inclusion, and collaboration, and advising leaders and teams on best practices. Monitor and analyze communication and change management effectiveness, continuously improving measures and content based on feedback and business needs. Closely collaborate with the local and regional communications network in BASF and ensure all activities comply with local (India) requirements and leverage local trends and platforms to maximize impact. Requirements : Bachelor’s degree in Communication, Marketing, Public Relations, Change Management, or related field. Up to 1-2 years’ experience in communication, event organization, social media management, preferably in a multicultural or digital environment is beneficial. Excellent communication skills in English; knowledge of local languages is a plus. Ability to create concepts and content relevant to the local context with a strategic and analytical mindset. Strong interpersonal and intercultural skills, an open and transformative mindset, curiosity to question the status-quo, and the ability to connect and engage diverse audiences. WHAT WE OFFER Be part of a global leader in digital transformation, working in a vibrant Digital Hub that values innovation, agility, and cross-functional collaboration. jobs.name: AI Engineer - Agentic Coding (m/f/d)
jobs.description: ABOUT US Agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor and Codex are changing how our engineers work, and new capabilities arrive faster than we can currently absorb them. You will join a small existing team that already owns this area, with established tooling, working relationships across engineering, and colleagues who know the landscape. You will not be starting from scratch or figuring it out alone. What we need is the capacity and depth to keep pace: teaching teams what has become possible, building it into our templates and golden paths, supporting teams directly when things do not work, and assessing which developments are worth adopting. This work sits directly on the Accelerate lever of our “Winning Ways” strategy — enabling people to use AI effectively in their own area of work, and prioritizing the applications whose value has been proven in fast, focused pilots. For software engineering, that is this team's remit. RESPONSIBILITIES This position suits an engineer with an active interest in how agentic coding changes software work, rather than a general interest in AI. When a new model or agent feature ships, you try it within days, against your own hard problems rather than a toy example — a legacy refactor whose shape you already know, a test suite that resists, a migration you have previously done by hand. Your views come from that, not from reading about it, and you can distinguish a real capability improvement from a well-produced demo. The second-order question interests you as much as the result: if this holds, what does it change about how we review code, structure repositories, write specifications and run CI? You will probably recognize yourself in the following: You write and iterate on your own agent configuration — instruction files, custom commands, subagents, MCP servers — rather than accepting the defaults. You know how differently these tools behave on a large, old, inconsistent codebase than on a greenfield project, and you have views on what makes a repository navigable to an agent. You have reviewed a lot of agent-written code and can say where it reliably goes wrong: changes that pass the tests but are wrong, plausible refactors that quietly lose behavior, work that looks finished and is not. You care about the state of the codebase, not only about throughput. You have seen how quickly quality can erode when generation is cheap and review is not. You enjoy making other engineers more effective. Teaching is a substantial part of this role, not an occasional obligation. You already follow this field closely in your own time. What this role adds is the mandate, the budget and the working hours to do it properly. Responsibilities Technical enablement and forward-deployed support (40%) Teach engineers how to use new capabilities effectively — not only that a feature exists, but what it changes in day-to-day work, demonstrated on our own code. Work directly with teams on their real problems: pairing, debugging agent workflows, and investigating why a tool that performs well in a demo does not perform on our codebases. Run sessions, office hours, demos and written guides, and turn recurring problems from the field into permanent improvements. Developer platform and templates (25%) Equip our templates and golden paths with agent harnesses: agent instruction files, MCP server configuration, custom commands and subagents, tool permissions and sensible defaults, so services work well with agentic tools from day one. Define and track the DevEx metrics that show whether these changes have real impact — adoption, cycle time, delivery throughput, developer-reported friction — so template changes and model swaps can be assessed on evidence. Make newly approved models available to teams through our existing tooling layer. Model and feature evaluation (20%) Test new models as they are released, open-source and commercial, and establish how their capabilities compare to the frontier models we already use. Evaluate against tasks that reflect our actual work rather than public leaderboards, and be specific about where a cheaper or open model is sufficient and where it is not. Market and concept validation (15%) Follow the landscape and distinguish substantive developments from noise, covering tools, protocols, agent patterns and workflows. Run structured, time-boxed evaluations of promising concepts in our own context, and document what was tested, what you recommend, and what we should not pursue for now. QUALIFICATIONS Practicing engineer. You write production-quality code and have been trusted with real systems. We are not prescriptive about the stack: deep knowledge of any modern open-source language is what counts. Python and TypeScript come up most often here, but strong Go, Rust, Kotlin or comparable backgrounds are equally welcome. Daily use of agentic coding tools — Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codex — with a clear understanding of their limitations as well as their strengths. Familiarity with the underlying mechanics: LLM APIs and tool calling, MCP, context management, agent and prompt design, token economics, common failure modes. Engineering fundamentals: Git, CI/CD, containers, at least one cloud platform. An evidence-based approach. You can design a test that answers a question, and revise your view when the results say you should. Accountability. You give and take ownership rather than working under close supervision: you identify where the improvement potential lies, develop your own concept for it, and carry it through to adoption. Much of this work is not specified in advance — you will define it more often than you receive it, and you are measured on the result rather than the effort. Speed. You would rather put a working improvement in engineers' hands this month and refine it than design the complete solution first. You time-box your evaluations, and you focus on what matters most instead of doing a little of everything. Improvement mindset. You argue for the best solution rather than the easiest compromise, you give candid and constructive feedback rather than empty phrases, and you actively bring in outside perspective — from the market, from open source, from other engineering organizations — rather than working only from how we do things today. Strong teaching and communication skills. Making other engineers effective is a core part of the role, not a side effect of it. You build momentum for new ways of working rather than skepticism. Fluent English, written and spoken. Nice to have: Public work we can review: a GitHub profile, open-source contributions, an MCP server, a tool, articles or talks. Experience with internal developer platforms such as Backstage, or with scaffolding and template systems. Experience with DevEx and developer productivity metrics (DORA, SPACE, DX Core 4 or similar). A background in which other engineers were your users: forward-deployed or solutions engineering, developer relations, consulting, platform teams, or teaching.
