jobs.name: National EHS Specialist
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities . About BASF At BASF, we create chemistry for a sustainable future. We combine economic success with environmental protection and social responsibility. Around 112,000 employees contribute to the BASF Group’s success worldwide. Our business comprises the Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, Surface Technologies, Nutrition & Care and Agricultural Solutions segments. We want to contribute to a better world with enhanced quality of life for everyone. That is why we have firmly anchored the three pillars of sustainability – the economy, environment and society – into our corporate purpose, our strategy, our targets and our operations. They are the core of what we do, a driver for growth and an element of our risk management. We believe that chemistry has a critical role to play in achieving greater sustainability. We are determined to move forward in this respect. Our employees are at the forefront of this transformation, across every role and function in the organization. Join us today in shaping a sustainable future together. About The Role At BASF we are entering an exciting time within our Agriculture business with an existing portfolio of world class products and a pipeline of new products that will bring significant benefits to the agriculture industry. As a National EHS Specialist, you will be the trusted advisor for Environment, Health & Safety across BASF's Agricultural Solutions business in Australia and New Zealand. You'll partner with business leaders to strengthen our EHS culture, drive compliance, influence safe work practices and deliver continuous improvement across diverse agricultural operations, sites and supply chain partners. How You Will Do It Partner with business leaders across ANZ to provide expert EHS guidance and drive EHS priorities across the Agricultural Solutions (AP) business. Ensure compliance with Responsible Care principles, Australian and New Zealand legislation, and BASF EHS standards across sites, warehouses, contractors and suppliers. Champion and strengthen BASF's OneAP EHS culture through engagement, coaching, training and continuous improvement initiatives. Monitor emerging regulatory requirements, assess business impacts and implement practical compliance and risk management strategies. Analyse EHS performance data and KPIs to identify trends, drive improvements and support leadership decision-making. Travel across ANZ operational sites to build strong stakeholder relationships and support safe, compliant and high-performing operations. What We Look For To be successful in this role, you'll bring significant EHS leadership experience and a passion for creating safe, compliant and high-performing workplaces. You'll be confident influencing senior stakeholders, navigating complex operational environments and translating regulatory requirements into practical business solutions. You will: Hold a Diploma in Environmental Health & Safety or equivalent. Have 7-10 years of EHS experience, ideally within agriculture, agribusiness, manufacturing, logistics or other operational environments. Demonstrate strong knowledge of Australian EHS legislation, compliance frameworks and industry best practice. Thrive in a complex matrix organisation and enjoy building strong relationships across multiple sites and stakeholder groups. Have experience influencing senior leaders and engaging effectively with diverse operational, contractor and site-based workforces. Bring strong analytical and reporting skills, with the ability to use EHS data to drive continuous improvement and business outcomes. What We Can Offer You At BASF you get more than just compensation. Our total offer includes a wide range of elements to suit each one of our global team. By creating chemistry with us, you can look forward to: A diverse and inclusive environment, with an open and fair internal promotion process A competitive parental leave policy, regardless of gender, and a supportive return to work plan Give back to your community with our corporate volunteering scheme 4 weeks annual leave, with the offer to purchase additional leave throughout the year Opportunities to apply for international assignments – the perks of a global business! Connect to Create Chemistry If you’d like to join a diverse global business and create chemistry for a sustainable future, we want to hear from you! Click ‘apply’ below. BASF is proud to be a WORK180 Endorsed Employer for all women. If you’d like to know more information about how we are supporting our employees, you can view our policies and benefits here . Offers of employment will be subject to background checks including references, police checks and may include a pre-employment medical. Beware, Job Applicants. At BASF, we are committed to providing a safe and transparent recruitment process. Please be aware of job scams and fraudulent job postings. Only apply through the official BASF Career website to ensure your application is received by us. Be cautious of unsolicited job offers or communications that do not come from official BASF email addresses. Verify any doubtful communications through our HR department. Never provide personal information or make payment as part of the application process. #LI-Jobs

jobs.name: Temporary Laboratory Assistant - MS Structural Elucidation (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture. #ForTheLoveOfFarming#TheBiggestJobOnEarth#AgEmployerOfChoice Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions! WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT In our APD/EFL Environmental Fate and Structure Elucidation unit, we conduct regulatory studies to ensure the safety of our products for consumers, the environment, and wildlife. A key part of our work is the structural elucidation of degradation products and production-related by-products. To determine chemical structures, we utilize state-of-the-art analytical techniques, particularly in the fields of mass spectrometry and NMR. We are looking for a new team member to support us on a fixed-term basis for 12 months with the possibility of an extension for a further 12 months. In this role, you independently operate and maintain analytical instruments in the areas of LC-MS and NMR. You also perform routine maintenance and minor repairs on these instruments. You develop and optimize analytical methods with a focus on chromatography and mass spectrometry. Your expertise is essential in evaluating measurement data using specialized software and interpreting results to address complex analytical questions. Together with your colleagues, you conduct GLP and non-GLP studies for the structural elucidation of crop protection products and their degradation products. You are responsible for the evaluation, documentation, and management of analytical data, preparing reports, coordinating outsourced analyses, and providing scientific customer support as part of GLP-compliant data generation. WHAT YOU OFFER completed vocational training as a Chemical Laboratory Technician or a comparable qualification at least four years of professional experience in mass spectrometry, structural elucidation, or a comparable analytical environment solid knowledge of mass spectrometry and experience working in a GLP-regulated environment. experience and knowledge in high-resolution mass spectrometry (HRMS) and NMR are an advantage very good German and good English language skills, as well as proficiency in common IT applications and databases strong communication skills, a collaborative mindset, and a structured, detail-oriented approach to work WHAT WE OFFER A dynamic work environment that empowers you to contribute your ideas, take ownership, and assume responsibility. A strong focus on continuous learning, modern technologies, and the responsible use of artificial intelligence, enabling us to work in a future‑oriented, efficient, and sustainable way while actively driving innovation. Inspiring networks for the development and implementation of your ideas (e.g. Women in Business). Learning opportunities for your professional and personal development. Career paths as professional development into other roles within the company. We actively support with childcare (e.g. company daycare, holiday programmes) and provide a fitness and health studio as well as a medical center with numerous offers for your health. We offer sustainable mobility benefits - a discounted Deutschlandticket for regional public transport, a job‑bike leasing program, and on‑site e‑charging stations for private electric vehicles to make your commute affordable, healthy, and climate‑friendly. HOW TO REACH US Romy Marie Brinsa (Talent Acquisition), romy.brinsa@basf.com, Tel: +49 30 2005-56730 will be happy to answer your questions for this position. You are also welcome to book an online appointment. You can also reach our recruiting team here . First information about our application process can be found here ABOUT US BASF Agricultural Solutions Deutschland GmbH is a reliable partner to the agricultural sector, offering innovative and sustainable solutions tailored to a wide range of crop systems. With the Agricultural Center in Limburgerhof, near the BASF Group headquarters in Ludwigshafen, you’ll find an attractive environment for both your professional life and your leisure time in the Rhine ‑ Neckar metropolitan region. You can learn more about the Agricultural Center in Limburgerhof here . Find out more about our Agricultural Solutions team here Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF In Global Business Services, we support BASF's divisions with a cross-functional network and offer modern solutions tailored to the needs of the business. You process business transactions in the general ledger and fixed asset accounting and ensure reconciliation with the subledgers. You are responsible for the timely preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in accordance with IFRS and HGB, as well as the preparation of income tax calculations for German BASF Group companies in the electromobility sector. In accounting matters, you serve as the central point of contact for our subsidiaries, the subledgers, and BASF’s central finance units. You can also reach our recruiting team here . First information about our application process can be found here . ABOUT US As an international service hub, the BASF Services Europe GmbH bundles a wide range of services for the BASF Group throughout Europe. In the heart of Berlin, we combine expertise in the areas of finance, HR, supply chain, procurement, product safety and IT. We focus on digital and customer-focused solutions, to create services for future. Learn more about us and our career opportunities here . Diversity is our greatest strength! jobs.name: EHS Specialist
jobs.description: Objectives of the Position To support the implementation and continuous improvement of Workplace Safety programs, regulatory compliance, emergency preparedness, and EHS initiatives for BASF Asia-Pacific Service Centre (KL Hub) and BASF Malaysia office (BuO) operations. The role serves as the operational focal point for Workplace Safety activities and stakeholder engagement, contributing to a safe, compliant, and resilient workplace environment that supports business growth, workplace transformation initiatives, and the transition towards a 24/7 operating model. M ain Tasks Functional Tasks (including but not limited to) Workplace EHS Compliance Serve as the Workplace Safety focal point for KL Hub and BuO offices, ensuring compliance with BASF requirements, local regulations, and corporate EHS standards. Support implementation and continuous improvement of safety programs, procedures, emergency response plans, risk management, and operational guidelines. Coordinate statutory and corporate EHS reporting and audits (e.g., DOSH, REHSA), monitor safety performance, and drive timely closure of findings and follow-up actions. Maintain safety and training records, certifications, inspection and incident reports, and other compliance documentation. Workplace Risk Management Lead risk assessments, hazard identification, safety inspections, observations, and compliance reviews. Coordinate periodic checks and maintenance of safety and emergency equipment (fire extinguishers, emergency lighting, smoke detectors, first aid, etc.) to ensure readiness. Investigate incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions, perform root-cause analysis, implement corrective/preventive actions, and track their effectiveness. Oversee IAQ, environmental monitoring, and workplace hygiene assessments with building management and service providers to drive improvements. Emergency Preparedness & Business Resilience Lead and improve emergency preparedness and response programs for KL Hub and BuO offices, including drills, exercises, and crisis simulations. Coordinate Emergency Response Team (ERT) activities: nomination, onboarding, training/certification renewals, duty rosters, annual planning etc. Actively participate in emergency response, crisis management, and business continuity efforts; monitor ERT effectiveness and drive improvements. Safety Culture & Capability Development Promote a proactive safety culture through engagement programs, awareness campaigns, safety communications, and wellbeing initiatives. Develop and deliver workplace safety and competency training (new joiner briefings, fire safety, emergency response, first aid, Global Safety Day, and EHS learning campaigns). Conduct safety inductions and orientations, share safety alerts/lessons learned/best practices, and support leadership engagement to reinforce ownership and accountability. Stakeholder Management Build and manage partnerships with Business Units, HR, Facilities, Procurement, Building Management, contractors, and service providers to improve Workplace Safety; provide guidance and escalate complex issues to the Senior Manager as needed. Serve as Secretary and EHS focal point for the Safety & Health and Emergency Response Team committees: coordinate meetings, management reviews, action tracking, governance reporting, and communicate key outcomes. Contractor Safety & Facilities Oversight Lead contractor safety for office projects, maintenance, renovations, fit-outs, relocations, and infrastructure upgrades: review risk assessments, method statements, and permit requirements, and ensure EHS requirements are integrated into workplace changes. Conduct contractor safety briefings, monitor compliance with BASF EHS and regulatory obligations, and coordinate with Facilities, Building Management, and contractors to ensure safe execution. Strategic Projects & Continuous Improvement Support and implement strategic EHS, workplace transformation, employee wellbeing, and operational excellence initiatives in line with business needs. Identify and drive process improvements, digitalization, standardization, and simplification for Workplace Safety programs; act as EHS focal point to ensure EHS requirements and risk management are integrated into workplace-related projects. Produce management reports, dashboards, and presentations to monitor project performance and support decision-making; support regional and global EHS initiatives as assigned. Act as the EHS focal point for workplace-related projects, ensuring EHS requirements, risk management principles,   and BASF standards are integrated throughout project planning and execution. Requirements Education Bachelor's Degree in Occupational Safety & Health, Environmental Science, Engineering, or a related discipline. Professional EHS certifications (Safety and Health Officer or Occupational Safety and Health (OSH) Coordinator) and relevant workplace safety experience would be an advantage. Work Experience >5 years of relevant experience in Occupational Safety & Health, Environmental Protection, EHS Management Systems, Workplace Safety, Facilities Safety, or related EHS functions. Experience in office/workplace environments, regulatory compliance, emergency preparedness, audit management, and EHS program implementation are an advantage

jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF In Global Business Services, we support BASF's divisions with a cross-functional network and offer modern solutions tailored to the needs of the business. In accounting matters, you serve as the central point of contact for our subsidiaries, the subledgers, and BASF’s central finance units. In the heart of Berlin, we combine expertise in the areas of finance, HR, supply chain, procurement, product safety and IT. We focus on digital and customer-focused solutions, to create services for future. Learn more about us and our career opportunities here . Diversity is our greatest strength! Jusqu’au 1er juillet, notre activité faisait partie de BASF. Dans le cadre de cette transition, toutes les offres d’emploi ainsi que le processus de candidature sont encore hébergés sur la plateforme BASF et présentés sous l’identité visuelle de BASF. Merci de ne pas vous laisser dérouter par cette situation : tous les postes proposés sont des opportunités au sein de Surventis, et votre candidature nous sera directement transmise. Chez Surventis, nous allons au-delà des apparences dans tout ce que nous entreprenons. Nous plaçons nos clients au cœur de nos décisions, anticipons leurs besoins et développons des solutions qui créent une véritable valeur ajoutée ainsi que des partenariats durables. Nous nous inspirons mutuellement à voir plus loin, à prendre pleinement la responsabilité de notre travail et à repousser sans cesse les limites du possible. VOS PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITES Rattaché au Responsable HSE, vous proposez et mettez en œuvre les systèmes et les programmes de prévention destinés à améliorer la sécurité des procédés du site en adéquation avec les exigences règlementaires et Groupe SURVENTIS. À ce titre : Vous garantissez l'animation de la politique du site en matière de sécurité des procédés ; Vous garantissez le pilotage des analyses de risques des installations lors des projets d´amélioration ou des installations nouvelles (APR, HAZOP, SHE review, PID review etc. ) en accord avec les référentiels Groupe et en lien avec les experts Groupe ; Vous garantissez la mise à jour des Études de Dangers sur les installations neuves ou existantes, notamment dans le cadre des révisions quinquennales ; Vous garantissez le conseil et l'assistance dans votre domaine ; Vous contribuez à la prévention et la maîtrise du risque industriel sur le site y compris au travers de l'animation du système de gestion de la sécurité (SGS) incluant la rédaction des dossiers de sécurité ; Vous contribuez à la mise en place et à l´évolution des procédures et consignes en sécurité des procédés et veiller à leurs conformités d'application ; Vous contribuez au respect des législations et réglementations et des exigences SURVENTIS en vigueur en matière de sécurité des procédés ; Vous contribuez à la gestion des modifications sur le site ; Vous contribuez aux missions du service HSE. jobs.description: Now hiring! AG Territory Manager - Calgary (High River - Crossfield) Field We are looking for a AG Territory Manager - Calgary (High River - Crossfield) Field to join our Agricultural Solutions team in Southern Alberta. Come create chemistry with us! BASF’s Agricultural Solutions division connects innovation, customers, partners and agricultural experts and integrates sustainability criteria into all business decisions. We help farmers deliver the best possible outcomes, working to achieve the balance between economic, environmental and social value creation for sustainable and efficient agriculture. We are looking for a Territory Manager to develop, cultivate, and maintain business relationships with assigned retail and grower customers within a set geography and is expected to drive continued sales growth with these customers. The Territory Manager will prioritize time and resources with customers identified in high-opportunity segments. As a AG Territory Manager - Calgary (High River - Crossfield) Field, you create chemistry by... Creating and executing annual and strategic territory plans that align with national and regional business objectives, while ensuring integration with marketing and customization for accurate forecasting. Developing account plans for strategic customers, including short- and long-term action plans to respond to market dynamics and ensure profitability. Managing relationships and resources by creating demand with growers and retailers as part of the territory plan, ensuring retailer demand creation aligns with account team activities and measuring customer satisfaction through feedback surveys. Identifying, negotiating, and closing sales opportunities with target customers for our portfolio. Determining when and how to use internal or external technical resources, partnering with Technical Services Representatives to educate retailers and growers on BASF innovations for new business opportunities. Aligning broader teams on strategic messaging and positioning and providing market intelligence to BASF’s Marketing team regarding industries, competitors, and customers. Participating in local and regional teams to meet customer needs and coaching and developing these skills in others through mentoring. If you have... A Bachelor's degree or diploma with a concentration in agronomy, chemistry, biology, business, agribusiness or related field. A minimum of 1.5 years’ experience with a Bachelor’s degree, or 3.5 years’ experience with an Associates Degree/2 year Diploma. Professional experience in sales, or a technical background within an agricultural-related field. Strong interpersonal communication skills combined with a passion for making a positive difference in the agriculture industry. Proven ability to develop and cultivate meaningful relationships with customers and internal stakeholders. Maintain or obtain CCSC designation within the first year of employment. Strong business acumen and technical proficiency, including working experience with Microsoft Office Suite & CRM. Ability to work independently to create a territory plan that is aligned with the national and regional objectives. Ability to self-manage time and resources and to allocate time and energy appropriately, resulting in achievement of goals. Create your own chemistry with you@BASF Adding value to our customers begins with adding value to you. you@BASF is the suite of benefits, perks, programs and unique opportunities we offer to support you – the whole you – in all stages of your life and career. jobs.name: Senior Counsel - Regulatory - RTP, NC
jobs.description: Now hiring! Senior Counsel - Regulatory - RTP, NC We are looking for a Senior Counsel - Regulatory to join our Agricultural Solutions team in [Location]. Come create chemistry with us! The Global Regulatory Legal group at BASF Agricultural Solutions provides strategic legal leadership on federal, state and international laws governing pesticides and products of biotechnology. The group also provides advice concerning laws and regulations governing trade standards like import tolerances and residue levels, and manages regulatory data cooperation and compensation. We are seeking an experienced professional like you to join our team as a senior leader responsible for advising BASF’s Agricultural Solutions functions in the US and Canada on critical regulatory, litigation and policy matters affecting them, overseeing high-impact risk areas and driving the global regulatory legal strategy. This position will report to the Head of Global Regulatory Legal. As a Senior Counsel - Regulatory - RTP, NC, you create chemistry by... Providing targeted legal advice and strategic guidance to the Regulatory Affairs and Regulatory Science units within BASF Agricultural Solutions North America and Canada, in connection with authorizations for and regulation of both crop protection products and seed and trait products, as well as handle FIFRA data compensation. Advising on compliance with regulatory requirements governing BASF Agricultural Solutions’ portfolio of conventional and biological pesticides and pest control products, agricultural seed treatments, and seeds with biotech traits, among others, subject to a wide variety of US and Canadian laws, in support of obtaining new product approvals, addressing related operational incidents, asserting confidentiality claims, conducting investigations and voluntary disclosures of potential regulatory deviations, and defending the company against enforcement claims. Proactively collaborating in the Global Regulatory Legal group supporting BASF Agricultural Solutions in its strategic positioning in the US and Canada and in other regions countries in alignment with the Global Regulatory Legal License-to-Operate (LTO) strategy. You will further represent BASF Agricultural Solutions in law committees of product regulatory – related trade associations in the US. Advising, integrating, and supporting litigation and disputes over BASF Agricultural Solutions’ LTO, including FIFRA data compensation proceedings, as well as providing early alerts regarding anticipated potential litigation risks to product authorizations arising under North American pesticide laws, including endangered species, and seeds and traits laws. Reviewing and commenting on advertising material for agricultural solutions products to ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements and industry standards, and drafting and reviewing product regulatory provisions in transactional documents, including stock and asset purchase and sale agreements, agreements for the purchase or sale of goods or services, confidentiality agreements, and material transfer agreements. If you... Have a Juris Doctorate degree and an active license to practice law in at least one US state orof the District of Columbia. Possess at least 15 years’ expertise in a law firm, corporation, or regulatory authority focused on US pesticide and plant biotech law. Demonstrate a deep understanding of the US agricultural industry and agricultural solutions business. Display exceptional and effective written and oral communications skills and excellent ability to teamwork. Combine your vision for change and impact, and your ability to both identify problems and present creative alternatives and solutions. Have outstanding analytical abilities. Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF. We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us As one of the largest chemical companies in North America we have been finding solutions for your everyday needs and addressing the most complex economic, environmental, and sustainability challenges for more than 150 years! At BASF we empower our employees with the tools, guidance and opportunities they need to advance and succeed in work and life. Giving you the support you need to be your best and fulfill your personal ambitions is what helps us create chemistry. After all, our success is linked to yours. Whatever path you envision, BASF is a great place to build a rewarding, successful career. Belong to Something Bigger. #belongatBASF Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. If you have experienced any of the above, please contact Careers.NorthAmerica@basf.com to report fraud. Equal employment opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

jobs.name: Seed production and Logistics support (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF We are BASF in agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. We do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture by connecting innovation, customers and society. Come join us on our journey to create solutions for sustainable agriculture at the Innovation Center of BASF Agricultural Solutions Belgium NV in Belgium. We are seeking a dynamic and skilled Seed production and Logistics support (m/f/d) at the earliest possible date to join the regional OSR Seed Production management team in the execution of seed production transactions like quality analyses requests, SAP, sample handling, seed production certification, logistics, seed handling, field tasks to achieve high quality OSR commercial seed within the predetermined timelines. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth Take a look at our Agricultural Solutions: Vision & Mission WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Manage basic seed shipment for commercial seed production to multipliers: transaction in SAP, Masterdata creation, add all documents, physical prepare and tasks linked to it within the agreed deadlines. Manage and execute all seed handling for the grow-out test in Belgium, Italy, contra-season and store all incoming seed lots of commercial seed production for the 2 production seasons. Execute all requests for quality analyses in the quality management system for parental lines and commercial OSR seed production ensuring that the seed lots meet internal and external quality parameters. Execute the seed certification process: declaration, registration and labeling of the production lots for OSR parental lines within the growing season. Execute the OSR purchase orders, all invoices and payments related to Supply Chain business, field and seed productions agreements,… Execute OSR seed production activities for pre-basic, basic, and commercial seed to meet production plan objectives and targets in Belgium and EU. WHAT YOU OFFER Bachelor’s degree Logistic, Agriculture or equivalence through experience with minimum 3 to 5 year of experience. Fluent in Dutch and English, notions of French is a plus. Intermediate to advanced computer expertise of MS Office, email tool, SAP and StarLims. Experience in seed production is an advantage. The ability to work independently as well as in a team. Strong organizational and planning skills with attention to detail. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills. Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Positive and proactive attitude towards new responsibilities and challenges. Flexibility in working hours to meet operational requirements. Willingness to travel internationally when required. WHAT WE OFFER A permanent contract within an attractive working environment in a professional and motivated team. Interesting and challenging learning and development opportunities to help you make the most of your talents and your job. An attractive base salary in relation to your diploma and competencies, an annual bonus and extra-legal benefits. HOW TO REACH US If you need more information about the process or the vacancy, you can reach our recruiting team here . ABOUT US BASF is a multinational company dedicated to revolutionizing agricultural science. We are committed to developing innovative solutions that address global challenges in food security and sustainability. Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

Based at our Savannah facility, you will contribute to the production of FCC catalysts, co-catalysts, and additives that help petroleum refiners convert crude oil into gasoline, transportation fuels, heating oil, and petrochemical feedstocks serving industries worldwide. During your 12-hour rotating shift as a Operator Associate, you will Operate major plant equipment and/or processes (pumps, valves, filters, screens, compressors, dryers, etc.) following standard procedures and practices, as well as participate in system improvement processes. Maintain equipment and diagnoses problems to avoid shutdowns. Drive/Operate a Forklift. Keep records and interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form. jobs.name: Specialist, Process &Technology Transfer
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities . Objectives bridge development with commercial manufacturing. Lead and coordinate the transfer of innovative chemical manufacturing processes from laboratory development through pilot-scale validation and commercial production with external partners at toll manufacturing sites. collaborate closely with Process Development scientists, tolling steering manager and external toll manufacturing organizations to ensure robust, safe, and economically viable production processe M ain Tasks Lead end-to-end technology transfer projects from laboratory through pilot-scale validation and commercial manufacturing with external partners and toll manufacturers. Develop and execute technology transfer plans to ensure smooth implementation at manufacturing sites. Establish clear project objectives, timelines, deliverables, and success criteria. Evaluate process scalability, equipment compatibility, and manufacturing feasibility. Prepare and maintain comprehensive technology transfer packages. Identify and mitigate technical risks associated with process scale-up. Support pilot plant campaigns and analyze results to optimize process performance. Provide technical support during production startup, validation, and commercial manufacturing. Troubleshoot process, yield, quality, or operational issues during scale-up and introduction into mass production. Work with manufacturing teams to improve productivity, cost efficiency, process robustness, and product quality. Monitor critical process parameters and establish process control strategies. Generate project reports for internal and external stakeholders. Serve as the technical interface between BASF and contract manufacturing partners. Take part to or conduct technical assessments of external manufacturing facilities. Support pilot & production trials and process validation activities at tolling sites. Ensure all process transfers comply with BASF EHS standards, safety & operational standards, local regulatory requirements, quality management systems and customer requirements. Contribute to process innovation and best-practice sharing across BASF Global manufacturing networks. Be an active part of cross-functional teams to ensure timely execution of project milestones. Minimum Education and Qualification Required for the Position Education Engineer Degree in Chemical Engineering, Chemical Process Engineering, Industrial Chemical Engineering, or a related scientific field with significant industrial experience in chemical manufacturing and process scale-up Alternatively PhD in Chemistry with experience in Industrial Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Polymer Chemistry, Process Chemistry, or a related discipline with significant industrial experience in chemical manufacturing and process scale-up. Language Chinese native + Fluent in English written and spoken. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both Chinese and English. Professional experience Minimum 3 years of industrial experience in Chemical manufacturing, Technology transfer, Process scale-up or Pilot plant operations Proven experience in transferring processes from laboratory to pilot scale and commercial production. Experience in working with external contract manufacturers or toll manufacturers is highly desirable. Experience in specialty chemicals, performance materials, coatings, polymers, electronic materials or related industries is an advantage. Understanding of process safety and manufacturing risk assessment methodologies is an added value.

Bolder ambition. If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact, and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place. Surventis is a global expert in the development, production and marketing of innovative and sustainable automotive OEM and refinish coatings, decorative paints as well as applied surface treatments for metal, plastic and glass substrates in a wide range of industries. This portfolio is supplemented by "Beyond Paint Solutions," which enables new applications with innovative surfaces. You will work with some of the largest Body Shop and Distribution organizations in the market through paint application process development, correct application of products through teaching & hands on demonstrations and helping the sales team convert new business. You will work closely with the sales team to make sure our distribution partners are properly trained and can effectively sell and position our product offerings against competitive product lines. In addition, you will work with the Business Development and Sales team to gain new business and ensure identified Body Shop KPI’s are achieved. As a Technical Service Specialist –New England - Automotive Refinish you will... Be responsible for the technical success of Surventis’ automotive refinish products, in the New England/Upstate NY markets. Work on coating technologies including solvent & waterborne base coat/clear coat systems, OEM paint approval process, new product and process development at the field level and affecting positive financial impact through product usage and application training. Train and develop our Body Shop and Distribution customers, you will make process improvement recommendations that can be highly valuable to end users. Lead new product and customer demonstrations, being proficient in product application, selling and implementing new products, and generating a positive experience with Surventis-branded products. Participate in the technical aspects of the sales process. Lead customer training to ensure Surventis product proficiencies and product conversions of new Surventis customers. Work with the Surventis team to help meet and exceed new business and financial targets. Add value to our customers through root cause analysis, trouble-shooting technical applications, and color match issues. If you have... HS Diploma (or equivalent) coupled with relevant experience. At least 10+ years of industry experience as a refinish tech. Strong understanding of competitive products and tools. Proficiency with Surventis’ current Automotive Refinish products and technology tools (a plus). Ability to utilize Microsoft Office tools to lead presentations focused on introducing new products to the market and supporting a better understanding of Surventis-branded products. CRM expertise is a plus. Privacy statement Surventis takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. The competitive Pay Range for this role is $85,000 - 105,000 depending on qualifications.  Actual pay will be determined based on education, certifications, experience, and other job-related factors permitted by law. Monitor approximately 1,600 chemical registrations representing nearly 900 unique products, ensuring the accuracy of hazard classifications, SDS documentation, storage locations and lifecycle information. Support implementation of new projects, new technologies and new products from a biosafety and chemical safety perspective. jobs.name: Sr Agronomic Sales Advisor - South Dakota (Field)
jobs.description: Now hiring! Sr Agronomic Sales Advisor - South Dakota We are looking for an Sr Agronomic Sales Advisor to join our Agricultural Solutions team. Welcome to BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth #AgEmployerOfChoice Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions! As a Sr Agronomic Sales Advisor, you create chemistry by... Creating demand for BASF seed, crop protection, and seed treatment products while serving as a trusted advisor on agronomics, seed varieties, and crop solutions. Establishing strategic business and agronomic plans with key growers, acting as the primary BASF contact to support both short and long-term business objectives. Developing and executing territory plans for seed, crop protection, and seed treatment products, while building strong partnerships with internal teams and retail customers to achieve shared goals. Driving seed growth opportunities through retailer engagement, joint customer visits, and targeted product positioning to maximize performance on every acre. Managing sales plans, forecasts, product positioning, and revenue targets with assigned retailers, while accurately forecasting demand and delivering financial results. Cultivating strong relationships with sales teams, technical service representatives, and strategic account managers to support customer success and business growth. Developing and implementing market strategies, product launches, and territory growth plans that identify key opportunities, strengthen customer relationships, and drive long-term business performance. If you... Have a Bachelors Degree and knowledge and previous sales experience with agronomics, seed varieties and chemistry. Bring 5+ years sales experience with 8+ years overall experience. Possess strong business acumen and agronomic skills for seed and crop protection. Have experience working well in a team environment with a positive attitude and creativity. Successfully engage across the business. Have strong computer skills, as well as experience with Digital Tools such as SalesForce and Xarvio. Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF. We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us BASF Agricultural Solutions is a trusted partner to the agricultural industry, delivering innovative and sustainable solutions that help farmers succeed across a wide range of cropping systems. Across North America, our teams work together to address some of agriculture's most important challenges while creating value for customers, communities, and the environment. At BASF, you'll find opportunities to grow your career, collaborate with talented colleagues, and make a meaningful impact through work that matters. Find out more about our Agricultural Solutions team here . Our people are at the heart of everything, dedicated to delivering value for our customers every day. By focusing on enabling our people today and in the future, we will ensure we have the talent and skills needed to succeed. United by the love of farming, we innovate, collaborate, and strive for the best solutions together, creating connections and driving success as one team. This is how we make an impact. For the love of farming, the biggest job on Earth. Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. If you have experienced any of the above, please contact Careers.NorthAmerica@basf.com to report fraud. Pay transparency BASF is committed to pay transparency practices. The competitive Pay Range for this role is $110,960 - $152,570. Actual pay will be determined based on education, certifications, experience, and other job-related factors permitted by law. Equal employment opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

jobs.name: Senior Technician, Utilities Grade 1
jobs.description: Main Tasks & Responsibilities 1) Operates the utilities plants and maintains them in good operational order. 2) The utilities plants include, a) Treated water storage and supply system, Water Demineralization Plant, Cooling Water Systems and Fire Hydrant pumping facilities. b) Steam Generation Plants and distribution system. c) Air Compressors and compressed air supply system. d) Nitrogen Membrane Generator, LIN storage & Evaporator and N2 distribution system. 3) Operates and monitors the running of the Diesel Engine Emergency Generator set during TNB power failure. 4) Records the daily stock level and consumption of utilities direct and indirect raw materials such as boiler gas fuel and water treatment chemicals. 5) Records daily utilities supply figures in the computerized log sheets. 6) Keeps the utilities plants and materials storage areas clean and tidy. 7) Assists maintenance craftsmen in carrying out maintenance works on the utilities equipment and machinery during a major overhaul or a plant shutdown. 8) To assists in the factory Emergency Response Plan and fire fighting as per instruction given or other emergency requirement. 9) To assists specific task assigned by the Snr. Manager-UGF or Supervisor UGF as and when required. 10) To support the implementation of ISO 9001, ISO 14001, 5S and Process Safety Management by practicing them accordingly to ensure full compliance with the requirements as stipulated in the system Qualification 1) SPM (min grade 2) with pass in English, or 3 years working experience in Boiler House, with 1st grade boiler man certification & with Engine driver grade 1. 2) Added knowledge of utilities plant like Demin. plant / Air Compressor / Nitrogen Membrane Generators & Evaporator 3) In depth technical knowledge of boiler operation technology and all the equipment and machinery design, functions, limitations, operability, maintainability and safety features. 4) Familiar and knowledgeable with local regulations with regards to boiler operation. 5) Ability to use computers for the normal management use and knowledgeable in the common software like Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Words and Microsoft PowerPoint. 6) Good level knowledge and ability to speak, read and write in the English language, 7) Familiar and experienced in ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 18001, 5S which are management standards implemented and practised by BASF.

jobs.name: Principal Analyst Cyber Security Defense Center (m/f/d)
jobs.description: ABOUT US At BASF Digital Hub Madrid we develop innovative digital solutions for BASF, create new exciting customer experiences and business growth, and drive efficiencies in processes, helping to strengthen BASF´s position as the digital leader in the chemical industry. We believe the right path is through creativity, trial and error and great people working and learning together. Become part of our team and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace and strongly encourage applications from individuals with disabilities. We value diversity and believe that varied perspectives enhance our team's effectiveness. Our hiring practices are designed to ensure equal opportunity for all candidates. As Principal Analyst, you are the most senior technical authority within the CSDC - a recognized subject matter expert who leads from expertise, not hierarchy. You shape the strategic direction of our detection and response capabilities, act as the technical bridge to adjacent security functions, and represent the CSDC in internal governance bodies and external communities. RESPOSIBILITIES Lead the technical response to our most complex and high-risk security incidents as Case Lead - from triage and analysis through containment, eradication, resolution, and closure Lead investigations and compromise assessments Analyze complex malicious artifacts (binaries, scripts, documents) through static and dynamic analysis and reverse engineering to determine their underlying, often obfuscated, functionality Drive our hypothesis-driven threat hunting program: design hunting campaigns, validate hypotheses against threat intelligence, and convert findings into durable detection coverage Design, review, and continuously improve detection logic, correlation rules, and SOAR playbooks on our Elastic Security platform, applying Detection-as-Code practices Shape the CSDC automation and AI roadmap: co-design AI-assisted triage and investigation workflows and supervise their operation with clear human-in-the-loop safeguards Define the strategic roadmap for detection and response capabilities together with CSDC leadership; evaluate and recommend new technologies, tools, and methodologies Act as technical advisor to CSDC leadership on capability development, and as senior escalation point and on-call resource for critical incidents Mentor and train Tier 2 and Tier 3 analysts; jobs.name: QA/QC Supervisor, Environmental
jobs.description: Now hiring! QA/QC Supervisor, Environmental Palmyra, MO (Onsite) We are looking for a QA/QC Supervisor, Environmental to join our Agricultural Solutions team in Palmyra, MO. The QA/QC Supervisor plays a key role in maintaining compliant and reliable plant operations by partnering daily with EHS and plant teams, including supervisors, maintenance personnel, and operators, to ensure the site operates within NPDES permit limits. The role provides timely analytical support to guide operational decisions, maintain continuous laboratory coverage for manufacturing, and address water, soil, waste, and other environmental matters in collaboration with the Waste Specialist. In addition to leading, developing, and training direct reports, the supervisor contributes to environmental and quality investigations by helping identify root causes and implement effective corrective actions. The position also provides backup supervisory support for the QA/QC Supervisor. Welcome to BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth #AgEmployerOfChoice Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions! As a QA/QC Supervisor, Environmental, you create chemistry by... Maintaining compliance with all safety regulations and procedures. Leading and developing direct reports in meeting performance, development and organizational objectives. Ensuring training of direct reports and documentation of training is current. Providing analytical support to ensure continuous lab operations and support NPDES (water) permit, air permits, soil management plan, RCRA, HWMACT and other compliant sample points. Setting up and maintaining laboratory instruments as needed. Ensuring processes are in place to communicate data to operations, monitor check samples, prepare mobile phases and standards, etc. Setting up and running standard methods in-house or develop/adjust BASF analytical methods as needed to meet compliance requirements and support production troubleshooting. Responsible for microbial contamination monitoring. Leading and contributing to quality investigations with site personnel teams to obtain root cause and effective corrective actions. Leading standards management program for the Americas, ensuring adequate supply of analytical standards are available, orders are filled and distributed promptly and packaged/shipped following IATA requirements. Assisting quality management system activities. (QC data back up/storage/retrieval). Providing technical assistance as needed for process adjustments and laboratory troubleshooting and off schedule samples. If you... Have a BS/BA degree in Chemistry, Biology, or a related field. Bring 5 years of analytical laboratory experience in Quality Assurance or Quality Control from manufacturing or environmental laboratory Bring 2 years of supervisory experience, preferred. Apply working knowledge of laboratory analytical testing and/or microbiological testing techniques. Leverage knowledge of quality systems and continuous improvement practices, such as ISO 9001, Lean Manufacturing principles or Good Laboratory Practice (GLP); experience in these areas is preferred. Demonstrate strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and clear written and verbal communication. Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF. We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us BASF Agricultural Solutions is a trusted partner to the agricultural industry, delivering innovative and sustainable solutions that help farmers succeed across a wide range of cropping systems. Across North America, our teams work together to address some of agriculture's most important challenges while creating value for customers, communities, and the environment. At BASF, you'll find opportunities to grow your career, collaborate with talented colleagues, and make a meaningful impact through work that matters. Find out more about our Agricultural Solutions team here . Our people are at the heart of everything, dedicated to delivering value for our customers every day. By focusing on enabling our people today and in the future, we will ensure we have the talent and skills needed to succeed. United by the love of farming, we innovate, collaborate, and strive for the best solutions together, creating connections and driving success as one team. This is how we make an impact. For the love of farming, the biggest job on Earth. Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. If you have experienced any of the above, please contact Careers.NorthAmerica@basf.com to report fraud. Equal employment opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

jobs.name: Sales Promotion Staff (North West) (12 months contract)
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities . Main responsibilities Manage sub-dealers across Chiang Mai, Lampang, Lamphun, and Chiang Rai to meet sales targets, conducting regular visits to drive sales performance. Responsible for executing campaigns and generating reports for sales involving dealers, sub-dealers, and farmers, as well as reports for promoters regarding sub-dealers and farmers. Develop an effective network comprising dealers, sub-dealers, and key farmers. Field activities and demand creation in area, support and response document to Senior Promoter in area. Support to achieve teamwork and team spirit within business unit. Strengthen relationships with sub-dealer and key farmers. Respond to company requirement and system. Prepare and submit market information reports to the Senior Executive, Sales Executive, Area Sales Manager, or Sales Manager. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in agriculture, Agronomy, Crop Science, or a related field. 2–3 years of field experience within the agricultural or seed industry. jobs.description: Praktikum Product Stewardship & Regulatory Affairs - Care Chemicals (m/w/d) Stellendetails | BASF SE Zum Hauptinhalt Stellen finden Sprache Ceština (Ceská republika) Dansk (Danmark) Deutsch (Deutschland) Ελληνικά (Ελλάδα) English (United States) Español (España) Español (México) Français (France) Magyar (Magyarország) Italiano (Italia) 日本語 (日本) 한국어 (대한민국) Norsk bokmål ‎(Norwegian Bokmål) Nederlands (België / Nederland) Polski (Polska) Português (Brasil) Português (Portugal) Slovencina (Slovensko) Svenska (Konungariket Sverige) ภาษาไทย (ประเทศไทย) Türkçe (Türkiye) 简体中文 (中国大陆) 繁體中文(台灣) Anmeldung für Mitarbeitende Stellenbeschreibung Praktikum Product Stewardship & Regulatory Affairs - Care Chemicals (m/w/d) STANDORT UNTERNEHMEN EINSATZGEBIET VERTRAGSART REFERENZCODE FLEXIBLE ARBEITSOPTIONEN STANDORT UNTERNEHMEN EINSATZGEBIET VERTRAGSART REFERENZCODE FLEXIBLE ARBEITSOPTIONEN Jetzt bewerben WILLKOMMEN BEI UNS Wir bei Care Chemicals handeln aus Leidenschaft. Unsere Mitarbeiter:innen sind unser wertvollstes Gut und wir pflegen eine Kultur der Empathie, der Unterstützung und des Wachstums. Auf diese Weise befähigen wir unser Team, sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Mit vereinten Kräften engagieren wir uns für die Entwicklung nachhaltiger, digitaler und innovativer Lösungen für eine bessere Zukunft. Pflegende Hautcremes, milde Shampoos, Sonnenschutzmittel, schonende und umweltfreundliche Waschmittel und leistungsstarke Reiniger für Haushalt und Industrie – all diese Produkte nutzen Inhaltsstoffe aus unserem Bereich Care Chemicals. Darüber hinaus bieten wir beispielsweise Lösungen auf dem Gebiet des Pflanzenschutzes, für technische Anwendungen in der Bauchemie oder Rohstoffe für die Lackindustrie sowie digitale Services für unsere Kunden. Weltweit arbeiten wir gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden an innovativen Lösungen, die Endverbraucher:innen und industrielle Formulierer überzeugen – und das zunehmend auf Basis von natürlichen und nachhaltig gewonnenen Rohstoffen. Lassen Sie uns gemeinsam eine bessere Zukunft entwerfen! WAS SIE ERWARTET Im Product Stewardship & Regulatory Team unseres Geschäftsbereichs Care Chemicals bieten wir Ihnen im Rahmen eines Praktikums für 6 bis 12 Monate die Möglichkeit, vielfältige Einblicke in nationale und internationale regulatorische Themen zu gewinnen. In einem wertschätzenden und unterstützenden Umfeld arbeiten Sie gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Kolleginnen und Kollegen an aktuellen Fragestellungen und Projekten und lernen die unterschiedlichen Anforderungen entlang der Wertschöpfungskette kennen. Gemeinsam mit Ihrem Team unterstützen Sie die Bearbeitung regulatorischer Fragestellungen im Zusammenhang mit nationalen und internationalen Chemikaliengesetzen wie REACH und CLP. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Kolleginnen und Kollegen tragen Sie dazu bei, Anforderungen aus sektorspezifischen Regelungen, beispielsweise der Detergenzien-Verordnung oder der Kosmetikgesetzgebung, zu analysieren und verständlich aufzubereiten. Sie unterstützen die Bewertung und Bearbeitung von Kundenanforderungen sowie Anforderungen externer Interessengruppen, beispielsweise im Bereich Tierschutz oder Umweltzeichen. Darüber hinaus wirken Sie bei der Zusammenarbeit mit Branchenverbänden sowie bei der Beobachtung regulatorischer Entwicklungen und Advocacy-Themen mit. Nicht zuletzt leisten Sie einen wichtigen Beitrag zum Aufbau und zur Pflege eines vertrauensvollen Netzwerks mit internen und externen Partner:innen. WAS SIE MITBRINGEN Bachelorabschluss in Chemie oder Naturwissenschaften oder eines ähnlichen Studiengangs Interesse an Regulatorik und/oder Product Stewardship versierter Umgang mit MS-Office-Anwendungen sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit sowohl in Englisch als auch Deutsch (mindestens auf B2-Niveau) Teamplayer sowie ausgeprägte strategische und analytische Denkweise Bereitschaft, an drei Tagen der Woche in Monheim zu arbeiten WAS WIR BIETEN Sie sind vom ersten Tag an Teil des BASF-Teams. Wir zahlen Ihnen eine attraktive Praktikantenvergütung: Bachelorstudierende: 800 € monatliches Bruttoentgelt für Pflicht- oder freiwillige Praktika Masterstudierende: 1.000 € monatliches Bruttoentgelt für Pflicht- oder freiwillige Praktika Freiwillige Praktika mit einer Dauer von mehr als 3 Monaten werden gemäß den gesetzlichen Vorgaben mit dem Mindestlohn vergütet. Bei uns steigen Sie in anspruchsvolle Arbeitsgebiete ein und übernehmen spannende Aufgaben und nach Möglichkeit Teilprojekte in einem interdisziplinären Arbeitsumfeld. Ergänzend bieten die BASF Standorte unterschiedliche Möglichkeiten wie Führungen oder Workshops an, um BASF näher kennen zu lernen. So gewinnen Sie vielfältige Einblicke und Erfahrungen bei dem größten Chemieunternehmen weltweit. Informationen zu Praktika finden Sie hier. SO ERREICHEN SIE UNS Sie haben Fragen zum Ablauf oder zu der Stelle? Wenden Sie sich an: Corinna Granterath (Talent Acquisition), corinna.granterath@basf.com, Tel.:+49 30 2005-59302. Gerne können Sie sich auch einen Online-Termin buchen. Unser Recruiting-Team erreichen Sie auch hier Erste Infos zu unserem Bewerbungsprozess finden Sie hier ÜBER UNS Pflegende Cremes, milde Shampoos, starke Stylinggele, glänzende Lippenstifte und schützende Sonnenlotionen - all diese Produkte enthalten Inhaltsstoffe der BASF Personal Care and Nutrition GmbH, einer Tochtergesellschaft der BASF. Auf Basis natürlicher, nachwachsender Rohstoffe entwickeln und produzieren wir ein großes Sortiment an Inhaltsstoffen für die Körperpflegeindustrie. Mehr über die BASF Personal Care and Nutrition GmbH erfahren Sie unter: on.basf.com/CareAndNutrition Vielfalt ist unsere größte Stärke! Werden Sie Teil unserer Erfolgsformel und gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft – in einem globalen Team, das Inklusion und Chancengleichheit unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, sexueller Orientierung, Behinderung oder Weltanschauung lebt. Und übrigens, wir überlassen es unseren Mitarbeitenden, ob und wann sie sich duzen. jobs.name: Cyber Security Product Owner (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF At BASF, we enable secure, modern and user-friendly authentication across our global enterprise. Our team provides reliable login capabilities for business-critical applications across cloud and on-premises environments based on one federated identity. We are responsible for authentication technologies such as Smartcards, Windows Hello for Business and FIDO2, ensuring secure access for employees and administrators worldwide. As a core part of BASF's Cyber Security and Identity & Access Management landscape, we are driving the adoption of phishing-resistant and passwordless authentication technologies that strengthen security while improving user experience. To strengthen our team in Madrid, we are looking for a Senior Cyber Security Engineer who combines technical expertise, hands-on engineering and architectural thinking to help shape the future of authentication at one of the world's leading chemical companies. RESPONSIBILITIES As a Senior Product Owner, you will be responsible for the overall success, strategy, and lifecycle management of BASF's authentication services. Your responsibilities will include: Own the vision, strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle management for BASF's authentication services, including Smartcard Management, Smartcards, Windows Hello for Business, and FIDO2 Define and drive the product roadmap in alignment with BASF's Cyber Security, Identity Security, and Zero Trust strategies Prioritize business requirements, customer needs, security objectives, and technical capabilities to maximize product value Manage and continuously refine the product backlog, ensuring transparency and alignment across stakeholders Act as the primary interface between business stakeholders, Cyber Security teams, architects, engineers, service providers, and management Drive the adoption of phishing-resistant and passwordless authentication technologies across BASF Define service objectives, KPIs, service quality targets, and success metrics Lead product lifecycle activities, including demand management, service evolution, innovation management, and decommissioning decisions Ensure alignment between product investments, business priorities, compliance requirements, and operational capabilities Support architectural and technology jobs.name: Sr Agronomic Solutions Advisor - Central California
jobs.description: Now hiring! Now hiring! Sr Agronomic Solutions Advisor I – California - Field We are looking for an Sr Agronomic Solutions Advisor to join our Agricultural Solutions team in Central California. Welcome to BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth #AgEmployerOfChoice Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions! As a Sr Agronomic Solutions Advisor – Central California, you create chemistry by... Creating demand for BASF crop protection products with assigned growers, as well as be a trusted adviser in the industry. Establishing business and agronomic plans with key growers, including business strategies and tactics that meet the needs of targeted growers. You will also be acting as the primary contact from BASF, including business strategies and tactics for both short and long term. You will also establish a strong partnership with your BR and align on a strategic plan toward targeted retailers and growers to achieve goals. You will also accurately be forecasting brand sales with assigned customers and achieving financial goals. Cultivating solid working relationships with local sales teams, technical service representatives, and strategic account managers to support implementation of customer plans. Developing and executing market strategies to launch new products per established goals, market development execution, crop activities, and product positioning.  Additionally, you will be developing an area/territory plan annually that includes overall business objectives, strategies for growth, identification of top customers, and an action plan to achieve overall growth. If you... Have a Bachelors Degree and knowledge and previous sales experience with agronomics and chemistry. Bring 8+ years sales experience. Possess strong business acumen and agronomic skills for crop protection. Have experience working well in a team environment with a positive attitude and creativity. Successfully engage across the business. Have strong computer skills, as well as experience with Digital Tools such as SalesForce. Must have PCA license or able to obtain immediately. Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF. We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us BASF Agricultural Solutions is a trusted partner to the agricultural industry, delivering innovative and sustainable solutions that help farmers succeed across a wide range of cropping systems. Across North America, our teams work together to address some of agriculture's most important challenges while creating value for customers, communities, and the environment. At BASF, you'll find opportunities to grow your career, collaborate with talented colleagues, and make a meaningful impact through work that matters. Find out more about our Agricultural Solutions team here . Our people are at the heart of everything, dedicated to delivering value for our customers every day. By focusing on enabling our people today and in the future, we will ensure we have the talent and skills needed to succeed. United by the love of farming, we innovate, collaborate, and strive for the best solutions together, creating connections and driving success as one team. This is how we make an impact. For the love of farming, the biggest job on Earth. Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. If you have experienced any of the above, please contact Careers.NorthAmerica@basf.com to report fraud. Pay transparency BASF is committed to pay transparency practices. The competitive Pay Range for this role is $110,960 - $152,570. Actual pay will be determined based on education, certifications, experience, and other job-related factors permitted by law. Equal employment opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.
