Ons logistiek productieteam neemt alle laad- en los-activiteiten voor zich. In hoofdzaak omvat dit het laden en lossen van tankwagens en ketelwagons, en het bedrijven van afvul- en afzaklijnen. Wil jij een sleutelrol spelen in de logistieke operaties bij BASF? Als logistiek operator krijg je de kans om verschillende taken en werkposten te bemannen en door te groeien binnen ons team. JOUW UITDAGING Dit is wat je te wachten staat: Als logistiek operator ben je verantwoordelijk voor de fysieke afhandeling van verpakkings-, verladings- en verzendingsopdrachten bij BASF. Samen met je collega’s voer je in hoofdzaak de bulk belading van (gevaarlijke) vloeistoffen uit. Daarnaast werk je aan verschillende logistieke taken zoals het laden en lossen van vrachtwagens en containers met een vorkheftruck, het afzakken/afvullen van producten en de bediening van complexe IBC/vat-afvullijnen. Je bouwt waardevolle ervaring op en daardoor kan je op termijn ingezet worden op verschillende laadplaatsen. Jouw expertise groeit, waardoor je diverse complexere taken tot een goed einde kan brengen. Op termijn kan je doorgroeien naar een leidinggevende rol. ONZE IDEALE MATCH Je hebt minstens 2 jaar ervaring in vergelijkbare complexere logistieke activiteiten, ervaring met een heftruck is een pluspunt maar geen vereiste. Je bent leergierig en wil je graag verder verdiepen in deze materie. Onder stress presteer je goed en blijf je rustig en klantvriendelijk. Je bent fysiek fit en houdt ervan om actief bezig te zijn. Een positieve werksfeer is voor jou belangrijk, en je helpt je collega's waar nodig. Je hebt oog voor detail en afwerking in je werkzaamheden. Dit vertaalt zich ook naar je veiligheidsbewustzijn. Je bent bereid om in shiften te werken: 2- of 3-ploegen. ONS AANBOD Een uitdagende en dynamische functie in een stabiel bedrijf met een familiale sfeer. Een hartelijke ontvangst tijdens onze onthaaldagen en begeleiding door ervaren collega's. Een groeiend salarispakket (je start met een bruto jaarloon tussen 68 346,09 € en 71 417,15 € (inclusief shiftpremie op basis van 2 ploegen en vakantiegeld) afhankelijk van jouw ervaring) met een keuzeplan waarmee je brutoloon kan omzetten in andere voordelen, zoals extra verlof, een leasefiets, een elektrische leasewagen of gadgets zoals laptop, smartphone of tablet. Diverse sociale voorzieningen, waaronder een pensioenplan, hospitalisatie- en ambulante zorgverzekering voor jou en je gezin. Een goede balans tussen werk en privé: Met minstens 49 vrije dagen per jaar en extra vrije dagen door je shiftwerk, heb je ruimte om te genieten van je privéleven terwijl je op andere momenten aan de slag bent. Een keuken en afhaalmaaltijden in de buurt, maandelijkse fruitbedeling en maaltijdcheques zijn voorzien. Alternatieve transportmogelijkheden, zoals gratis busvervoer en carpooling. Volop kansen voor zelfontwikkeling door ons ruime opleidingsaanbod en interne jobmarkt. Selectieprocedure: HR gesprekken: tussen 29 sept en 20 okt. Technische screening: 21 okt of 29 okt of 30 okt. Je mag feedback verwachten in november. MEER OVER ONS BASF Antwerpen is het meest toonaangevende chemiebedrijf ter wereld, dankzij onze diverse teams die intelligente oplossingen ontwikkelen voor een duurzame toekomst. Onze chemische productiesite draait al op groene stroom en we streven ernaar de eerste klimaat-neutrale site te worden. Met zo'n 3700 collega's met verschillende achtergronden, bieden we een inspirerende werkomgeving waar iedereen zichzelf kan zijn en talenten maximaal kunnen ontwikkelen. Voel je de chemie? jobs.description: Now hiring! Sr. Account Manager - High Tech Leafy Southern US (Remote) Company vehicle provided We are looking for a Senior Account Manager - High Tech Leafy to join our Agricultural Solutions team for our Vegetable Seeds business. The ideal candidate will be located in the Mid-Southern US, but open to other locations in the continental US. The Senior Account Manager will develop, plan and execute sales initiatives for strategic accounts to initiate, sustain, and grow business over time. They will cultivate long‑term partnerships with national and international customers, aligned with the marketing and sales strategy and BASF Vegetable Seeds’ objectives to drive both profitability and lasting collaboration. The role connects strategic accounts with retail and internal crop, trials, product development, and marketing teams to translate varietal performance into credible customer recommendations and growth opportunities. Welcome to BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth #AgEmployerOfChoice Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions! As a Sr. Account Manager - High Tech Leafy, you create chemistry by... Planning, reviewing, adapting, and executing annual sales and Key Customer Plans for assigned strategic accounts. Establishing customer priorities, sales targets, key performance indicators, and crop marketing actions that contribute to the annual budget plan. Leading and coordinating customer trialing activities in order to demonstrate the value of commercial and pre-commercial assortment. Working with customers, Agrotechnologists, Product Development Specialists and crop teams to define objectives, establish trials, monitor progress, evaluate results, document varietal performance, and translate findings into customer recommendations, product advancement decisions, and commercial opportunities. Representing the company and introducing value-based proposals that address key customer needs, build long-term partnerships, and generate sustainable sales. Managing relevant connections between customers and leading retailers in the region. Leading cross-functional customer teams to provide solutions to customer needs and challenges, improve customer-facing processes, share information, overcome objections, and strengthen the customer experience with Nunhems. Providing market, price, product, grower, retailer, and consumer insights to support crop vision, strategy, positioning, and portfolio decisions. Collaborating across crop, sales, marketing, trials, and product development teams to implement crop strategy, promote new introductions, and ensure learning from customer trials is shared and applied. If you... Hold a bachelor’s degree in agriculture, horticulture, plant science, business, or a related field. Bring 5–8 years of sales or strategic account management experience in vegetable seed, produce, horticulture, or a related agricultural business. Apply well-rounded vegetable seed business knowledge and strong agronomic expertise, preferably in Controlled Environment Agriculture. Previous experience planing, coordinatinating, monitoring, evaluating, and communicating customer trials and varietal performance with customers and internal specialists, preferred. Leverage advanced consultative selling skills, including negotiation, value-based proposals, sales planning, and closing. Demonstrate an entrepreneurial mindset and influence decisions across diverse functions and stakeholder groups. Manage projects and competing customer, sales, and trial priorities effectively, with prior project management experience, preferred. Lead, coach, align, and mobilize cross-functional customer teams without direct authority. Develop turnkey solutions for customers and retailers by leveraging knowledge of leading U.S. retailers and the broader customer production ecosystem. Communicate effectively in written and spoken English, with bilingual English and Spanish skills preferred, and use Microsoft Office and CRM systems at a working level. Are able to travel 50-75%, domestically and internationally Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF. We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us BASF Agricultural Solutions is a trusted partner to the agricultural industry, delivering innovative and sustainable solutions that help farmers succeed across a wide range of cropping systems. Across North America, our teams work together to address some of agriculture's most important challenges while creating value for customers, communities, and the environment. At BASF, you'll find opportunities to grow your career, collaborate with talented colleagues, and make a meaningful impact through work that matters. Find out more about our Agricultural Solutions team here . Our people are at the heart of everything, dedicated to delivering value for our customers every day. By focusing on enabling our people today and in the future, we will ensure we have the talent and skills needed to succeed. United by the love of farming, we innovate, collaborate, and strive for the best solutions together, creating connections and driving success as one team. This is how we make an impact. For the love of farming, the biggest job on Earth. Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. The competitive Pay Range for this role is $88,160 - $121,220. Actual pay will be determined based on education, certifications, experience, and other job-related factors permitted by law. Equal employment opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

jobs.name: Executive Assistant to the CTO and the Value Creation & Delivery Office (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
WELCOME If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. Please do not be confused by this: All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application will be submitted to us. At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships. We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Surventis became an independent company on 30 June 2026. The Chief Transformation Officer (CTO) is a member of the Executive Committee and is responsible for enterprise transformation, value creation and execution across all businesses and functions. The Executive Assistant runs the Office of the CTO. You make sure the CTO’s time goes to the decisions that matter, that every management meeting is prepared to a board standard, and that agreed actions actually get done. You also take on selected project work. In your role, you help to ensure that the CTO is well prepared for daily priorities by coordinating schedules, organizing meetings and serving as a trusted point of contact for internal and external stakeholders. Together with the CTO and the Value Creation & Delivery leadership team, you maintain an overview of commitments, actions and follow-up activities to support transparent and effective collaboration. Working closely with leaders and business functions, you prepare leadership and management meetings to a high standard, coordinate decision papers and document outcomes and next steps clearly and concisely. You contribute to selected transformation and strategy initiatives by organizing information, preparing analyses and creating executive summaries that support informed decision-making. You also play an important role in bringing people together by coordinating workshops, leadership off-sites, site visits, internal communications and external advisor engagements. WHAT YOU OFFER university degree in business administration, economics, engineering or a comparable field, or an equivalent qualification at least five years of experience supporting a board member, CEO or executive leader, or experience in consulting, project management, strategy or transformation environments strong Microsoft 365 skills, especially PowerPoint and Excel, along with confidence using modern productivity and AI tools fluent German and English, both written and spoken, with the ability to communicate effectively across diverse stakeholder groups a collaborative, well-organized and dependable working style combined with empathy, strong communication skills, sound judgment and a commitment to high-quality outcomes WHAT WE OFFER We offer an attractive salary with individual benefits such as performance-related bonuses. Company-funded supplementary health insurance, accident insurance and an attractive pension plan offer comprehensive coverage. We offer a wide range of local and global development and career opportunities for professional and personal development. The feedback culture is firmly integrated into our corporate culture, e.g., through regular employee surveys and management feedback. At our location in Münster, we have our own fitness studio “Freizeit” with a physiotherapy practice, permanently employed company doctors, a company restaurant “Auszeit” including a café bar, a bilingual company daycare center “LackiKids” and a vacation program “LackiKids on Tour”. We have 30 vacation days/year (full-time), additional time off options and a 37.5-hour week. HOW TO REACH US Melissa Amina Rahmani (Talent Acquisition), melissa.rahmani@basf.com, Tel.: +49 30 2005 58073, will be happy to answer any questions you may have about this position. You are also welcome to book an online meeting . ABOUT US Learn more about our company here . Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief. jobs.name: Junior Controller Product Costing (m/f/d) - Hybrid Option GER
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF In Global Business Services, we support BASF's divisions with a cross-functional network and offer modern solutions tailored to the needs of the business. As a specialized service unit we ensure a high level of customer orientation and we design our services to be cooperative, efficient and future-oriented. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Are you interested in financial accounting, manufacturing processes and understanding how product costs are built up? Then join our Business Reporting Chemicals II team. In this role, you develop expertise in Product Costing, Inventory Valuation and SAP processes while working closely with finance, controlling and operational teams across multiple locations, including Europe’s largest integrated site in Ludwigshafen. You support month-end and year-end closing activities, including Product Costing, Inventory Valuation and financial reporting processes. You analyze, validate and monitor standard and actual product costs in SAP, including the execution of product costing runs. Besides that, you investigate cost deviations, perform root cause analyses and collaborate with manufacturing, accounting and controlling teams to ensure accurate product cost calculations. In this role, you review, maintain and validate costing-relevant master data to ensure high data quality and accurate inventory valuation. You provide operational support for Product Costing processes and contribute to process improvements, harmonization initiatives and automation projects. Finally, you participate in projects to implement SAP S/4HANA. You are welcome to book an online appointment. You can also reach our recruiting team here. First information about our application process can be found here and in our Q&A video. In the heart of Berlin, we combine expertise in the areas of finance, HR, supply chain, procurement, product safety and IT. We focus on digital and customer-focused solutions, to create services for future. Learn more about us and our career opportunities here . Diversity is our greatest strength! jobs.description:
WELCOME If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. Please do not be confused by this: All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application will be submitted to us. At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships. We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT The Global Controlling Specialist reports to the Global Head of RFN Controlling and is the key contact for Digitalization and Data Analytics topics in Controlling. Broad operational controlling and BI expertise combined with strong communication, presentation and interpersonal skills are prerequisites to act as a business partner for the Refinish Leadership Team and lead cross-functional data analytics projects across regions. You contribute to the further development of global controlling reporting solutions, ensure high data quality, and support users in making the best use of reporting tools and analytics. Working closely with colleagues from Finance, IT, and Data & Analytics, you coordinate reporting requirements, foster effective cross-functional collaboration, and serve as a strong sparring partner on all Controlling and Digital matters. Together with international teams, you support the digital evolution of Controlling, share knowledge, and contribute to the development of digital skills across the organization. You help introduce automation and AI-supported solutions that improve reporting, analytics, and controlling processes while creating a positive user experience. You also contribute to financial analyses, performance monitoring activities, and ad hoc business requests, enabling informed and transparent decision-making. WHAT YOU OFFER master’s degree in finance, accounting, controlling, business analytics, information systems, or a related field with relevant professional experience in controlling, finance, business analytics, or a comparable area strong knowledge of Power BI, Excel including Power Query and Power Pivot, and a solid understanding of reporting and controlling processes self-organized and collaborative working style combined with strong communication skills, curiosity, and a continuous learning mindset fluent German and English language skills; experience with Databricks, data warehouse environments, and modern analytics platforms is beneficial ideally experience with automation tools such as Power Automate as well as project coordination or project management experience WHAT WE OFFER We offer an attractive salary with individual benefits such as performance-related bonuses. Company-funded supplementary health insurance, accident insurance and an attractive pension plan offer comprehensive coverage. We offer a wide range of local and global development and career opportunities for professional and personal development. The feedback culture is firmly integrated into our corporate culture, e.g., through regular employee surveys and management feedback. At our location in Münster, we have our own fitness studio “Freizeit” with a physiotherapy practice, permanently employed company doctors, a company restaurant “Auszeit” including a café bar, a bilingual company daycare center “LackiKids” and a vacation program “LackiKids on Tour”. We have 30 vacation days/year (full-time), additional time off options and a 37.5-hour week. jobs.description:
Now hiring! Technical Sales Representative This position offers a company car, laptop, phone, and all travel expenses covered by the company; travel can be anywhere from 50-60%. We are looking for a Technical Sales Representative to join our Surventis Surface Treatment team in Western Pennsylvania. New finish, Proven expertise. Bolder ambition. If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact, and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. Please do not be confused by this: All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application will be submitted to us. At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships.  We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place. As a Technical Sales Representative you will... Understand the business activities of accounts in the territory and apply knowledge of the customer’s internal operation to tailor sales presentations and sales proposals to the account’s specific needs. Manage territory profitability by reviewing territory compensation margins, providing margin improvement by product selection and optimum pricing. Assure that technology provided within the territory strengthens the company’s competitive position within the accounts. Plan a weekly itinerary of calls to allocate time effectively and to ensure proper territory coverage by industry, geography and account potential. Call on established and prospective customers, determine their needs, and sell appropriate products to markets, targeted by the business units of the company. Make proper number of calls per day based on territory requirements. Must be able to physically service and call on existing and prospective customers. Select the process and the right material to solve customer cleaning, sanitation or surface treatment problems. Make sales presentations, both orally and written. Answer customers’ questions concerning product use. Negotiate pricing: Provide pricing quotes, price and delivery policy within established limits, subject to approval. Attain sales plan by securing new customers, increasing sales to current customers and maintaining up to date opportunity pipeline in CRM (Salesforces). Work closely with customers focusing on building strong business relationships. Maintain contact with customers in relation to their service requirements. Provide information on new products, methods, techniques and other general information such as safety and disposal. Train customers and ensure proper and safe use of Surventis materials. Report competitive activities that impact sales in the territory, to the supervisor (District Manager). Prepare and submit call reports, exception reports, and in-plant service reports via CRM (Salesforce). Use the CRM (Salesforce) for management of the accounts. Share reports with appropriate colleagues to ensure collaboration with different functions to keep all necessary information on all accounts. Improve technical knowledge of Surventis materials through self-study and participation in professional Association. Participate in team selling activities in cooperation with other TSR’s, technical support personnel and application engineers. Request samples according to company policy. Exercise proper caution in handling company materials and equipment. Operates automobile (company car) safely and maintain it in proper operating condition. Complete all necessary reports in due time (expenses, mileage report, etc.). If you have... BS Degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Engineering, or Business is required. Minimum of 2 years of relatable experience is required. B2B/outside industrial sales experience, in specialty chemical sales (surface treatment-paint pretreatments, wastewater treatments, metalworking fluids, etc.) preferred. Ability to make sales presentations and follow up with written proposals and manage customer contracts. Well organized with sales planning. Managing customer accounts within the assigned territory. Strong selling skills for customer acquisition and continuous up-/cross-selling opportunities (customer support/account management) Build and strengthen customer relationships. Technical consulting capabilities regarding products and processes; will learn and understand Chemetall product portfolio. Strong business acumen. Strong Negotiation skills Problem solving skills Time management Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. Travel up to 50-60%, with occasional overnight travel. Valid driver's license in good standing. Privacy statement Surventis takes security & data privacy very seriously. jobs.name: Processing Operator III
jobs.description: Now hiring! Processing Operator III Parma, ID Annual bonus / Overtime pay eligible We are looking for a Processing Operator III to join our Agricultural Solutions team for our BASF | Nunhems vegetable seeds business in Parma, ID. Come create chemistry with us! BASF's Agricultural Solutions division connects innovation, customers, partners and agricultural experts and integrates sustainability criteria into all business decisions. We help farmers deliver the best possible outcomes, working to achieve the balance between economic, environmental, and social value creation for sustainable and efficient agriculture. As a Processing Operator III in our Parma, ID site, you will be responsible of the processing of seed through one of the processing sub-departments, while following standard operating procedures and company guidelines: warehousing/receiving, conditioning, enhancement, treatment and packaging/shipping. This requires following instructions and accurately measuring seed materials necessary to fulfill the processing manufacturing orders. During your shift as a Processing Operator III, you will Understand and follow all standard operating procedures and accredited procedures (NAL) in accordance with Processing Management in order to ensure Processing standards and global standardization are maintained. You will also participate in continuous improvement activities on the work floor. Understand and follow all safety policies and procedure in accordance with corporate, local, state and federal mandates to ensure regulatory compliance, as well as understand and perform good housekeeping practices for all assigned areas of responsibility to achieve a safe work environment. Pass lift truck/reach truck training and safely use these as directed to move seed or other materials. Execute a part of the processes within PRC sub-department. Train new employees in departmental processes. If you... Hold a High School Diploma or equivalent. Have 2+ years of manufacturing and/or agricultural operations or other related experience. Are able to gain certification (internal training) to operate a forklift and/or reach truck safely and competently. Have intermediate computer/MS Office skills, for basic usage and understanding of Excel formulas SAP experience, preferred. Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF . We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us As one of the largest chemical companies in North America we have been finding solutions for your everyday needs and addressing the most complex economic, environmental, and sustainability challenges for more than 150 years! At BASF we empower our employees with the tools, guidance and opportunities they need to advance and succeed in work and life. Giving you the support you need to be your best and fulfill your personal ambitions is what helps us create chemistry. After all, our success is linked to yours. Whatever path you envision, BASF is a great place to build a rewarding, successful career. Belong to Something Bigger. #belongatBASF Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. jobs.name: Ag Professional Development Program - Marketing & Sales
jobs.description: Now hiring! Ag Professional Development Program - Marketing & Sales Location: Calgary, AB (first rotation) BASF's Professional Development Programs (PDPs) were created to provide highly motivated, mobile-minded current university students an opportunity to enhance their professional skills through a variety of diverse learning experiences. Participants will contribute to real-world rotational assignments within different domestic locations. They will explore career options and develop technical and professional decision-making skills, while fulfilling specific business needs. Participants also have the opportunity to assess their capabilities, skills, and interests and gain valuable exposure to BASF's culture, values, and decision-makers. Explore your sense of adventure! Build your professional network! Engage your passion for challenge! Apply for the BASF Ag Sales & Marketing Professional Development Program! The PDP role is 24 months in length with a term spent working in Marketing and Customer Solutions Team (CST) prior to a transition into a Field Sales role. The Marketing / CST role will be located in Calgary, Alberta. Field Sales will be located somewhere in Canada after 12 months within Marketing / CST.  Upon successful completion of the program, participants will be eligible to remain in Field Sales or pursue other opportunities within BASF. PDPs are expected to be fully mobile within Canada for this role. Welcome to BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth #AgEmployerOfChoice Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions! As a Ag Professional Development Program - Marketing & Sales, you create chemistry by... Enhancing career development and value delivery to BASF through planned assignments. Building professional and technical skills to target growers, retailers, distributors, and key influencers, while learning to develop business strategies and tactics that help growers get the most on every acre. Leveraging the tools to communicate the value of BASF's innovative crop protection products and services. If you are or possess... An upcoming graduate with a Bachelor of Science (or Bachelor of Commerce) with emphasis in Business, Economics, Marketing, Agronomy, Biology, Plant Science or a related field. Self-motivated and results oriented. Customer focused. Mobility & commitment to relocation. Strong influencing & impact skills. Team oriented with a passion for agriculture. Valid Driver’s License. Strong communication skills. Create your own chemistry with you@BASF Adding value to our customers begins with adding value to you. you@BASF is the suite of benefits, perks, programs and unique opportunities we offer to support you – the whole you – in all stages of your life and career. With you@BASF, you create your own chemistry. The total rewards that you receive as a BASF employee go way beyond a paycheck. From competitive health and insurance plans to robust retirement benefits that include company-matching contributions, to making sure you never stop learning, we believe investing in you is investing in our success. Working for a large, global organization, you’ll have a chance to grow professionally and personally, expand your network and build a rewarding and dynamic career.  We also provide engaging learning and development opportunities to help you make the most of your talents and your role. About us BASF Agricultural Solutions is a trusted partner to the agricultural industry, delivering innovative and sustainable solutions that help farmers succeed across a wide range of cropping systems. jobs.name: Master Thesis in Sun Protection (m/f/d) 1
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF At Care Chemicals, we carry the passion to care. Our people stand as our most prized asset, and we cultivate a culture of compassion, support, and growth. Through this, we empower our team to excel both personally and professionally. United as one, we are dedicated to pioneering sustainable, digitized, and innovative solutions for a brighter future. Nourishing lotions, mild shampoos, protective sunscreens – these products, along with environmentally friendly detergents and high-performance cleaners, feature ingredients crafted by our Care Chemicals division. Our portfolio extends to plant protection solutions, technical applications in construction chemistry, raw materials for the coatings industry and digital services for our customers. Collaborating with global clients, we engineer innovative solutions with a growing emphasis on sustainable sourcing. Let’s sketch a better future together! WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT The Sun Protection unit at the Grenzach site is the global competence center for cosmetic sun protection within BASF. We focus on the development of innovative ingredients, particularly new UV filters, and their application in sun protection formulations. We welcome your support as part of an internship lasting six to eight months, which can also be completed in the context of a master’s thesis, starting February 2026. During your internship, you work on application research questions related to sun protection products. You prepare cosmetic formulations and conduct UV transmission measurements to determine the absorption of UV filters or the sun protection factor of the formulations. Additionally, you perform stability tests on the formulations, such as viscosity and pH measurements. Finally, you investigate the crystallization of UV filters in formulations using microscopy, summarize your results, interpret them, and present your findings. WHAT YOU OFFER enrolled student in cosmetic sciences or a comparable degree program basic knowledge of cosmetic formulations good communication skills in German strong team player committed, independent, structured, and proactive working style WHAT WE OFFER You are part of the BASF team from day one. We pay an attractive internship allowance of €800 (monthly gross salary for voluntary internships and mandatory internships; thesis projects are remunerated with €1,000). You have the opportunity to live in a BASF-subsidized shared apartment for interns near the plant. If you need to relocate and use the shared apartment, we  support you with a rent subsidy of €300 (monthly, gross). With us, you enter challenging fields of work and take on exciting tasks and, if possible, sub-projects in an interdisciplinary work environment. In addition, BASF sites offer various opportunities such as tours or workshops to get to know BASF better. This gives you a wide range of insights and experience at the world's largest chemical company. Information on internships can be found here HOW TO REACH US Corinna Granterath (Talent Acquisition), corinna.granterath@basf.com, Tel.:+49 30 2005-59302 will be happy to answer your questions for this position. You are also welcome to book an appointment online (technical questions cannot be answered in this appointment) You can also reach our recruiting team here First information about our application process can be found here ABOUT US At its site in Grenzach, BASF's competence center for UV filters, BASF Grenzach GmbH performs global development, technical service and production of innovative UV filters. Our products are used in sun screens, cosmetics and personal care products. The site is also home to the global development and technical service of antimicrobial active ingredients. The company's unique location in the border triangle of Germany, France and Switzerland, with the Black Forest and the Alps nearby, offers attractive and varied leisure activities in addition to interesting professional opportunities. You can find out more about BASF Grenzach GmbH at: www.basf-grenzach.de Diversity is our greatest strength! jobs.name: Postdoc NMR Data Science (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF We are a globally leading research and development organization with more than 3000 employees working in the fields of materials science, analytics, chemical synthesis, process development, life sciences, catalysis, and digitalization. Through our creative and diverse teams and our cutting-edge research, we help our partners succeed and drive the sustainability transformation of the chemical industry. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Our Spectroscopy & Polymer Analytics team provides our partners with structural elucidation, identification, quantification, and polymer characterization using spectroscopic and chromatographic methods across BASF’s entire value chain. You support interdisciplinary projects and develop innovative digital solutions for spectroscopic challenges, particularly in the field of NMR data analysis. In addition, you develop and implement new machine learning models for complex spectroscopic data. In close collaboration with our partners, you continuously expand and improve our digital portfolio while ensuring fast and cost-effective analytical services. Last but not least, you prepare research proposals and scientific publications. WHAT YOU OFFER PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, Chemistry, Analytics, or a related field several years of experience in developing data pipelines, data architectures, and AI models advanced knowledge of IR or NMR method development as well as pulse sequence programming is an advantage fluent in German and English, both written and spoken strong project management skills, a high level of data awareness, and the ability to apply digital technologies and methods to solve complex scientific challenges experience in applying scientific AI is considered a plus strong team spirit and passion for innovative, data-driven solutions WHAT WE OFFER From day one, you will be part of the BASF family. You will be involved in challenging areas of responsibility and have the opportunity to contribute to exciting projects in an interdisciplinary environment. jobs.name: Material Handler
jobs.description: Now hiring! Material Handler Wyandotte, MI (On Site) We are looking for a Material Handler to join our Performance Materials team in Wyandotte. Come create chemistry with us! The Performance Materials division is at the forefront of the much-needed sustainability transformation in plastics. Our experts co-create products with customers to bring innovations to major industry sectors such as transportation, consumer goods, industrial applications, and construction.These solutions contribute to a sustainable future by pushing the boundaries in thermal resistance, robustness and lightweight applications. During your 8-hour shift as a Material Handler, you will… Perform the loading process for bulk trucks, loading from silos and supersacks Verification of receiving and loading documents Cross train to learn and perform other logistics responsibilities Learn and perform receiving and rail car off loading duties General warehouse duties Learn and use various software applications Counting and reporting of physical inventory Understanding and practice of safety methods Overtime on rotating weekends and holidays Communicate with logistic planners and production personnel Fill in areas of the logistics department as needed. If you… Have a High School Diploma or GED. Hold a Forklift Operator certification, or willing to obtain one. Are willing and able to work an 8-hour shift with occasional need to stay longer. Can work overtime on rotating weekends and holidays. Have knowledge and Hazcom training along with experience in Shipping and Receiving (preferred). Able to occasionally lift up to 50lbs. Then… Click below to Belong@BASF! Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF. jobs.name: Supply Chain Coordinator
jobs.description:
Now hiring! Supply Chain Coordinator Greenville, OH We are looking for a Supply Chain Coordinator to join our team in Greenville, OH. New finish, Proven expertise. Bolder ambition. If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact, and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. Please do not be confused by this: All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application will be submitted to us. At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships.  We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place. The Logistics Coordinator is responsible for converting finished and intermediate goods orders (both internal and external) into shipping schedules for the Greenville Site, ensuring customer needs are met. This role involves optimizing production and distribution costs, managing inventory investments within service constraints, and ensuring materials and capacities are available to support schedules. The position serves as a key interface for logistics between the production scheduling group/operations, package/marine command, and internal/external customers. As a Supply Chain Coordinator, you will....... Develop and manage shipping schedules to meet customer requirements across North America. Optimize production and distribution costs while managing inventory investments. Ensure availability of materials and capacities to support schedules. Serve as a key logistics interface between production scheduling, operations, package/marine command, and customers. Administer and coordinate communication for material movements. Internship Details: Duration: 4 months (Summer 2027) Location: Peace Region, AB and Sherwood Park, AB Compensation: $25 - $32 / Hour Welcome to BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth #AgEmployerOfChoice Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions! Why Join Us? This isn’t your average internship. At BASF, you’ll: Make an Impact : Contribute to meaningful projects that support farmers, strengthen relationships in our communities and drive sustainability. Build Your Network : Develop lasting relationships with mentors, managers, and peers who will guide and support your career journey. Learn by Doing : Gain practical, hands-on experience in sales, agronomy, and customer engagement that translates into real-world skills. Grow Your Career : Explore career paths and gain visibility into potential full-time opportunities, including our Professional Development Program (PDP). Have Fun : Participate in field tours, networking events, and team activities that make your summer both rewarding as it is memorable. What You’ll Learn: How to manage a customer portfolio and drive innovation in the field. The ins and outs of BASF’s product line and how it supports sustainable agriculture. Communication, leadership, and decision-making skills that will serve you in any career path. What You’ll Do: Build relationships with growers and promote BASF solutions. Support field tours, events, and product demonstrations. Lead a field-scale project and scout fields to gain technical insights. Collaborate with BASF teams to grow the business and your skills. Travel within your assigned territory. What We’re Looking For: You’re currently enrolled in an agriculture or related degree program. You’re passionate about ag, sustainability, and making a difference. You’re a strong communicator, organized, and ready to learn. You have a valid driver’s license and are open to travel. To be eligible for this internship, you must be currently enrolled in a post-secondary program and returning to studies following the internship. Applications from individuals who have already graduated will not be considered. Ready to grow with us?

A track record of working independently to demonstrate your leadership potential and flexibility that showcases a willingness to work shifts and weekends when necessary. BASF in Thailand was established in 1966 and maintains its head office in Bangkok. It operates three production sites in Samutprakarn, Chonburi and Rayong, an Automotive Coatings Technical Competence Center, and a Performance Materials Technical Development Center in Samutprakarn. jobs.name: Assistant Manager, Quality & Technical Service Lab
jobs.description: Objectives In alignment with BASF Quality Policy, oversee day‑to‑day quality management of the site to ensure raw materials meet production specifications and finished products satisfy customer expectations. Be responsible for ISO‑related audit activities, and maintain and continuously improve the company’s quality management system. Main Tasks Production Safety Responsibilities ‑ Serve as the Production Safety lead for the Quality & Technical Service Lab Department. Comply with the principle of “whoever is in charge of business shall be accountable for safety; whoever manages production and operations shall be accountable for safety”, and fulfil dual responsibilities for safety performance within the scope of assigned duties. ‑ Be in charge of department‑level safety training, retain relevant records, develop and control safety training plans, assess employees’ safety‑related performance and arrange additional training where required. ‑ Ensure tools, instruments and equipment within the department are correctly deployed for daily operations. ‑ Identify potential workplace hazards and unsafe employee behaviours, and take appropriate corrective actions to eliminate such risks. ‑ Identify all work activities within the department requiring job hazard analysis, organise risk analysis exercises and implement risk‑mitigation measures. ‑ Investigate all incidents and accidents occurring within the department to identify root causes, implement corrective actions, propose disciplinary recommendations for accountable parties and deliver follow‑up employee training. ‑ Secure a safe working environment for employees and contractors, including provision of appropriate personal protective equipment, tools and materials. ‑ Ensure the Quality Control Supervisor implements corresponding obligations in accordance with all safety procedures. ‑ Cascading corporate safety requirements to every employee and contractor within the department. ‑ Ensure all safety rules, procedures and safe working practices are fully understood and followed by all department employees and contractors. Quality Management ‑ Schedule and oversee daily laboratory operations aligned with production and shipment plans. ‑ Ensure raw material and finished‑product conformance against specifications and requirements. ‑ Monitor raw material and finished‑product status in the SAP system; issue Certificates of Analysis (CoA) for delivered finished goods and obtain Quality Deviation Reports (QDR) for non‑conforming batches. ‑ Establish test methodologies for new raw materials and new products during new‑product launch phases. ‑ Guarantee effective implementation of the quality management system and maintain the system in compliance with ISO standards. ‑ Compile and analyse quality‑related data, and prepare relevant reports as requested by line management. Metrology Management ‑ Take charge of calibration for trade‑related measuring instruments onsite, including management of calibration procedures, calibration schedules and calibration‑related budget. Document Control ‑ Maintain and update laboratory operating manuals. ‑ Compile and revise quality‑control manuals. ‑ Ensure proper retention of all quality‑control‑related records. External Audits ‑ Plan, organise and execute internal and external audits for ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 to secure successful audit outcomes. ‑ Ensure timely completion of all corrective actions. Customer Complaint Handling ‑ Lead customer‑complaint investigations. ‑ Conduct root‑cause analysis, define corrective actions, and monitor timely closure of such actions. ‑ Host customer visits, build sound working relationships with customer quality teams and capture customer requirements. Product Stewardship ‑ Act as the site Product Stewardship focal point; collaborate with Greater China and Asia Pacific Product Safety & Stewardship (PSS) teams to prepare Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS) for products and raw materials used onsite, and deliver relevant training for internal stakeholders. 5S Management ‑ Implement and sustain well‑organised laboratory working environments in compliance with corporate 5S policies. People Management ‑ Set performance objectives for direct reports and conduct performance evaluations. ‑ Formulate individual development plans for direct reports based on incumbent competencies and business requirements. ‑ Address inappropriate behaviours of direct reports, and coordinate with Human Resources to administer disciplinary procedures per corporate policies. ‑ Foster an inclusive, transparent and high‑performance working culture to support talent development and retention. ‑ Manage attendance, overtime, training and leave arrangements for direct reports in line with business needs, corporate policies and applicable laws and regulations. Budget Management ‑ Develop, monitor and optimise annual quality‑function budgets in compliance with quality policies and compliance obligations. ‑ Strictly adhere to corporate finance and cost‑accounting rules. Deploy effective measures to cut maintenance costs, reduce material losses and eliminate waste. Other Assignments ‑ Perform other duties as assigned by the line manager. Requirements - Education: Bachelor’s degree or above, major in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Applied Chemistry, Polymer Chemistry. - Working Experience: Minimum 5 years of working experience in quality management and laboratory management within the chemical industry. ‑ Sound knowledge of polymerisation and polymer science. ‑ Bilingual proficiency in Chinese and English for day‑to‑day business delivery. ‑ Competency in office software and enterprise applications including SAP.

Als Teil des Corporate Centers unterstützen wir unseren Vorstand in allen Portfolio- und Ressourcenallokationsentscheidungen. Wir entwickeln Strategien, identifizieren Chancen und Risiken und analysieren Trends in Nachhaltigkeit und Technologie. Gemeinsam mit den Unternehmensbereichen erarbeiten wir Strategien für die Geschäftsbereiche und begleiten deren Umsetzung. WAS SIE ERWARTET Projekt Mercury – NGBA Core Businesses ist eines der größten Transformationsprojekte der BASF mit dem Ziel die zentralen Geschäftsprozesse neu zu definieren und ein neues Enterprise Resource Planning System (ERP) einzuführen. Unser Team für Change Management & Kommunikation sorgt dafür, dass alle relevanten Stakeholder informiert, motiviert und aktiv eingebunden sind. Hierfür suchen wir ab November 2026 Unterstützung im Rahmen eines 3- bis 6-monatigen Praktikums , bei dem Sie die Möglichkeit haben den Veränderungsprozess durch gezielte Maßnahmen zu unterstützen. Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehört die Erstellung und Überarbeitung von Kommunikationsmaterialien wie internen Mitteilungen, Newslettern und Präsentationen. Sie erstellen und pflegen Inhalte für interne Kommunikationskanäle, indem Sie Artikel verfassen, Grafiken gestalten und Intranetseiten aktuell halten. Die Planung, Organisation und Durchführung von Meetings, Workshops sowie weiteren internen Veranstaltungen erfolgt mit Ihrer Unterstützung. Durch die Durchführung von Recherchen, Umfragen und Feedbackanalysen tragen Sie zur Bewertung und Weiterentwicklung der Kommunikationsmaßnahmen bei. jobs.name: Senior Compliance Manager Data Protection (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture. #ForTheLoveOfFarming#TheBiggestJobOnEarth#AgEmployerOfChoice Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions! WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Our department AP/LC designs, implements, maintains and improves the governance of Compliance @AP. We are a global team, steered centrally from Limburgerhof and focusing on AP Group’s Compliance Management System and part of the corporate governance framework. We focus our resources, time and energy on compliance topics that are key for AP Group and use a planned approach to manage and improve the governance of these topics. We maintain a global Compliance community that supports the department in establishing a culture of compliance and integrity. Together with the teams involved, you design and maintain the data protection governance model for Agricultural Solutions, ensuring clear responsibilities, decision-making processes, minimum standards, documentation requirements and a reliable governance calendar. You develop appropriate methodologies for data protection risk assessments, control testing, monitoring and thematic reviews, as well as assess the effectiveness and maturity of existing measures. Through an independent oversight and advisory role, you consolidate data protection risks, controls, incidents and improvement measures, as well as prepare clear reports on material risks, developments and outstanding actions. In close cooperation with internal audit, risk, control and information security functions, as well as the (Group) DPO, you coordinate joint activities and support follow-up through to completion. You contribute your perspective to significant digital, AI, data-sharing, M&A, and transformation initiatives and constructively support the management of data protection risks, control concepts, decision-making processes and residual risks. In addition, you define quality requirements and framework conditions for data protection impact assessments, records of processing activities, data inventories, data subject rights, data protection incidents, international data transfers, third-party risks and data protection training, while supporting complex or particularly high-risk matters. Together with us, you enhance a company culture that values openness toward AI, encourages continuous learning and promotes responsible and human‑centered use of technology. WHAT YOU OFFER a master's degree in law or compliance / business with an additional legal qualification in-depth knowledge of the GDPR and, ideally, other data protection regulations in international organizations practical experience with data protection governance, risk assessments, controls, monitoring, audits and measures management experience with data protection impact assessments, data subject rights, data breaches, international data transfers and third-party risks excellent German and English language skills, proficiency with digital applications and benefitial a relevant data protection certification digital mindset and the willingness to see AI as an opportunity to improve processes and ways of working WHAT WE OFFER A dynamic work environment that empowers you to contribute your ideas, take ownership, and assume responsibility. A strong focus on continuous learning, modern technologies, and the responsible use of artificial intelligence, enabling us to work in a future‑oriented, efficient, and sustainable way while actively driving innovation. Inspiring networks for the development and implementation of your ideas (e.g. Women in Business). Learning opportunities for your professional and personal development. Career paths as professional development into other roles within the company. We actively support with childcare (e.g. company daycare, holiday programmes) and provide a fitness and health studio as well as a medical center with numerous offers for your health. We offer sustainable mobility benefits - a discounted Deutschlandticket for regional public transport, a job‑bike leasing program, and on‑site e‑charging stations for private electric vehicles to make your commute affordable, healthy, and climate‑friendly. jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF In Global Business Services, we support BASF's divisions with a cross-functional network and offer modern solutions tailored to the needs of the business. As a specialized service unit we ensure a high level of customer orientation and we design our services to be cooperative, efficient and future-oriented. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Join us with your own ideas and help us shape our processes as well as further development of our services! As (Junior) Procurement Specialist with Dutch and English, you are responsible for all operational purchasing activities. In detail, you ensure that our BASF companies in Europe are supplied with raw materials, technical goods and services. You play an active role: you implement and adhere to the company's procurement guidelines by conducting numerous Purchase-to-Pay process tasks. In collaboration and consultation with our internal business partners, you handle orders accordingly to the guidelines. Assuring timely deliveries and handling non-conformities are part of your daily tasks. In doing so, you are responsible for entering master data of contracts into our IT systems and keeping this data updated. WHAT YOU OFFER bachelor's degree in commerce or a similar field, completed vocational education would be also possible initial professional experience in an area of business and commerce; preferably purchasing is a plus, but not compulsory excellent communication skills in Dutch and English, French and/or German are a plus good knowledge of IT standard applications, experience in working with SAP or other procurement related IT programs are a plus ability to identify customer needs and enjoy consulting WHAT WE OFFER Gross annual salary (full-time): 35.000 -39.000 € , depending on qualification and work experience -  In addition, you can expect a bonus dependent on the companys success 30 days of paid vacation, special leave and sabbatical options Flexible working hours so that you can organize your working and private life according to your needs Location-independent working models with defined days of presence in Berlin and residence in Germany - here a first impression Work mobile from other EU countries for up to six weeks Modern sustainable office building in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg with flexible working options, rooftop terrace and cafeteria for innovative and team-focused collaboration - get to know our location Subsidy for public transport, personal employee benefit card and other discounts HOW TO REACH US Maximilian Mette (Talent Acquisition), maximilian.mette@basf.com, Tel.: +49 30 2005-56084 will be happy to answer your questions for this position. You can also reach our recruiting team here First information about our application process can be found here and in our Q&A video ABOUT US As an international service hub, the BASF Services Europe GmbH bundles a wide range of services for the BASF Group throughout Europe. In the heart of Berlin, we combine expertise in the areas of finance, HR, supply chain, procurement, product safety and IT. We focus on digital and customer-focused solutions, to create services for future. Learn more about us and our career opportunities at basf.com/servicehub-berlin . Diversity is our greatest strength! jobs.name: Transport Management (Assistant Manager)
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities . Responsible for reporting and analytics related to Operational data quality for management/Stakeholder review. Job Requirements Min. Degree in supply chain, business administration, international business. Other tertiary education can be considered with the availability of professional experience. At least 4 years Professional experience in logistics or supply chain management, preferably in logistics, transportation and international trade deliveries Has experience in leadership or supervising operational team & International liaisons Process implementation and tools/application familiarity incl. change management and digital applications for supply chain Strong customer and service orientation, proactive and able to provide solutions; with critical thinking skills High proficiency in verbal and written English with strong communication and presentation skills Team Management, Mentorship experiences or tendencies Experience with ERP in supply chain preferred. SAP or other ERP Innovation orientation and openness for automation and digitalization The BASF Service Hub Kuala Lumpur (BASF Asia-Pacific Service Centre Sdn Bhd) is strategically located in the capital city of Malaysia. Since its inception in 2005, the hub has expanded from 130 employees to over 1,300 employees currently and is expected to keep growing. As an ISO 9001:2005 certified organization, the Service Hub Kuala Lumpur is committed to delivering high quality expertise and services in finance, people, supply chain, EHSQ (environment, health, safety, quality), product safety and digital. We take pride in providing our business services to BASF companies and affiliates across 20 markets in the Asia Pacific region and beyond. Moreover, we offer our services in 8 different languages to cater to the diverse needs of our stakeholders. Our focus on competency and technology-driven solutions allows us to consistently deliver exceptional services, thereby contributing to the success of our businesses. BASF also has two other regional hubs located in Berlin, Germany, and Montevideo, Uruguay, which cover the European and American regions. BASF Service Hub Kuala Lumpur was recognized with nine prestigious awards in 2024, reflecting its commitment to creating a vibrant, inclusive, and empowering workplace. These awards include winning the title of Operational Excellence in HR at the GBS Asia Awards 2024, multiple accolades at the Life at Work Awards 2024, where the hub was recognized as First Runner-up for Workplace Excellence (International Organization) and CEO Champion (International Organization), as well as Second Runner-up for Best International Organization. The hub also won the title for Excellence in Learning Tech Advancement System and a Certificate of Excellence in Talent Management and Leadership at the HRD Awards 2024. Furthermore, the hub secured a Bronze Award for Excellence in Digital Transformation at the HR Excellence Awards 2024 and received a Bronze Award for Human Resources Impact and an Honorary Award for Creative Talent Management Impact at the SSON Impact Awards Asia 2024. At BASF, we create chemistry for a sustainable future. Our ambition: We want to be the preferred chemical company to enable our customers’ green transformation. We combine economic success with environmental protection and social responsibility. Around 112,000 employees in the BASF Group contribute to the success of our customers in nearly all sectors and almost every country in the world. Our portfolio comprises, as core businesses, the segments Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, and Nutrition & Care; our standalone businesses are bundled in the segments Surface Technologies and Agricultural Solutions. BASF generated sales of €65.3 billion in 2024. BASF shares are traded on the stock exchange in Frankfurt (BAS) and as American Depositary Receipts (BASFY) in the United States. Further information at www.basf.com .

jobs.name: Analista Semi Senior Financial Reporting (fixed-term project-based)
jobs.description: Este puesto se ofrece bajo un contrato a plazo fijo, basado en proyecto, con una duración mínima garantizada de seis meses. Quiénes somos: Somos BASF, la compañía química más grande del mundo, con más de 150 años de experiencia. En Montevideo, operamos como un HUB que brinda servicios a todas las empresas de BASF en las Américas. Ofrecemos soluciones profesionales en finanzas, adquisiciones, reportes, logística, tecnología, recursos humanos, proyectos, comunicaciones, asuntos legales, medioambiente, seguridad, salud y calidad. Área: En el HUB de Montevideo contamos con el área de Financial Reporting, la cual es responsable de asegurar que los estados financieros se completen de forma adecuada, cumpliendo con las normativas locales e internacionales. Se preparan reportes mensuales, trimestrales y anuales donde se trabaja con Finanzas Local, Controlling y la caza matriz. A fin de mes se toma toda la información desde los módulos de SAP System, para luego reportar nuestras versiones Financieras y Operativas en nuestro sistema oficial. Objetivo principal de la posición: Desempeñar tareas diarias y análisis periódicos relativos Financial Reporting, asegurando la integridad y exactitud de la información contable en SAP y otras bases de datos. Principales tareas: Asegurar la correcta ejecución de los procedimientos y controles de cierre de mes (cubriendo todos los procesos predefinidos como FRC controls), garantizando la calidad del reporte a casa matriz. Contribuir en la preparación de notas a los Estados Financieros, trimestrales y anuales. Realización de los Account Análisis mensuales de acuerdo con el mapping de cuentas predefinido. Preparación de las analíticas de acuerdo con el cronograma definido. Presentación de las mismas corresponda. Contribuir en diversos proyectos e iniciativas a lo largo del año relativos a documentación de procesos, FRC, testeos, auditoría, entre otros. Apoyo y coordinación con Local Finance en lo referente a las actividades bajo su scope (Account análisis, Analíticas, M&A). Proporcionar guía y soporte a los negocios en la aplicación de IFRS16. Ser responsable de la creación y mantenimiento en el sistema (RFEX) para los contratos que cumplan los criterios de capitalización en base a la normativa aplicable (IFRS16), asegurando la calidad de la información contable. Monitoreo integral de la Clearing Account, identificando desvíos y canalizando su resolución, velando por el correcto funcionamiento del proceso. Brindar soporte a los negocios en la estimación y proyección de costos asociados a los contratos de arrendamiento. Velar por la correcta gestión de los costos facturados. Colaborar con tareas relativas a Activos Fijos así como al proceso de Account Analysis. Estar en constante y proactiva comunicación con diversos clientes y stakeholders, trabajando de cerca con las diferentes áreas de la organización. Entender el proceso E2E y el impacto dentro del flujo de trabajo, evaluar y proponer mejoras en el proceso. Requisitos mínimos de educación y calificaciones para la posición: Educación: Estudiantes avanzados o graduados en Contador Público o Administración de Empresas. Experiencia laboral: Entre 3 y 5 años de experiencia contable en áreas de reporting. Idiomas: Manejo de inglés intermedio a nivel oral y escrito. Se valorará altamente el dominio del portugués. Habilidades técnicas: Conocimiento sólido de Microsoft Office, especialmente de Excel, se valorará la experiencia con macros. Buen dominio de las normas contables. Habilidades blandas: Excelentes habilidades de comunicación para mantener un contacto constante con clientes, stakeholders y otras áreas del HUB. Qué ofrecemos: Vivir BASF es ser parte de una cultura donde el foco está en las personas y en su desarrollo profesional y personal. Nuestra diversidad, colaboración y estilo de liderazgo marcan la diferencia. Al sumarte a nuestro equipo, te ofrecemos: Un modelo de trabajo híbrido y flexible Acceso a un ecosistema de aprendizaje con recursos y herramientas disponibles on‑demand Seguro médico privado para vos y tu familia desde el primer día, además de seguro de vida Días adicionales de licencia flexible, además de tu licencia legal Día libre por cumpleaños Día libre por mudanza Bono anual (sujeto al cumplimiento de los requisitos establecidos por las políticas internas) Beneficios de bienestar, como servicios de nutrición dentro de la compañía y masajes BASF considera la Ley N° 19.691 y el Decreto N° 73/019 en todos sus procesos de contratación. Cada candidato calificado que cumpla con los requisitos establecidos en la descripción del puesto será considerado en este proceso de contratación sin distinción. Además, BASF es un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades. Aceptamos con entusiasmo nuestra responsabilidad de tomar decisiones de empleo sin tener en cuenta la raza, la edad, el estado civil y social, el origen nacional, la discapacidad, el sexo, la identidad de género o las expresiones, o cualquier otra característica o grupo de candidatos o empleados que no esté relacionado con su aptitud e idoneidad para el puesto. Nuestra dirección está comprometida a seguir esta política en lo que respecta a la contratación, colocación, promoción, transferencia, descenso, despido, terminación, reclutamiento, remuneración y otras formas de compensación, capacitación y trato general durante el empleo.

jobs.name: Production Operator- Pesol
jobs.description: Now hiring! Production Operator- Pesol Malcom, IA (On Site) We are looking for a Production Operator- Pesol to join our Performance Materials team in Malcom, IA. Come create chemistry with us! The Performance Materials division is at the forefront of the much-needed sustainability transformation in plastics. Our experts co-create products with customers to bring innovations to major industry sectors such as transportation, consumer goods, industrial applications, and construction.These solutions contribute to a sustainable future by pushing the boundaries in thermal resistance, robustness and lightweight applications. As a Production Operator for our Performance Materials business unit, you will gain meaningful experience working an operations team in the production of Polyester Polyols at our Malcom, Iowa site. We are seeking a safety-focused professional like you to operate reactors, blend tanks, filling systems, and loading and unloading equipment at our Malcom facility. In this role, you will manufacture quality finished goods, manage raw materials, monitor and adjust production equipment, and support safe, efficient plant operations while working as part of a collaborative production team. "This position is part of a job family with multiple levels and will be filled at a level that is commensurate with the candidate's qualifications and experience. " During your 12- hour shift (day or night) as a Production Operator- Pesol , you will … Operate reactors, blend tanks, control systems, and filling and loading equipment safely and efficiently in accordance with procedures, batch sheets, and supervisor direction. Load and unload tank trucks, railcars, totes, drums, and pails; moving raw materials and scrap with a forklift; and completing required batching activities. Inspect equipment, reading and recording operating data, making appropriate adjustments, and performing light maintenance and housekeeping to keep production running smoothly. Perform basic lab analyses to track batch progression and ensure good product quality. Follow all EHS requirements, including safe work permits, lockout/tagout, line break, PPE, hot work, respirator use, and required safety and job training. Contribute to safety, quality, cost, productivity, and morale goals by using LEAN tools, supporting improvements, communicating across shifts, and helping the team respond to changing production needs. If you… Possess a High school diploma or equivalent; with manufacturing experience (preferred).
