jobs.name: Technical Agronomy Summer Intern
jobs.description: Technical Agronomy Summer Intern – Grow Your Future with BASF As a Technical Agronomy Summer Intern , you’ll be part of a team that’s shaping the future of agriculture while building your own career foundation. Internship Details: Duration: 4 months (Summer 2027) Location: Winnipeg and Brandon, MB Compensation: $25 - $32 / Hour Welcome to BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth #AgEmployerOfChoice Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions! Why Join Us? This isn’t your average internship. At BASF, you’ll: Make an Impact : Support large-scale agronomic trials and contribute to real-world agricultural solutions. Build Your Network : Engage with growers, retailers, and BASF teams across the business. Learn by Doing : Get hands-on experience with seeding, spraying, harvesting, and evaluating crop trials. Grow Your Career : Present your own research project to peers and senior leaders, and explore future career tracks. Have Fun : Participate in customer tours, field events, and team activities while working independently in the field. What You’ll Learn: Agronomic trial design and execution. Crop evaluation techniques including plant vigor and stand counts. Safe operation of ATVs, sprayers, and farm equipment. Stakeholder engagement and professional communication. Time management and independent work in a regional setting. What You’ll Do: Organize and manage large-scale trials (e.g., InVigor Demonstration Strip Trials). Conduct evaluations on seed treatments, herbicides, and fungicides. Support customer tours and presentations. Operate ATVs and pull-behind sprayers. Transport equipment between trial sites. Complete and present a demand creation or research project. What We’re Looking For: Currently enrolled in an agriculture science or related degree program. Enthusiastic about agronomy and eager to learn. Strong communicator with a commitment to safety. Able to travel within your assigned region and work independently. Valid driver’s licence required. Experience with farm equipment and sprayers is an asset. To be eligible for this internship, you must be currently enrolled in a post-secondary program and returning to studies following the internship. Applications from individuals who have already graduated will not be considered. Ready to grow with us?

jobs.name: Internship Management Consulting (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF We are BASF’s global in-house management consulting team. Our focus is on strategic projects that drive change and deliver tangible impact. Our work covers a broad range of topics, including growth initiatives, organizational development and efficiency improvement projects, as well as acquisitions and divestitures. We foster a strong team spirit and actively support career development within BASF. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Starting on January 1, 2027 , you will have the opportunity to join our Management Consulting department for three months . As a fully integrated team member, you will be involved from day one in the preparation, coordination, and execution of management consulting projects for the BASF Group’s management. These projects cover a wide range of areas, including strategy, marketing, organization (structures and processes), business optimization, post-merger integration, and corporate development. You will conduct sophisticated analyses, support the team in client interviews, and prepare results and recommendations for presentation to senior management. WHAT YOU OFFER currently enrolled in a master’s degree program with above-average academic performance, regardless of field of study initial professional experience gained through internships or working student positions in consulting or strategy proficient in the use of standard IT applications, particularly Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint fluent English and advanced German language skills required WHAT WE OFFER Practical phase - actively apply theory in challenging and varied tasks/projects Teambuddy - contact person for all questions and regular feedback Networks - get to know different perspectives, ways of thinking and fields of work Internship compensation - a recognition of the commitment, more information you will find here Flexible working hours - depending on the location and area of work HOW TO REACH US Annika Höhn (Talent Acquisition), annika.hoehn@basf.com, Tel: +49 30 2005-58420 will be happy to answer your questions for this position. You can also reach our recruiting team here . First information about our application process can be found here . ABOUT US BASF SE, located in Ludwigshafen am Rhein, is the corporate headquarters of the BASF Group and part of the Rhine-Neckar Metropolitan Region. BASF stands for competence in chemistry since 1865 and is represented today in the world's major consumer markets, with a wide range of products. As the largest employer in the region, BASF SE offers multiple career opportunities for students, university graduates and professionals providing also training in over 30 professions. Leisure, sports, culture and a good infrastructure characterize the Rhine-Neckar Metropolitan Region, in which BASF is also involved with numerous activities. Learn more about BASF SE here . Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.description: Objectives of the Position • Provide Accounts Payable's related support to deliver AP services to BASF companies in Asia Pacific in accordance to Accounts Payable processes and work procedures and in compliance with BASF policies, Financial Reporting Compliance (FRC), local company legal and statutory requirements. • Ensure that timelines and quality meet the agreed service levels and targets. • To coordinate, train and support the Analyst in performing Accounts Payable's payment process related function. • Assist and support Payment Manager in daily task, implementation of project initiatives as when required. Groom and develop team members to be able to handle issues/queries independently • Ensure WI are reviewed on a half yearly basis, and new processes are clearly documented especially for new team members. • Support implementation of accounts payable policies based on guideline according to regional and global standard • Monitor & perform GRIR clearing on a monthly basis including statement of accounts reconciliation • Generate AP monthly aging report and perform analysis (aging/debit balances) with follow up on invoices and block status. • Input VAT management including input VAT verification, non-deductible input VAT adjustment and VAT reconciliation reports preparation. • Regularly analyse on root cause of late payment and propose for solution to improve payment timeliness. • Perform Risk Monitor on timely basis with follow up and stamp of action notes – Risk Monitor Missing Approval, Risk Monitor T&E, Risk Monitor Overdue and Risk Monitor Parked Document. • Support audit yearly audit activities and ensuring prepared by clients reports, audit samples collection, audit walkthrough and vendor balance confirmation letters are completed on time within audit schedule. • Schedule and prepare month end post mortem meeting with the manager on regular basis by having an analysis and status update on GRIR status, Risk Monitor reports, Payment Accuracy and any related areas which concern the impact on P2P operation. Assist Manager to manage knowledge gained on work problems encountered and steps for resolution to facilitate continuous learning, development and cross sharing of knowledge throughout accounts payable team. • Act as AP Digital Assistant to improve AP performance indicators towards strategic and data-driven position • Ensure quality of service offerings are maintained through knowledge transfer & retention of team members. • Provide support to ensure on-time implementation on global and regional P2P projects. • Collaborate closely with Expert/Specialist community in process enhancement related topics. • Drive process changes in the team by recommending and proposing solutions to local company. • Ensure quality of service offerings are maintained through knowledge transfer & retention of team members. jobs.name: Production Area Supervisor
jobs.description: Now hiring! Production Area Supervisor Greenville area, SC (On-site) We are looking for Production Area Supervisors to join our Care Chemicals team in Mauldin, SC. Come create chemistry with us! BASF’s Care Chemicals division is a globally leading supplier to the cosmetics, detergents and cleaning industries. We also offer solutions for technical applications and crop protection. Together with our customers, we create innovative solutions to meet the current and future needs of society more sustainably. We contribute to the long-term success of our customers’ brands with a broad range of products and concepts via our global network of production and development site. As a Production Area Supervisor you will support the day-to-day operation of the plant, providing technical leadership in executing the required production plan. You will be responsible for leading manufacturing operations with a strong focus on safety, compliance, team development, and operational excellence, providing technical leadership in executing the required production plan.  This role drives a culture of accountability and continuous improvement while ensuring adherence to all safety, environmental, and operational standards. As a Production Area Supervisor, you create chemistry by… Driving a strong safety culture by promoting risk reduction, ensuring EHS compliance, and supporting emergency response (e.g., Incident Commander / First Aid) Conducting safety engagements during daily activities and ensure compliance with all site safety rules and procedures. Conducting routine area tours to verify safe operations, ensure adherence to procedures, and maintain high housekeeping standards. Leading day-to-day manufacturing operations, ensuring safe, efficient execution of duties across the shifts. Maintaining direct accountability for all manufacturing functions within the assigned area. Coaching and developing operators and team members, ensuring completion of required training and achievement of performance goals Overseeing the training and development of new hires, existing employees, and contractors; in alignment with the site’s competency-based training program. Ensuring effective communication, troubleshooting process issues, and collaborating cross-functionally to drive operational excellence Maintaining accurate systems, reporting, and documentation (AIM, MOC, SAP, batch records) to support compliance and business continuity Ensuring environmental and regulatory compliance, and driving continuous improvement initiatives Responsible for compliance with environmental and regulatory permits, including wastewater, stormwater, SPCC, etc. Implementing and overseeing the RCRA compliance program, including: proper storage, labeling, and marking of materials; routine inspections; compliance with <90-day accumulation requirements, proper packaging, and handling of regulated materials Reinforcing accountability, operational discipline, and a culture of teamwork, ownership, and continuous improvement. Set clear expectations and maintain accountability for adherence to procedures and standards at all levels of the organization. If you… Hold a High School diploma, or equivalent. Preferrably have 2 years of management experience in a manufacturing environment. Are able to work 8hr day shift pattern, Monday to Friday and any necessary overtime. Rotational on-call duties during weekends. Are safety conscious when working with and around chemicals, have knowledge of the proper methods of handling corrosive, flammable and explosive materials, have knowledge of quality control procedures. Are able to prioritize tasks and be self-motivated, show initiative, have excellent attention to detail, are results oriented and customer focused, possess good communication skills, and possess the ability to work in a team environment.  . Possess strong troubleshooting skills, familiarity with chemical processing equipment, strong and effective interpersonal skills. Have experience in process hazard analysis, management of change, root cause analysis, and incident investigations. Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF . We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us As one of the largest chemical companies in North America we have been finding solutions for your everyday needs and addressing the most complex economic, environmental, and sustainability challenges for more than 150 years! At BASF we empower our employees with the tools, guidance and opportunities they need to advance and succeed in work and life. Giving you the support you need to be your best and fulfill your personal ambitions is what helps us create chemistry. After all, our success is linked to yours. Whatever path you envision, BASF is a great place to build a rewarding, successful career. Belong to Something Bigger. #belongatBASF Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. If you have experienced any of the above, please contact Careers.NorthAmerica@basf.com to report fraud. Equal employment opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

jobs.description: RESPONSIBILITIES Lead the technical response to our most complex and high-risk security incidents as Case Lead - from triage and analysis through containment, eradication, resolution, and closure Lead investigations and compromise assessments Analyze complex malicious artifacts (binaries, scripts, documents) through static and dynamic analysis and reverse engineering to determine their underlying, often obfuscated, functionality Drive our hypothesis-driven threat hunting program: design hunting campaigns, validate hypotheses against threat intelligence, and convert findings into durable detection coverage Design, review, and continuously improve detection logic, correlation rules, and SOAR playbooks on our Elastic Security platform, applying Detection-as-Code practices Shape the CSDC automation and AI roadmap: co-design AI-assisted triage and investigation workflows and supervise their operation with clear human-in-the-loop safeguards Define the strategic roadmap for detection and response capabilities together with CSDC leadership; evaluate and recommend new technologies, tools, and methodologies Act as technical advisor to CSDC leadership on capability development, and as senior escalation point and on-call resource for critical incidents Mentor and train Tier 2 and Tier 3 analysts; develop advanced training content and drive knowledge transfer across the team Lead cross-functional initiatives with adjacent teams (Cyber Threat Intelligence, Offensive Security, Vulnerability Management, Platform Engineering) and steer external service providers to meet BASF security requirements Represent the CSDC in internal security governance bodies and in external communities and trusted networks (e.g., BSI, Deutscher CERT-Verbund, CSSA, FIRST) QUALIFICATIONS Education and Experience Degree in computer science, IT security, or a comparable technical qualification 8+ years of professional experience in cyber defense, incident response, with a track record as a recognized subject matter expert Demonstrated experience leading technical teams and investigations under pressure in high-stakes situations Technical Expertise Expert-level knowledge of the internals of mainstream operating systems (Microsoft Windows, Linux) and of network protocols and traffic analysis Deep understanding of current attacker tradecraft: advanced persistent threats, actors, infrastructures, and TTPs, structured along MITRE ATT&CK Strong hands-on expertise with Elastic Security as SIEM and EDR: detection rule development and tuning, investigation and hunting; experience with Elastic automation capabilities (workflows, AI Assistant) and ES|QL is a strong plus Proficiency with modern DFIR tooling (e.g., OSQuery, Velociraptor, Volatility, Suricata, Wireshark) and with malware analysis and reverse engineering tools (e.g., Ghidra, IDA Pro, x64dbg, WinDbg) Solid experience in cloud and identity threat detection and response (Microsoft Entra ID / Active Directory, Azure, AWS) Ability to program in Python and ideally Go; confident scripting in common shells (Bash, PowerShell); ability to read C and x86/x64 assembly in the context of reverse engineering Working understanding of AI/ML applications in security operations (model-assisted triage, LLM-assisted investigation, explainability) is a plus Leadership and Communication Proven ability to lead technical experts through stressful situations and to remain a calm, structured decision-maker during critical incidents Strong mentoring and coaching mindset; genuine motivation to grow the analysts around you Confident communication in English, both spoken and written, up to executive level; German language skills are a plus Excellent organizational and time management skills; willingness to participate in an on-call rotation Certifications Relevant certifications are valued as supporting evidence of your expertise - none of them is a strict requirement. We particularly welcome: GIAC / SANS: GCIH, GCFA, GNFA, GREM, GCTI, GDAT, or GCDA; the GIAC Security Expert (GSE) designation is a distinguishing qualification at this level Elastic: Elastic Certified Analyst or Elastic Certified Engineer Cloud security: Microsoft SC-200 or AZ-500, AWS Certified Security - Specialty, or GIAC GCLD Offensive and intrusion analysis: OffSec OSCP or OSDA, or CREST Registered Intrusion Analyst (CRIA) WHAT WE OFFER A secure work environment because your health, safety and wellbeing is always our top priority. Flexible work schedule and Home-office options, so that you can balance your working life and private life. Learning and development opportunities 23 holiday days per year 5 additional days (readjustment) 2 cultural days A collaborative, trustful and innovative work environment Being part of an international team and work in global projects Relocation assistance to Madrid provided At BASF, the chemistry is right Because we are counting on innovative solutions, sustainable actions, connected thinking and on you, become a part of our formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.At BASF, we are committed to upholding and ensuring compliance with company standards related to quality, environment, health, safety, and energy, in line with our global guidelines.We actively promote a culture of prevention and continuous improvement, encouraging collaboration in initiatives related to quality, environmental protection, health, safety, and energy performance.We foster responsible energy use, promoting efficiency in daily operations and supporting the identification of improvement projects and energy-saving opportunities

Rejoignez xarvio Digital Farming , l'entité agriculture numérique du groupe BASF, et participez au développement d'une approche innovante de la protection des cultures : le service HEALTHY FIELDS. Avec HEALTHY FIELDS, les producteurs céréaliers souscrivent à un contrat de Performance sur leurs hectares cultivés plutôt qu'à l'achat de produits phytosanitaires. Ce service innovant de protection des cultures repose sur des modèles agronomiques et épidémiologiques combiné à du suivi terrain afin d'optimiser les interventions et de contribuer à une utilisation raisonnée des intrants. Nous recherchons un étudiant ingénieur motivé pour participer régionalement au développement et à l'amélioration du service, auprès des agriculteurs et de nos partenaires de la distribution agricole. VOS PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITES Complètement intégré à la petite équipe xarvio HEALTHY FIELDS (5 personnes), vous participez à: Suivi agronomique terrain : Assurer le suivi d'un réseau de parcelles engagées dans le service HEALTHY FIELDS et confronter les prévisions des algorithmes à la réalité terrain ; Évaluation des outils numériques : Analyser les performances de l'Outil d'Aide à la Décision  et participer à l'exploitation des données agronomiques ; Expérimentation et innovation : Mettre en place et suivre des essais en grandes parcelles chez des agriculteurs partenaires, évaluer l'intérêt agronomique, économique et environnemental des résultats obtenus ; Compréhension des usages : recueillir les retours des agriculteurs et techniciens utilisateurs du service et établir des recommandations d'amélioration de l'expérience client et de la proposition de valeur du service ; Prospective et développement : réaliser une veille sur les services agricoles innovants, participer à la réflexion stratégique d'évolution du service ; Contribuer à des événements techniques et professionnels aux côtés des équipes xarvio. VOTRE PROFIL Vous êtes à la recherche d'un stage de 6 mois dès février 2027 dans le cadre de votre dernière année d'école d’ingénieur en agriculture ou agronomie ; Vous avez un intérêt marqué pour l'agriculture de précision et les technologies numériques ; Vous avez des bases en production végétales et en protection des cultures (grandes cultures) ; Vous aimez travailler sur le terrain, au contact des techniciens et des agriculteurs ; Vous êtes basé dans le nord de la France (région Hauts-de-France, Ile-de-France, Normandie voire Grand Est) et possédez le permis de conduire afin d’effectuer des déplacements réguliers sur le secteur (véhicule fourni par BASF) ; Vous êtes autonome, avez le sens pratique et le goût pour le travail collaboratif en distanciel. CE QUE NOUS VOUS OFFRONS Gratification de stage selon la réglementation en vigueur ; Un accompagnement personnalisé favorisant le développement de vos compétences métier; Une immersion au cœur des enjeux de l'agriculture de précision ; Une expérience terrain au contact direct des agriculteurs et conseillers agricoles ; Une découverte concrète des outils numériques appliqués à l'agronomie (OAD, modélisation, données satellitaires) ; Une contribution à des solutions favorisant la performance économique et la transition agroécologique ; Un sujet particulièrement adapté à un mémoire de fin d'études ingénieur associant analyse stratégique, terrain, agriculture numérique et transition agroécologique. CE POSTE VOUS INTERESSE ? Pour candidater, il suffit de cliquer sur le bouton « postuler » sur cette fiche de poste. Vous devrez alors créer votre profil et ajouter vos documents de candidatures. Cela ne vous prendra que quelques minutes. Nicolas, en charge de ce recrutement, reçoit et analyse toutes les candidatures et enverra un courriel aux candidats présélectionnés pour les inviter à un entretien vidéo MS Teams de 30 minutes. Nous vous souhaitons bonne chance et sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature ! Seules les candidatures soumises via l’offre publiée sur notre site carrière seront étudiées. Toute candidature reçue en dehors du processus prévu (par e-mail, par exemple) ne sera pas considérée. Pour bien comprendre le processus, vous pouvez vous rendre sur cette page dédiée. Il vous reste des questions ? Vous pouvez nous contacter ici. QUI SOMMES-NOUS ? Fournisseur majeur de solutions pour l'agriculture, BASF Agricultural Solutions France a pour ambition d'accompagner les agriculteurs dans la transition agroécologique au travers d'un portefeuille de solutions faites de produits modernes de protection des cultures, de biocontrôle, de solutions digitales, de semences et d'expertises agronomiques. Plus de 300 collaborateurs basés à Ecully à proximité de Lyon et en régions, répondent aux besoins des agriculteurs et aux enjeux de l'agriculture française. La diversité est notre plus grande force ! Rejoignez notre formule gagnante et venez développer le futur avec nous - au sein d'une équipe internationale qui encourage l'inclusion et l'égalité des chances indépendamment du genre, de l'âge, de l'orientation sexuelle, du handicap ou des croyances. Postuler Our people are at the heart of everything, dedicated to delivering value for our customers every day. By focusing on enabling our people today and in the future, we will ensure we have the talent and skills needed to succeed. United by the love of farming, we innovate, collaborate, and strive for the best solutions together, creating connections and driving success as one team. This is how we make an impact. For the love of farming, the biggest job on Earth. jobs.name: Intercompany & Invoicing Analyst (fixed-term project-based)
jobs.description: Quienes somos: Somos BASF, la compañía química más grande del mundo, con más de 150 años de experiencia. En Montevideo, operamos como un HUB que brinda servicios a todas las empresas de BASF en las Américas. Ofrecemos soluciones profesionales en finanzas, adquisiciones, reportes, logística, tecnología, recursos humanos, proyectos, comunicaciones, asuntos legales, medioambiente, seguridad, salud y calidad. Area: En BASF, nuestro equipo de Finance Order-to-Cash (O2C) es fundamental para asegurar la eficiencia y confiabilidad en la gestión financiera de nuestras operaciones en las Américas. Desde nuestro Hub en Montevideo, cubrimos los procesos desde el momento de la venta hasta el momento del pago de los clientes y somos responsables por áreas clave como tesorería y gestión de caja, cuentas por cobrar, gestión de cobranzas, gestión de crédito, conciliación intercompany y master data de clientes y proveedores. Nuestro objetivo es mantener procesos sólidos y ágiles, minimizar los riesgos financieros y operacionales, y fomentar la innovación continua mediante la digitalización y automatización de tareas. Principales objetivos de la posición: Llevar adelante la ejecución de la reconciliación mensual de operaciones entre compañías BASF (región Américas), como también la gestión de otros procesos de facturación y regalías, de manera eficiente. Tareas principales: Reconciliación de operaciones entre compañías BASF (región Américas) mes a mes, ajustando al cierre en caso necesario, en tiempo y forma, con su correcta justificación. Analizar y dar seguimiento de partidas pendientes por diferencias entre reconciliaciones de operaciones intra-BASF. Creación de contratos con terceros respecto a descuentos por volúmenes de ventas en tiempo y forma. Ejecutar las Notas de crédito por descuentos por volúmenes de ventas a terceros en tiempo y forma. Creación de reportes a los negocios por el proceso de descuentos por volúmenes de ventas. Seguimiento y registro de regalías cumpliendo con las fechas y estándares pre alineados. Monitoreo y resolución de facturas pendientes en el sistema para que continúen su proceso de facturación. Monitoreo de contratos por agentes y su correcta gestión. En caso contrario informar al referente en el equipo. Comunicación fluida y soporte a nuestros stakeholders a través de llamadas, correos, entrenamientos, etc. Requisitos mínimos de educación y calificaciones para el puesto: Educación: Estudiantes de Contador, Administración, Economía y/o afines. Experiencia laboral: 1 a 3 años de experiencia. Idiomas: Inglés avanzado. Habilidades técnicas: Conocimientos en Microsoft Office. Se valoran los conocimientos en SAP. Habilidades blandas: Trabajo en equipo, comunicación efectiva y proactividad. Qué ofrecemos: Vivir BASF es ser parte de una cultura donde el foco está en las personas y en su desarrollo profesional y personal. Nuestra diversidad, colaboración y estilo de liderazgo marcan la diferencia. Al sumarte a nuestro equipo te ofrecemos: Un modelo de trabajo híbrido y flexible Acceso a un ecosistema de aprendizaje con recursos y herramientas disponibles on‑demand Seguro médico privado para vos y tu familia desde el primer día, además de seguro de vida Días adicionales de licencia flexible, además de tu licencia legal Día libre por cumpleaños Día libre por mudanza Bono anual (sujeto al cumplimiento de los requisitos establecidos por las políticas internas) Beneficios de bienestar, como servicios de nutrición dentro de la compañía y masajes BASF considera la Ley N° 19.691 y el Decreto N° 73/019 en todos sus procesos de contratación. Cada candidato calificado que cumpla con los requisitos establecidos en la descripción del puesto será considerado en este proceso de contratación sin distinción. Además, BASF es un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades. Aceptamos con entusiasmo nuestra responsabilidad de tomar decisiones de empleo sin tener en cuenta la raza, la edad, el estado civil y social, el origen nacional, la discapacidad, el sexo, la identidad de género o las expresiones, o cualquier otra característica o grupo de candidatos o empleados que no esté relacionado con su aptitud e idoneidad para el puesto. Nuestra dirección está comprometida a seguir esta política en lo que respecta a la contratación, colocación, promoción, transferencia, descenso, despido, terminación, reclutamiento, remuneración y otras formas de compensación, capacitación y trato general durante el empleo.

jobs.name: R&D Scientist
jobs.description: Now hiring! R&D Scientist Attapulgus (Onsite) Relocation assistance provided. We are looking for a R&D Scientist to join our Refining Catalyst team in Attapulgus, GA. Rejoignez xarvio Digital Farming , l'entité agriculture numérique du groupe BASF, et participez au développement d'une approche innovante de la protection des cultures : le service HEALTHY FIELDS. Avec HEALTHY FIELDS, les producteurs céréaliers souscrivent à un contrat de Performance sur leurs hectares cultivés plutôt qu'à l'achat de produits phytosanitaires. Ce service innovant de protection des cultures repose sur des modèles agronomiques et épidémiologiques combiné à du suivi terrain afin d'optimiser les interventions et de contribuer à une utilisation raisonnée des intrants. Nous recherchons un étudiant ingénieur motivé pour participer régionalement au développement et à l'amélioration du service, auprès des agriculteurs et de nos partenaires de la distribution agricole. VOS PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITES Complètement intégré à la petite équipe xarvio HEALTHY FIELDS (5 personnes), vous participez à: Suivi agronomique terrain : Assurer le suivi d'un réseau de parcelles engagées dans le service HEALTHY FIELDS et confronter les prévisions des algorithmes à la réalité terrain ; Évaluation des outils numériques : Analyser les performances de l'Outil d'Aide à la Décision  et participer à l'exploitation des données agronomiques ; Expérimentation et innovation : Mettre en place et suivre des essais en grandes parcelles chez des agriculteurs partenaires, évaluer l'intérêt agronomique, économique et environnemental des résultats obtenus ; Compréhension des usages : recueillir les retours des agriculteurs et techniciens utilisateurs du service et établir des recommandations d'amélioration de l'expérience client et de la proposition de valeur du service ; Prospective et développement : réaliser une veille sur les services agricoles innovants, participer à la réflexion stratégique d'évolution du service ; Contribuer à des événements techniques et professionnels aux côtés des équipes xarvio. VOTRE PROFIL Vous êtes à la recherche d'un stage de 6 mois dès février 2027 dans le cadre de votre dernière année d'école d’ingénieur en agriculture ou agronomie ; Vous avez un intérêt marqué pour l'agriculture de précision et les technologies numériques ; Vous avez des bases en production végétales et en protection des cultures (grandes cultures) ; Vous aimez travailler sur le terrain, au contact des techniciens et des agriculteurs ; Vous êtes basé dans l'ouest de la France (région Pays de la Loire, région Centre-Val de Loire, voire le sud de la Normandie) et possédez le permis de conduire afin d’effectuer des déplacements réguliers sur le secteur (véhicule fourni par BASF) ; Vous êtes autonome, avez le sens pratique et le goût pour le travail collaboratif en distanciel. CE QUE NOUS VOUS OFFRONS Gratification de stage selon la réglementation en vigueur ; Un accompagnement personnalisé favorisant le développement de vos compétences métier; Une immersion au cœur des enjeux de l'agriculture de précision ; Une expérience terrain au contact direct des agriculteurs et conseillers agricoles ; Une découverte concrète des outils numériques appliqués à l'agronomie (OAD, modélisation, données satellitaires) ; Une contribution à des solutions favorisant la performance économique et la transition agroécologique ; Un sujet particulièrement adapté à un mémoire de fin d'études ingénieur associant analyse stratégique, terrain, agriculture numérique et transition agroécologique. CE POSTE VOUS INTERESSE ? Pour candidater, il suffit de cliquer sur le bouton « postuler » sur cette fiche de poste. Vous devrez alors créer votre profil et ajouter vos documents de candidatures. Cela ne vous prendra que quelques minutes. Nicolas, en charge de ce recrutement, reçoit et analyse toutes les candidatures et enverra un courriel aux candidats présélectionnés pour les inviter à un entretien vidéo MS Teams de 30 minutes. Nous vous souhaitons bonne chance et sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature ! Seules les candidatures soumises via l’offre publiée sur notre site carrière seront étudiées. Toute candidature reçue en dehors du processus prévu (par e-mail, par exemple) ne sera pas considérée. Pour bien comprendre le processus, vous pouvez vous rendre sur cette page dédiée. Il vous reste des questions ? Vous pouvez nous contacter ici. QUI SOMMES-NOUS ? Fournisseur majeur de solutions pour l'agriculture, BASF Agricultural Solutions France a pour ambition d'accompagner les agriculteurs dans la transition agroécologique au travers d'un portefeuille de solutions faites de produits modernes de protection des cultures, de biocontrôle, de solutions digitales, de semences et d'expertises agronomiques. Plus de 300 collaborateurs basés à Ecully à proximité de Lyon et en régions, répondent aux besoins des agriculteurs et aux enjeux de l'agriculture française. La diversité est notre plus grande force ! Rejoignez notre formule gagnante et venez développer le futur avec nous - au sein d'une équipe internationale qui encourage l'inclusion et l'égalité des chances indépendamment du genre, de l'âge, de l'orientation sexuelle, du handicap ou des croyances. Postuler Our people are at the heart of everything, dedicated to delivering value for our customers every day. By focusing on enabling our people today and in the future, we will ensure we have the talent and skills needed to succeed. United by the love of farming, we innovate, collaborate, and strive for the best solutions together, creating connections and driving success as one team. This is how we make an impact. For the love of farming, the biggest job on Earth. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT In our unit Digital Controlling & Processes, we develop and implement system-based steering concepts for our surface business. We oversee and enhance our SAP S/4HANA systems in the areas of controlling, data analytics and business warehouse. In close collaboration with stakeholders, we actively support our differentiated business steering approach by translating business unit and divisional requirements into robust IT solutions. Additionally, we serve as a consulting unit for all related topics and drive innovation in digital controlling processes. In your new role, you own and continuously develop the global product costing process framework, including standards, governance models, policies, and best practices. As the global expert for product costing and SAP CO-PC, you provide guidance to business stakeholders, service providers, key users, and IT partners and translate business requirements into sustainable process and system solutions. In addition, you drive the harmonization, standardization, and continuous improvement of product costing processes across regions and business units, ensuring efficient and compliant process execution. Together with the BPO provider, you monitor and improve product costing service delivery while ensuring data quality, process transparency, audit readiness, and compliance with internal controls. You lead product costing process and system enhancements within SAP S/4HANA and related digital finance solutions and coordinate user acceptance testing for projects, enhancements, and system changes. Furthermore, you support finance transformation through digitalization and automation, advance reporting and analytics requirements, and foster knowledge sharing and best practices within the global key user community. WHAT YOU OFFER degree in business administration, finance, information systems, or a related field, combined with several years of experience in product costing and expert knowledge of manufacturing controlling processes extensive hands-on SAP CO-PC experience, including standard costing, material ledger, inventory valuation, and variance analysis strong understanding of product costing integration with FI, MM, PP, and SD in SAP S/4HANA experience in process governance, standardization, and continuous improvement, ideally within an SSC, GBS, or Finance Service Hub ability to translate business requirements into effective and sustainable process and system solutions, as well as to collaborate effectively in a global and multicultural environment strong communication skills in English, with German language skills considered an advantage, as well as strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills WHAT WE OFFER We offer an attractive salary with individual benefits such as performance-related bonuses. Company-funded supplementary health insurance, accident insurance and pension related benefits We offer a wide range of local and global development and career opportunities for professional and personal development Surventis stands for diversity - we are proud of our Coatings employee networks WomenInCoatings, Color Pride and CultiConnect The feedback culture is firmly integrated into our corporate culture, e.g. through regular employee surveys and management feedback At our location in Münster, we have our own fitness studio "Freizeit" with a physiotherapy practice, permanently employed company doctors, a company restaurant "Auszeit" including a café bar, a bilingual company daycare center "LackiKids" and a vacation program "LackiKids on Tour". HOW TO REACH US Julia Kiersch (Talent Acquisition), julia.kiersch@basf.com, Tel: +49 30 2005-59139 will be happy to answer your questions for this position. You are also welcome to book an online appointment. ABOUT US Learn more about our company here . Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief. jobs.name: Delivery Lead (AGRO) - Morumbi/SP
jobs.description: Delivery Lead (AGRO) - Morumbi/SP Location: Morumbi/SP Hibrid Model: 3 days/ week in the office BUSINESS (AGRICULTURAL SOLUTIONS) We are BASF in agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems, connecting seeds and traits, crop protection, digital tools and sustainability approaches. We strive to deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and other stakeholders along the value chain. We do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture by connecting innovation, customers and society. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth ABOUT THE POSITION As Delivery Lead for Brazil Tax Technologies, you own the technical solution for BASF Agricultural Solutions' indirect tax and fiscal-reporting landscape in Brazil – centered on the tax-determination and fiscal-books/reporting capabilities connecting to the SPARK S/4HANA platform. You act as the technical solution owner for third-party or in-house solutions, translating tax-functional requirements into robust technical designs, configurations and integrations on SPARK. You govern and steer the delivery of change requests arising from the Brazil Tax Reform (CBS/IBS/IS transition through 2033) and from ongoing production support of the live solution, validating effort estimates and prioritizing the backlog. You are responsible for external vendor management including IT solution providers and implementation partners. You coordinate interfaces with the AP ERP Platform team to ensure end-to-end integration (SAP DRC, Nota Fiscal, SEFAZ). You ensure creation and maintenance of technical documentation and code in Azure DevOps, and drive quality through testing, UAT support and defect triage. You partner with the Tax function – jointly evaluating and approving new demands before build – and you own technical feasibility, architecture fit and solution integrity in collaboration with solution and enterprise architects. You evaluate the current Brazil Tax Technology landscape and build a roadmap for continuous improvement and future target-state evolution. You provide technical guidance and coaching to local Brazil tax-technology Subject Matter Experts and advocate APB/I's agile ways of working. CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS Education University degree (e.g., Bachelor) in Computer Science, Computing in Business, IT, or a comparable field. Master degree (preferred) Experience Several years' experience in software development, architecture and solution design, ideally in a tax or finance IT context. Proven experience delivering SAP-integrated tax solutions (e.g. indirect tax determination and/or fiscal reporting) OneSource, Tax One, SAP DRC or comparable. Experience in at least two comparable positions and in managing external vendors/implementation partners. Project experience in agile/DevOps environments; leadership experience within agile teams is an advantage. Technical skills Understanding of Brazilian indirect tax and e-invoicing (NF-e/NFC-e, SEFAZ, SPED, fiscal books). SAP technology and integration (SD/MM/FI touchpoints, master data, interfaces). Cloud provider (Azure); Project management software (Azure DevOps); Databases; SAP master data / reference systems. Solution design & architecture alignment; requirements engineering. Analytical thinking, problem-solving and systematic troubleshooting. Quality assurance, test-case design and UAT. Stakeholder management and consulting. Maintenance of technical documentation and code (Azure DevOps). Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new technologies. Excellent communication skills with a collaborative and solution-oriented mindset Methodology skills Agile methodologies Project management Change management Moderation & Presentation. Language skills Portuguese (fluent) English (fluent/business) DIVERSITY IS OUR GREATEST STRENGHT! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

Responsible in ensuring all work documentations and work processes are updated in compliance to BASF policies & guidelines, Financial Reporting Compliance requirements, local company legal and statutory requirements. Contribute and drive the implementation of project initiatives e.g. technology enhancement, internal control, merger and acquisition etc. Lead local projects and participate in regional projects. Contribute to Financial Reporting internal control measures. jobs.description:
Now hiring! Technical Service Specialist, Tupelo Mississippi Location- Remote / Homebased in Tupelo Mississippi or nearby Pay Range: $80,000 - $95 ,000 We are looking for a Technical Service Specialist to join our Surface Treatment team in Tupelo Mississippi. New finish, Proven expertise. Bolder ambition. If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact, and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. Please do not be confused by this: All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application will be submitted to us. At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships.  We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place. As a Technical Service Specialist (TSS) you will have responsibility that leads and coordinates all technical, purchasing, inventory, reporting activities, manage assigned projects, and respond to customer needs and complaints for our customer accounts within your territory. This position offers an incentive bonus plan, company car, laptop, phone, and all travel expenses covered by the company; travel for this role is 50% daily travel within your territory with occasional overnight travel. As a Technical Service Specialist, you will... Be the first in line for technical support with customers; providing in-depth technical service to key customers. Foster a Safety mindset acting as a safety ambassador for your customers. Complete all required Surventis compliance trainings, complete and pass all required technical training utilizing the CL3 platform, in person live training and adjacent technical seminars. Train plant personnel, line audits, startup of new processes, troubleshoot problems, continuous improvement, coordinate test work being done for the plant and participate in plant functions, such as system clean outs, team audit meetings, process analysis, and inventory management where necessary. Plan service visits with the purpose of bringing value to the customer (not just pinks and blues). The goal is to develop and strengthen relationships with key stakeholders. Communicate with a written service report utilizing clear purpose driven comments of action items and findings. Load service reports Salesforce and notify all key stakeholders. Participate in business reviews to continually reinforce our value proposition while keeping our customers out of the zone of indifference. Set up each account with the proper process instructions for the chemical process supplied by Surventis. Educate customers on proper handling of chemicals, reagents, and sample submission procedures. Assist & facilitate the installation, and troubleshoot and train proper use of process equipment provided by Surventis to the account. Look for opportunities to add business whenever possible, to be done in concert with the Technical Sales Representative (our best leads come from our customers). If you have... Bachelors Degree in Chemistry of Chemical Engineering is preferred. We are also open to high school diploma with more experience. Minimum of 1 year of technical experience with pretreatment, coatings, surface treatment, metalworking and adjacent industry applications is preferred. We are also open to fresh undergraduates with chemistry background. Ability to learn new skills and techniques associated with different product applications and chemical programs. (Products include metalworking fluids, paint pretreatment, e-coat, etc.) Ability to work autonomously, perform job responsibilities, and make consequential decisions without the need for continual direct supervision. Understanding of the chemical process, knowledge of Manufacturing Plant operations and the importance of safety. Technical expertise regarding products, specifications, processes, operations, testing, and data collection. Strong troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and problem-solving skills and analytical experience for testing and technical evaluation. Strong inventory management/control and product ordering is required. Relationship management experience, building and strengthening relationships with customer's technical department. Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written. Basic computer skills are required. (MS Office Products, Salesforce, etc.) Ability to work collaboratively with internal and external teammates (Surventis and customers) to execute established account strategy and achieve established goals. Ability to lift 50lbs and stand for long periods of time. Travel for this position is 40% with occasional overnight travel within your territory. Privacy statement Surventis takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. Pay transparency Surventis is committed to pay transparency practices. The competitive Pay Range for this role is $80,000 - $95,000. Actual pay will be determined based on education, certifications, experience, and other job-related factors permitted by law. Equal employment opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. jobs.name: Tool Design Engineer
jobs.description: Now hiring! Tool Design Engineer Wyandotte, MI We are looking for a Tool Design Engineer to join our Performance Materials team in Wyandotte. Come create chemistry with us! The Performance Materials division is at the forefront of the much-needed sustainability transformation in plastics. Our experts co-create products with customers to bring innovations to major industry sectors such as transportation, consumer goods, industrial applications, and construction.These solutions contribute to a sustainable future by pushing the boundaries in thermal resistance, robustness and lightweight applications. We are seeking a skilled tooling design professional to support Cellasto manufacturing operations through the design, development, and optimization of production molds, gauges, fixtures, and other manufacturing tools. In this role, you will leverage advanced tooling design principles and extensive expertise in SolidWorks or Creo to deliver innovative, reliable, and cost-effective solutions that enhance product quality, manufacturing efficiency, and workplace safety. You will be responsible for designing, launching, and providing ongoing support for new production molds, gauges, fixtures, and related production equipment. Working closely with engineering, production, maintenance, and quality teams, you will ensure tooling solutions meet product specifications, manufacturing requirements, and operational objectives. Through effective project coordination and continuous improvement efforts, you will play a key role in reducing reject rate and supporting the successful introduction of new products and technologies within the Cellasto plant. As a Tool Design Engineer, you create chemistry by... Designing Cellasto foaming molds according to global design guidelines, supporting the successful introduction of new products into production phase with minimal reject levels. Coordinating the construction and modification of tools, managing timelines and ensuring global quality specification for tools are met. Supporting the Design review and Reject Rate meetings and providing technical insights for design optimizations, with focus in product functionality and process performance (reject levels and manufacturability). Supporting Operations in troubleshooting existing tool to minimize the level of reject rate by suggesting and implementing design optimizations, according to the global design guidelines and in alignment with S&E and Quality. Designing, coordinating the construction and introducing assembling fixtures and inspection gauges. Managing projects workflows and design documentation. If you... Have a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or correlated area, with a blend of professional experience that supports the success in the role. Possess preferably at least 10 years of experience in in tool or product design for automotive industry in one or more of the following operations: molding (cast, injection or blow molding), machining or assembly. Have a solid ability in designing with CAD (CREO Elements/Pro/Solid Works preferred), construction and process verification and DFM principles. Have solid understanding of the mold design process including interpreting part designs and translating to mold designs and drawings, incorporating DFM requirements and leading mold design reviews. Understand tool construction process. Are proficient with MS Office, Solid Works, Document Management Systems. Have strong EHS orientation and emphasis in both personnel and process safety. Are able to lead yourself and execute your work with minimal level of supervision. Are a good team player and communicate well across multiple levels of the organization. Then… Click below to Belong@BASF! Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF . We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us As one of the largest chemical companies in North America we have been finding solutions for your everyday needs and addressing the most complex economic, environmental, and sustainability challenges for more than 150 years! At BASF we empower our employees with the tools, guidance and opportunities they need to advance and succeed in work and life. Giving you the support you need to be your best and fulfill your personal ambitions is what helps us create chemistry. After all, our success is linked to yours. Whatever path you envision, BASF is a great place to build a rewarding, successful career. Belong to Something Bigger. #belongatBASF Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. If you have experienced any of the above, please contact myhr@basf.com to report fraud. Equal employment opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

jobs.name: Global Customs Classification (Senior Executive) 3
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities . Objectives of the Position The Customs Classification Senior Executive is responsible for all related activities required for customs classification of BASF products and raw materials as well as other non-chemical materials to be classified. He or she must comply with the applicable laws and customs regulations to ensure a correct and up-to-date classification. In the role, he or she is part of the Global Customs Classification team and needs to closely work together with the National Customs Classification Senior Executive. Main Tasks Delivery of Customs service to business Collaborate cross-functionally with internal working partners in support of trade compliance, supply chain, and general company objectives and projects Support business unit queries related to customs such as classification, duty and analysis Support organizing meeting with countries and any business review as necessary Respond promptly to ad-hoc requests or urgent issues, providing support for special projects or tasks as they arise Customs Classification responsibilities Customs classification of BASF products, raw materials and non-chemical materials and maintenance of master data for customs classification in BASF's databases Global responsibility for non-chemical materials Global supported-governance role regarding customs classification for the BASF Group Identification of relevant customs laws and regulations as well as new customs issues Keep up with regulations and take immediate action to comply with the latest requirement Prepare monthly statistics and KPI report, monitor performance to ensure smooth operations Support the data preparation required for dashboards, including alerts and analysis Support the standardization of reporting of departmental and organizational measurements Support the automation of routine data collection and develop reporting processes that aid operational performance management Proactively address and resolve any discrepancies or customs-related issues (e.g.tariff classification mismatch, etc.) by troubleshooting the root cause and communicating clearly with relevant parties Management of service mailbox including setup, access, out of office reply, retention and trouble shooting Management of share point / team folders including access, retention and record keeping policy adherence Participation in the development of concepts for the implementation of legal requirements and in the optimization of customs classification processes in the BASF Group Support of the global harmonization of customs classification data and BASF’s IT processes on customs classification Support and understanding of BASF interests at national and international authorities and associations Ensuring regulatory compliance in collaboration with the business units and group companies Information, training and consulting support for the BASF Group companies, business units and group companies worldwide Monitoring and processing duty suspensions and tariff quotas if any Processing of IT-specific questions within the scope of the classification work and representation of the group interests in this work area C ustoms Compliance responsibilities Support Customs Compliance related assessment, health checks, audit and its documentation Support operational and service documentation including Standard Operating Procedure, Work Instructions, Work Guide Ensure all activities comply with relevant customs regulations, trade laws and tariff schedules Process and system improvement responsibilities Support any digitalization initiatives or automation for customs process and operations Support any system upgrade or enhancement related review and testing Requirements Education Bachelor’s degree in chemistry, Chemical Engineering or any major in sciences related subjects Working Experience Minimum 2-3 years’ relevant experience in Classification, Customs and Foreign Trade; familiar with Supply Chain operations Technical & Professional Knowledge Experience in customs, trade law and practices of chemical and non-chemical products is desirable Good Microsoft office knowledge Good analytical and work management skills Good knowledge of SAP and SAP GTS is highly desirable English (fluent in spoken and written) Other countries’ language will be advantages The BASF Service Hub Kuala Lumpur (BASF Asia-Pacific Service Centre Sdn Bhd) is strategically located in the capital city of Malaysia. Since its inception in 2005, the hub has expanded from 130 employees to over 1,300 employees currently and is expected to keep growing. As an ISO 9001:2005 certified organization, the Service Hub Kuala Lumpur is committed to delivering high quality expertise and services in finance, people, supply chain, EHSQ (environment, health, safety, quality), product safety and digital. We take pride in providing our business services to BASF companies and affiliates across 20 markets in the Asia Pacific region and beyond. Moreover, we offer our services in 8 different languages to cater to the diverse needs of our stakeholders. Our focus on competency and technology-driven solutions allows us to consistently deliver exceptional services, thereby contributing to the success of our businesses. BASF also has two other regional hubs located in Berlin, Germany, and Montevideo, Uruguay, which cover the European and American regions. BASF Service Hub Kuala Lumpur was recognized with nine prestigious awards in 2024, reflecting its commitment to creating a vibrant, inclusive, and empowering workplace. These awards include winning the title of Operational Excellence in HR at the GBS Asia Awards 2024, multiple accolades at the Life at Work Awards 2024, where the hub was recognized as First Runner-up for Workplace Excellence (International Organization) and CEO Champion (International Organization), as well as Second Runner-up for Best International Organization. The hub also won the title for Excellence in Learning Tech Advancement System and a Certificate of Excellence in Talent Management and Leadership at the HRD Awards 2024. Furthermore, the hub secured a Bronze Award for Excellence in Digital Transformation at the HR Excellence Awards 2024 and received a Bronze Award for Human Resources Impact and an Honorary Award for Creative Talent Management Impact at the SSON Impact Awards Asia 2024. At BASF, we create chemistry for a sustainable future. Our ambition: We want to be the preferred chemical company to enable our customers’ green transformation. We combine economic success with environmental protection and social responsibility. Around 112,000 employees in the BASF Group contribute to the success of our customers in nearly all sectors and almost every country in the world. Our portfolio comprises, as core businesses, the segments Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, and Nutrition & Care; our standalone businesses are bundled in the segments Surface Technologies and Agricultural Solutions. BASF generated sales of €65.3 billion in 2024. BASF shares are traded on the stock exchange in Frankfurt (BAS) and as American Depositary Receipts (BASFY) in the United States. Further information at www.basf.com .

Mit dem Bau der Anlage für Batteriematerialien legt die BASF in Schwarzheide den Grundstein für eine europäische Wertschöpfungskette der Elektromobilität. Um unseren CO2-Fußabdruck zu verbessern setzen wir auf effiziente Produktionsverfahren, innovatives Kreislaufmanagement und eine nachhaltige Energiestrategie. Dazu zählt auch die Rückgewinnung der Rohstoffe durch Recycling um damit den Kreislauf zu schließen. Werden Sie Teil dieser Reise und entdecken Sie das vielseitige Produktportfolio von BASF. WAS SIE ERWARTET Unsere Geschäftseinheit Technical Management ist Ansprechpartner:in für unsere Produktionsanlagen bei allen Themen rund um Instandhaltung und Infrastruktur. Wir stellen die Anlagenverfügbarkeit sicher und treiben Anlagenänderungsprozesse zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung voran. Als Projektingenieur:in führen Sie Studien durch, bewerten Varianten zur optimalen Lösung der Aufgabenstellung und treffen Entscheidungen innerhalb Ihres Verantwortungsspielraumes. Sie steuern den Anlagenänderungsprozess von der Kostenschätzung über die Planung bis zur Montage und Dokumentation. Zusätzlich unterstützen Sie bei der Inbetriebnahme durch den Betreiber. Sie erstellen Unterlagen zur Genehmigung der Projekte und erarbeiten Berichte über den monatlichen Projektstatus hinsichtlich Zeit-, Kosten- und Qualitätsaspekten sowie der Sicherheitsperformance. Für eine reibungslose Realisierung des Projektes erstellen Sie einen Projektplan vom Basic Engineering, unterstützen bei der Vergabe von Kontraktorleistungen und koordinieren interne Fachkräfte sowie externe Kontraktoren. Dabei sorgen Sie für die Einhaltung der Regeln zum Sicherheits-, Gesundheits- sowie Umweltschutz und verfassen nach erfolgreicher Projektumsetzung die Abschlussdokumentation. Nicht zuletzt wirken Sie proaktiv bei der kontinuierlichen Optimierung von Verfahrensanweisungen, Prozessen und Standards auf lokaler sowie globaler Ebene mit. Arbeiten Sie in einer offenen Arbeitsatmosphäre, in der die Vielfalt von Menschen, Meinungen und Erfahrungen willkommen ist und geschätzt wird. Profitieren Sie vom starken Tarifvertrag der Chemischen Industrie (attraktives Gehalt, Urlaubsgeld i.H.v. 1.200 €, 13. Monatsgehalt) sowie unseren zusätzlichen betrieblichen Leistungen. Zusätzlich erwarten Sie eine jährliche Erfolgsbeteiligung, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, eine Pflegezusatzversicherung sowie ein Langzeitkonto für einen flexiblen Renteneinstieg inkl. Zuschuss von 550 € pro Jahr. Sie erhalten die Möglichkeit zur Unternehmensbeteiligung durch den Erwerb von Aktien. Sie erhalten 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr und die Beschäftigung erfolgt auf Basis einer 38,5-Stunden-Woche. Ihre Gesundheit liegt uns am Herzen, deshalb bekommen Sie außerdem ein jährliches Guthaben in Höhe von 200,00 € für individuell gestaltbare Gesundheitsleistungen sowie einen zusätzlichen freien Tag. SO ERREICHEN SIE UNS Nils Giernoth (Talent Acquisition), nils.giernoth@basf.com , Tel.: +49 30 2005-59141 beantwortet gerne Ihre Fragen zu dieser Position. Gerne können Sie sich auch einen Online-Termin buchen. Unser Recruiting-Team erreichen Sie auch hier . Erste Informationen zu unserem Bewerbungsprozess finden Sie hier . ÜBER UNS Die BASF in Schwarzheide, zwischen der Hauptstadt Berlin und der Metropole Dresden gelegen, produziert funktionale Materialien und entwickelt intelligente Systemlösungen für globale Kunden. Wir stehen für Innovation, digitale Transformation und Nachhaltigkeit. Mit unseren neuen Technologien und Arbeitsweisen übernehmen wir eine Vorreiterrolle innerhalb der BASF-Gruppe. Nutzen Sie die Chance und gestalten Sie mit uns zukunftsorientierte Lösungen. Vielfalt ist unsere größte Stärke! Gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft – in einem globalen Team, das Inklusion und Chancengleichheit unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, sexueller Orientierung, Behinderung oder Weltanschauung lebt. Und übrigens, wir überlassen es unseren Mitarbeitenden, ob und wann sie sich duzen. jobs.name: (Senior) Regulatory Validation Coordinator (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF We are BASF in agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. We do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture by connecting innovation, customers and society. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth Take a look at our Agricultural Solutions: Vision & Mission WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT You will execute assigned validation and verification activities for new laboratory and computerized systems and changes to existing systems, in accordance with the approved validation strategy, agreed priorities and applicable OECD GLP requirements. You will prepare and maintain computerized system lifecycle documents and applicable SOPs, ensure they remain accurate, traceable and current, and coordinate review and approval by the designated owner. You will perform validation impact and risk assessments, recommend proportionate controls and escalate decisions beyond the defined framework. You will coordinate deviation investigations, root-cause analysis and CAPA follow-up and escalate significant risks, overdue actions or decisions requiring management approval. You will coordinate and ensure the timely completion of calibration activities for assigned laboratory equipment, in accordance with approved procedures, schedules and priorities. You will apply specialist expertise in GLP validation, computerized system compliance and data integrity and provide practical guidance to stakeholders. You will provide first-line operational IT support for assigned laboratory systems, coordinate issue resolution and escalate matters requiring system-owner or IT decisions. You will prepare assigned validation and calibration areas and documentation for GLP audits and regulatory inspections and coordinate follow-up actions allocated to the role. You will identify improvement opportunities, recommend practical enhancements and coordinate approved changes within the assigned scope. You will coordinate assigned activities across laboratory operations, Quality Assurance, IT, system owners and suppliers, track progress and escalate delivery risks. WHAT YOU OFFER You have a bachelor's or master's degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Chemistry, Engineering, IT or a related field. You have relevant professional experience in GxP validation or another regulated environment and can independently coordinate defined validation, documentation or quality-related activities. You have knowledge of GAMP 5 and applicable OECD GLP guidelines. You have knowledge of FDA 21 CFR Part 11 requirements, which is considered an advantage. You are accurate, service-minded and collaborative, with a positive and hands-on attitude. You have strong organizational and planning skills and can manage multiple priorities. You show a strong interest in laboratory systems, computing technologies and data management. You have excellent oral and written communication skills and are fluent in English. WHAT WE OFFER You will join a committed and collaborative team in an international, regulated environment. From day one, you will take on meaningful responsibilities and receive structured on-the-job training and knowledge transfer to further develop your expertise in GLP validation, computerized systems, data integrity and laboratory equipment calibration. We offer competitive compensation and attractive benefits, together with opportunities for professional development and career growth within an international company. HOW TO REACH US If you need more information about the process or the vacancy, you can reach our recruiting team here . ABOUT US As a reliable partner of the agricultural sector, BASF Agricultural Solutions Belgium NV offers innovative solutions in the area of crop protection and pest control to improve agricultural production, increase the profitability of agricultural companies and thereby improve the living standards of a growing population. Our strength lies in supporting farmers in the face of the challenges presented by an increasingly complex agricultural sector and in working with them to secure basic human necessities, such as food, nutrition and energy. Learn more about BASF Agricultural Solutions Belgium NV at BASF Innovation Center Gent. Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.
