jobs.name: Shipper
jobs.description: Now hiring! Shipper Attapulgus, GA (Onsite) We are looking for a Shipper to join our Catalyst team in Attapulgus, GA. Come create chemistry with us! BASF’s Catalysts division is the global market leader in catalyst technologies. The division develops and produces mobile emissions catalysts as well as process catalysts and offers precious metals trading, recycling and related products and services. As a Shipper, you will support the safe and efficient movement, handling, packaging, storage, and shipment of raw materials and finished products. In this role, you will operate logistics and material handling equipment, support additive production and shipping activities, manage inventory and warehouse processes, and ensure compliance with operational, quality, environmental, health, and safety requirements. During your 12 hour shift as a Shipper, you will Perform shared logistics duties including participating in housekeeping audits, following Blending Coordinator instructions and notes, completing safety shift inspection checklists, reporting repair needs, working with other Logistics Operators and Team Leaders to prioritize workload, and maintaining a clean and safe work environment. Understand, monitor, and operate within process safety operational guidelines, complete required process safety training, report process safety incidents, access SDS forms and EHS procedures, and follow written and verbal instructions while working independently to task completion. Direct truck drivers from staging areas and truck stops using telephones, CB radios, and plant radios, including properly spotting trucks according to procedures. Safely operate, maintain, perform minor repairs, and make proper adjustments to associated equipment, while properly labeling, storing, and handling materials used in logistics and production operations. Support export shipping activities by operating forklifts, pre-loader vehicles, blender loading systems, tote bin loaders, scales, chutes, and conveyors, as well as filling, labeling, staging, storing, and loading super sacks, tote bins, sea bulk containers, and domestic FCC shipments. Manufacture and package additive products by following process orders and procedures, weighing and blending components, selecting appropriate raw material lots, storing materials by lot and grade, sampling and labeling products, generating SDS shipping labels, and packaging additive production campaigns for transfer. Manage inventory and warehouse activities including locating and inventorying additives and raw materials, controlling inventory through computer and scanner systems, receiving packaging supplies and materials, verifying quantities against receiving documentation, and receiving, inspecting, repairing, and storing returned tote bins. Participate as a member of the Attapulgus Site Confined Space Rescue Team, utilize respiratory protection as required, maintain annual fit-testing certification, and perform additional duties assigned by supervision. If you... Hold a valid driver's license. Have the ability to safely operate, maintain, perform minor repairs, and make proper adjustments on associated equipment in assigned work areas. Are able to follow written and verbal instructions and work independently to task completion. Can read, write, count, and perform accurate arithmetic calculations using addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division. Have the ability to use computers to access procedures, SDS information, inventory systems, shipping documentation, email, and other operational resources. Are able to properly label, store, receive, inspect, and manage materials in accordance with site procedures. Can safely operate a forklift and successfully complete required forklift training. Are able to use normally available resources such as Process Orders, Procedures, and notes to perform required job duties and complete qualification sign-offs. Create your own chemistry with you@BASF This position is part of the United Steel Workers Union and is covered under the collective bargaining agreement.  All benefits are outlined in this agreement. About us As one of the largest chemical companies in North America we have been finding solutions for your everyday needs and addressing the most complex economic, environmental, and sustainability challenges for more than 150 years! At BASF we empower our employees with the tools, guidance and opportunities they need to advance and succeed in work and life. Giving you the support you need to be your best and fulfill your personal ambitions is what helps us create chemistry. After all, our success is linked to yours. Whatever path you envision, BASF is a great place to build a rewarding, successful career. Belong to Something Bigger. #belongatBASF Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. jobs.description: Now hiring! Reliability Engineer Chattanooga, TN (Onsite) Come create chemistry with us! Support the site by developing and implementing reliability improvement systems in collaboration with Production and Maintenance personnel. Provide technical services related to design review, equipment repair and maintenance, predictive and preventive maintenance, Root Cause Failure Analysis, troubleshooting, spare-parts management, and monitoring of preventive and predictive maintenance programs. Major objectives include: Improve asset reliability and availability by using performance data, asset criticality, and risk-based prioritization to address the highest-impact opportunities. Reduce recurring equipment failures through a disciplined Bad Actor Program, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and sustainable corrective actions. Develop and optimize preventive, predictive, and Reliability-Centered Maintenance strategies that support business and operating needs. Strengthen condition-monitoring capabilities, including vibration analysis, thermography, oil analysis, and other predictive technologies. Ensure reliability, maintainability, and lifecycle considerations are incorporated into equipment repairs, capital projects, and asset upgrades. Establish and execute a multi-year reliability improvement plan in collaboration with Production and Maintenance. As a Reliability Engineer, you create chemistry by... Track and analyze asset reliability performance, including mean time between failures (MTBF), mean time to repair (MTTR), availability, maintenance cost, and other relevant indicators; use the findings to prioritize improvement opportunities. Conduct asset criticality assessments and apply risk-based prioritization to maintenance strategies, resources, and reliability initiatives. Own the Bad Actor Program by identifying chronic equipment issues, developing action plans, tracking implementation, and verifying sustained performance improvement. Lead Root Cause Analysis for significant or recurring equipment failures and ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented and verified for effectiveness. Develop, monitor, and optimize preventive, predictive, and Reliability-Centered Maintenance strategies based on equipment risk, failure history, operating context, and business needs. Lead and improve condition-monitoring programs, including vibration analysis, thermography, oil analysis, and other predictive technologies; translate findings into timely maintenance actions. Provide troubleshooting and technical support to Production, the Maintenance Manager, Planner, and maintenance crafts for complex equipment reliability and repair issues. Evaluate equipment repair, replacement, and upgrade alternatives based on reliability, lifecycle cost, risk, schedule, and maintainability. Support capital projects and equipment upgrades through design review, equipment selection, layout, scope development, technical bid analysis, spare-parts determination, maintenance strategy development, installation, commissioning, and start-up in accordance with applicable plant, regulatory, and BASF standards. Develop, maintain, and execute the multi-year reliability improvement plan in collaboration with Production and Maintenance, including priorities, resource needs, schedules, and measurable outcomes. Develop the capabilities of in-house maintenance resources through coaching, technical guidance, and reliability-focused training. Comply with and actively support all applicable Quality, Safety, Ecology, Legal Compliance, and site policies and procedures. If you have... Bachelor’s degree in engineering and 2 years of related experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Knowledge of equipment reliability, maintenance, operations, and engineering activities in a chemical or manufacturing environment. Experience with preventive and predictive maintenance programs and equipment troubleshooting. Ability to perform or support Root Cause Failure Analysis and develop practical reliability improvement actions. Strong problem-solving, written communication, oral communication, and interpersonal skills. Ability to make sound decisions regarding equipment repair alternatives and reliability improvement priorities. Desired: Experience supporting capital projects, including equipment selection and layout, scope development, spare-parts determination, technical bid analysis, installation, commissioning, and start-up. Experience leading a Bad Actor Program or similar continuous-improvement process. Experience training and developing in-house maintenance resources. Knowledge of regulatory requirements, plant design requirements, and BASF engineering standards. Experience developing multi-year reliability improvement plans and maintenance strategies. jobs.name: Internship / Thesis Automation and Information Technology  (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF The Service Unit Global Engineering Services crafts and engineers a sustainable future with world class technical expertise. Our interdisciplinary, global, committed teams serve the BASF businesses to grow with our customers, products and markets. We add value by delivering competitive execution of investments. On construction sites across the globe, we deliver safe and reliable solutions to build and keep BASF assets operating at top performance. In doing so, we continuously improve and drive digital transformation. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT In the field of industrial communications technology, we support operations with industrial and hazard communication technology. In addition to conventional system technologies, we use innovative technologies for early hazard detection in the process industry. You will support us in the further development and implementation of our solutions. Possible topics include artificial intelligence (AI), PLC programming, computer vision, evaluation of innovative technologies. The focus of your work will be jointly determined depending on your interests and skills. At the Ludwigshafen site, you will work for this purpose in an interdisciplinary and cross-departmental team, in which you will present and discuss your results and implement them in the companies. WHAT YOU OFFER advanced bachelor's or master's degree in a STEM field of study good programming skills (e.g. Python, C/C++, Codesys) advantageous: knowledge in software versioning and MLOps (e.g. Git, DVC), machine learning, computer vision, network technology very good communication in German and English independent familiarization with new topics as well as the ability to actively contribute your ideas to the team we look forward to receiving your application documents, including a current certificate of enrollment. if it is a compulsory internship, please attach your study regulations or a corresponding document certifying the duration of the compulsory internship to your complete application documents WHAT WE OFFER Practical phase - actively apply theory in challenging and varied tasks/projects Teambuddy - contact person for all questions and regular feedback Networks - get to know different perspectives, ways of thinking and fields of work Internship compensation - a recognition of the commitment, more information here: on.basf.com/compensationBASFSE Flexible working hours - depending on the location and area of work HOW TO REACH US Yulia Haars (Talent Acquisition), yulia.haars@basf.com, will be happy to answer your questions for this position You can also reach our recruiting team here First information about our application process can be found here: on.basf.com/applicationprocess . ABOUT US BASF SE, located in Ludwigshafen am Rhein, is the corporate headquarters of the BASF Group and part of the Rhine-Neckar Metropolitan Region. BASF stands for competence in chemistry since 1865 and is represented today in the world's major consumer markets, with a wide range of products. As the largest employer in the region, BASF SE offers multiple career opportunities for students, university graduates and professionals providing also training in over 30 professions. Leisure, sports, culture and a good infrastructure characterize the Rhine-Neckar Metropolitan Region, in which BASF is also involved with numerous activities. Learn more about BASF SE at on.basf.com/BASFSE_LU Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.
